description:
🚀 Join SE3 Labs as (Senior) UAV / Robotics Integration Field Engineer - Hardware

Be the person who makes advanced autonomous systems work in the real world. Move across the full stack: drones, sensors, calibration, autonomy software, perception, networking, payloads, field operations, and partner environments. When the system is not mission-ready, you create clarity, find the root cause, and help make it robust.

 

About SE3

SE3 Labs is building Spatial AI by combining 3D computer vision with large language models. We believe the ability to reason about and act within physical space is foundational to unlocking the next generation of automation, from construction to smart infrastructure, and ultimately, defence.

Now, we’re bringing Spatial AI into the sky through high-performance UAVs that can perceive, localize, coordinate, and act in the real world. This requires more than strong algorithms and good hardware. It requires systems that can be configured, calibrated, tested, deployed, demonstrated, debugged, and improved under real field conditions.

We’re looking for a hands-on engineer who wants to work close to the product, close to the field, and close to the full autonomy stack. Someone who is not limited to one layer, but follows the problem wherever it leads.

 

About the Role

As (Senior) UAV / Robotics Integration Engineer, you will be the part of SE3’s engineering team to bring our technology into real-world use. You will bring together UAVs, payloads, sensors, onboard compute, autonomy software, operator tools, and partner environments into systems that are ready to fly, test, demonstrate, and deploy.

This is a highly hands-on, end-to-end prototyping and field engineering role. You will work directly with other startups, prime contractors, and military institutions, translating their requirements into practical mechanical and electrical designs building on our existing technology. When something is not working, you go where the evidence leads: recalibrate a sensor, debug a radio link, inspect a wiring harness, analyse a flight log, fix a configuration issue, improve a checklist, or bring the right evidence back to the software development team.

The problems you will work on are complex, dynamic, and multivariable. You will often have partial information, limited time, and a system where hardware, software, environment, and operator behavior interact in non-obvious ways. Your job is to create clarity, choose the right debugging path, and drive the system toward a robust long-term solution. You will not just operate systems. You will make them better.

 

What You’ll Work On

  • Own the integration project: Consult with partners, clarify requirements, agree interfaces and test criteria, and drive technical decisions and milestones to a working joint system.

  • Cross-Stack Engineering: Design integration concepts, CAD models, electrical circuits and system integration and bring together sensors, enclosures, calibration, compute, mechanisms, power electronics, controls, networking, autonomy software, and operator workflows.

  • Validation & Fieldability Ownership: Put your system through its paces: on test stands and in the field. Spot design flaws, integration gaps, recurring failure modes, and process bottlenecks. And establish confidence in mission-readiness as the maturity is realized.

  • Create clarity in complex situations: Separate symptoms from root causes, devise efficient debugging workflows, reproduce failures and drive lasting solutions that make the system more robust long term. When the root cause requires it, contribute directly to the layer that matters, drawing directly from the experts who develop core components of your system.

  • Acceptance & Testing Automation: Define and run acceptance tests for platforms, payloads, and deployment configurations. Own readiness checks across calibration, software flashing, networking, sensors, and pre-mission setup. Make readiness measurable and repeatable.

  • Field Deployment & End-User Interface: Install, configure, maintain, and support SE3 systems at test ranges, customer sites, partner demonstrations, exercises, and real-world deployments. Make sure our autonomous platforms perform reliably where it matters, enable end-users to succeed in their missions and represent SE3 with technical credibility outside the lab.

     
 

Your Profile

  • Most importantly, you’re structured, fast-moving, and mission-driven. You don’t wait for perfect information. You create clarity, iterate fast, and prefer finding and fixing root causes over applying patches.

  • You hold a B.Sc., M.Sc. or similar degree in Robotics, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, Mechatronics, or a related field.

  • You bring multiple years of hands-on experience integrating, testing, operating, and troubleshooting complex robotic, UAV, embedded, automotive, industrial automation, or defence systems.

  • You are proficient in using CAD software, creating wiring diagrams, building electromechanic prototypes and defining and executing test campaigns across hardware disciplines.

  • You are familiar with soldering, crimping, using multimeters, oscilloscopes, serial consoles, or other lab and field equipment, with at least basic experience in command line, data analysis tools and Linux usage.

  • You are proactive, hands-on and able to find effective solutions also under the constraints of field-campaigns and willing to travel and deploy across Europe.

  • You enjoy working directly with partners, operators, and end users. You can explain technical problems clearly, build trust in stressful situations, and represent SE3 professionally outside the lab.

  • You speak fluent English; German is a strong plus. A driving license is required. Given the nature of SE3’s work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to work on defence-related projects and, where required, obtain the relevant security clearance.

     
 

Especially Valued Bonus Skills

  • Specific knowledge in UAVs, PX4, ArduPilot, QGroundControl, Mission Planner, MAVLink, flight log analysis, mission planning, and airspace coordination.

  • Proficiency in PCBA and electronics circuit design and prototyping, especially targeting high-speed data interfaces and sensors

  • Experience with development on ROS2, Docker, Linux, edge compute devices, C++/Python, Bash, Git, or deployment automation.

  • Experience with networking and radio systems, including WiFi networks, LTE/5G modems, VPNs, telemetry links, antenna placement, RF interference, tactical communication links, and debugging connectivity issues in the field.

  • Experience with perception or measurement systems, camera/IMU calibration, sensor synchronization, image processing, or mission autonomy.

  • Skills interpreting sensor data, robot logs, flight logs, frequency-domain data, vibration issues, EMI issues, thermal issues, or intermittent hardware failures.

  • Experience with environmental testing such as vibration, thermal, ingress protection, EMI/EMC, or MIL-STD-style qualification workflows.

  • Experience creating acceptance tests, runbooks, troubleshooting- or training guides, fleet dashboards, release checklists, or field-support processes.

 

Perks & Benefits

  • Real Ownership: Get equity early, real stock options to participate directly in SE3’s growth

  • Work Environment to Excel at: Find a high-quality and modern toolset, flat hierarchy and a skilled, driven team which will push the limits together with you. We are an AI-first company empowering every employee with best-in-class AI tools and agents, giving you unlimited access to the latest advancements and a true productivity edge.

  • 31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off

  • Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass

  • Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Italy and Greece

  • Mentorship: Work closely with experienced engineers and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth

 

Our Process

  1. Intro Call (20 min): Let’s get to know each other

  2. Technical Screen (30 min): First overview of your abilities in system integration, field testing and debugging

  3. Technical Interview (45 min): We dive deeper into your hardware design skills and ability to iterate based on first principle reasoning.

  4. Onsite Trial/Case (1.5-2 hrs): We’ll integrate, diagnose, debug, or test something together, just like on the job.

  5. Team Dinner/Lunch: See if it’s a culture fit on both sides

description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Role
 
Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSEs) work directly with customers to quickly understand their greatest problems and design and implement solutions to use data against them. Our customers rely on Palantir’s platforms for some of their most critical operations, and projects often start with an open ended question like “Why are we delaying so many flights?” or “How can we better identify instances of money laundering?” As an FDSE, you’ll apply your problem solving ability, creativity, and technical skills to help organizations use their data to drive a real impact in the world. You’ll have the opportunity to gain rare insight into and contribute to some of the world’s most important industries and institutions.

As an FDSE, your responsibilities look similar to those of a startup CTO: you’ll work in small teams with minimal supervision and own end-to-end execution of high stakes projects. Your day might span discussing architecture with fellow engineers, wrangling massive-scale data, coding a custom web app, speaking with customer executives, or establishing strategy for your team.

Whether you aspire to be an entrepreneur or an engineering leader, we believe Palantir is the best place — with the best colleagues — to learn how. You’ll learn how to unpack a problem and understand the costs and consequences of its solution. You’ll learn new technologies and languages, and even develop them yourself. You’ll work autonomously and make decisions independently, within a community that will support and challenge you as you grow and develop.

Core Responsibilities
  • Impact: We take on meaningful and challenging projects that change the world for the better.
  • Ownership: We see projects through from beginning to end, working through any obstacles we may encounter.
  • Collaboration: We work internally with people from a variety of backgrounds — such as other FDSEs, product teams, and Deployment Strategists. We also work externally with our customers, often on site, to understand and solve their problems.
  • Trust: We trust each other to effectively manage time and priorities and give people the space to think for themselves.
  • Growth: We encourage ourselves and our peers to seek new challenges and opportunities for growth, as well as find new ways to innovate and share knowledge.
  • Learning: We often face entirely novel problems where we need to pick up a lot of new knowledge and learn how to use it to make progress. We believe experiential learning is one of the best teachers.

    • What We Value
  • Strong engineering background, preferred in fields such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, and Data Science.
  • A highly analytical mindset and eagerness to solve technical problems with data structures, storage systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end frameworks, and other technical tools.
  • Experience or interest in working with and using large scale data to solve valuable business problems.
  • Strong coder with demonstrated proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, C++, TypeScript/JavaScript, or similar.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively in teams of technical and non-technical individuals, and comfortable working in a rapidly changing environment with dynamic objectives and iteration with users.
  • Ability to continuously learn, work independently, and make decisions with minimal supervision.
  • Willingness and interest to travel as needed to client sites. Ability to travel 25-50% preferred, but may vary by team and location.

    • What We Require
  • Fluency in German
  • Security clearance or the ability to obtain a clearance.
    • Life at Palantir
     
    We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region.
     
    In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the city and or country in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office.
     
    If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process, please and let us know how we can help.
     
    Please note that you will never be asked to submit a payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

About Tensordyne 

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. While we have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe, this particular role is based on-site in Sunnyvale. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence! Location: This is an on-site role based in Sunnyvale, CA (required), with flexible office hours.

Responsibilities

The role will require you to join Tensordyne's Platform Software team to lead requirements gathering, design, and development of system-level services, tools, and supporting tests for Tensordyne's AI inference platform software, including debugging, profiling, and analysis capabilities. The successful candidate will support cross-functional engineering teams in the bring-up and validation of platform software on AI inference systems, and partner closely with the hardware, silicon, and validation teams to deliver robust, production-quality platform software. You will work close to the hardware on firmware and board bring-up, bootloaders and BSP development, device drivers, and Linux kernel modules, collaborating directly with the silicon and hardware teams on hardware/software co-design. The role also involves system-level performance and power optimization across the AI inference platform, working with low-level interfaces such as PCIe, I2C, SPI, and JTAG. Occasional travel (e.g., to partner, customer, or contract manufacturer sites) may be required but is not mandatory.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience developing low-level systems and embedded software, firmware, and tooling for high-performance computing systems deployed to data center customers.
  • Hands-on experience bringing up and debugging complex Linux-based systems at the kernel and driver level, including embedded Linux, device drivers, and/or RTOS environments; experience with SoC/silicon bring-up is highly desirable. Familiarity with AI inference frameworks and data center deployment/management environments is preferred.
  • Expert programming experience in C and C++, with proficiency in Python, Bash/Shell, and/or related programming languages. Rust experience is a plus. Comfortable interfacing directly with hardware, reading schematics and datasheets, and debugging with tools such as JTAG, logic analyzers, and oscilloscopes.
  • Self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable working across hardware, silicon, and software teams in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Excellent technical communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex technical concepts and practical solutions.
  • BS or MS degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

Tensordyne's culture was built on the following values

  • Put people first. We only succeed when our people succeed.
  • Ethics and integrity always; Being open, honest, and respectful of everyone.
  • Think Big. Be ambitious and have audacious goals.
  • Aim for excellence. Quality and excellence count in everything we do.
  • Own it and get it done. Results matter!
  • Make each person better together, than they would be as an individual.
  • Embrace each others' differences, and embrace that there will be differences.

Tensordyne is an equal opportunity employer. We believe that a diverse team is better at tackling complex problems and coming up with innovative solutions. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

description:
We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you.

Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future.

Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter.

Help us see what's possible. Join us.

Your Role

Orbem’s AI-powered MRI systems run on edge infrastructure deployed directly at customer sites, such as hatcheries and food processing plants. As an Expert Site Reliability Engineer, you will own the reliability, availability, and performance of this growing global fleet.

You are the team’s deepest technical authority on the on-premise platform, setting architecture and standards through hands-on expertise. You will own the hardware, network, operating system, and Kubernetes layers that power teams like Data, Machine Learning, and Software.

Your Day-to-Day

As an Individual Contributor on the expert track, your responsibilities center entirely on deep technical ownership and execution:

Edge Infrastructure Ownership

  • Own the reliability and lifecycle of our edge racks: server hardware, network equipment, custom Linux-based OS, and the GPU-enabled Kubernetes layer running our AI classification services.

  • Design and improve automation for provisioning our growing fleet (50+ edge clusters and counting) using tools like Terraform, BMC/IPMI, and router APIs.

  • Maintain the secure network connecting edge deployments to our central cloud, and the tooling that enables safe software delivery to the fleet.

Reliability & Incident Management

  • Participate in the rotation of support on weekdays and own triage and resolution for escalated production issues.

  • Lead post-incident reviews and turn findings into lasting, automated fixes.

  • Define and monitor SLOs/SLIs/SLAs for physical edge systems running unattended in the field.

  • Extend our observability stack (Prometheus, custom hardware exporters, Grafana, Datadog) to catch issues proactively, often before customers notice.

Architecture, Collaboration & Craft

  • Set technical direction for edge infrastructure projects and contribute to technical planning and ticket writing.

  • Mentor fellow engineers through pairing, design/code reviews, and knowledge sharing, raising the technical bar without formal management authority.

  • Act as the top-level technical escalation point, personally helping resolve the most complex support and production issues.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders (with the eventual support of a Product Manager) to gather requirements and manage technical alignment.

  • Automate away repetitive manual work, applying the same rigor to internal tooling as to a customer-facing product.

Your Experience and Skills

  • Container Orchestration: Super proficient in maintaining Kubernetes on edge machines.

  • Programming: Fluency in at least one modern language, such as Golang or Python.

  • Monitoring: Deep understanding of concepts and tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.

  • Terraform is a native language to you.

  • Linux & Server Expertise: Deep proficiency in Linux-based systems and experience with server hardware, including components like RAID controllers BIOS, and Booting.

  • DevOps: Good understanding of release systems and proficiency with GitOps tools like Argo CD.

  • Security Management: Proficient in security concepts like certificate management (issuing, lifecycles, etc.) and secure network tunnels (e.g., IPSec/VPN).

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Holistic Data Center Engineering Expertise: Deep understanding of how to deal with low-level hardware like routers, switches, servers, BIOS, and TPM modules .

  • Bare-Metal Automation: Proven experience designing and implementing automation for bare-metal infrastructure provisioning.

  • Modern Kubernetes & CI/CD Architect: Moves beyond basic deployments to architecting sophisticated, automated, and resilient delivery pipelines using cutting-edge GitOps and Kubernetes-native tooling.

  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Mastery: Expert-level proficiency with Terraform to build version-controlled, repeatable, and scalable environments.

Behavioral competencies

  • Strategic Thinker: You develop a clear vision and roadmap for the edge platform, considering its long-term health, scalability, and usability.

  • Strong Communicator: You build strong relationships with development teams and other stakeholders, communicate changes clearly, and secure buy-in.

  • High Ownership: You take end-to-end ownership of your technical output, including reliability, documentation, and continuous improvement.

  • Data-Driven: You use metrics on uptime, incidents, and support requests to prioritize the work that delivers the most value.

  • Customer-Focused: You keep developer and end-customer experience front of mind in your planning and execution.

Fit to Our Values

  • We Own Every Challenge: we enjoy complexity and thrive under uncertainty.

  • We Strive for Better: we seize any opportunity for growth and challenge the status quo. We are constantly learning and improving.

  • We Imagine New Frontiers: we think beyond “doable” and “reasonable”. We design a sustainable and healthy future together.

What We Offer

International Environment:

  • Join a team with 40+ nationalities across 5 continents, all driven by a shared purpose: shedding light on the world’s toughest challenges.

Comprehensive Benefits:

  • Stock Options: Share in Orbem’s success.

  • Relocation Support: Seamless support for your move to Germany.

  • Learning & Development: €1,750 annual budget for personal growth.

  • Fitness Membership: Access to Urban Sports Club or Wellpass.

  • Childcare Reimbursement: Support for Kita/Kindergarten fees.

  • Deutschland Ticket: Monthly subsidy towards public transportation costs.

Work-Life Integration:

  • Flexible Hours & Home Office: Work when and where it suits you.

  • WFH Perks: Get €185 to upgrade your home office + an external monitor on us!

  • 30 Days Paid Leave: Plenty of time to recharge.

  • Personal Leave: Flexibility for life’s important moments.

  • Work From Anywhere: Experience new cultures and environments for up to 60 days per year.

Make a Difference:

Join an ambitious, fast-growing team working on breakthrough technology. In our scale-up environment, you'll have the freedom to lead your projects and make an impact. We provide a platform for you to explore, innovate, and define your vision for the future. At Orbem, we're committed to helping you discover your strengths, and while we aim to teach you, we also want to learn from you.

Your Team:

You'll become part of our diverse and international team. Learn more about the team members, their work, and challenges here: https://orbem.ai/company/

At Orbem, we're committed to building a smart, diverse team, and we recognize that self-doubt can prevent talented individuals from applying. If you feel you don't meet every requirement, we'd love to hear from you anyway!

description:
About the Team

The OpenAI for Government AI Architect team partners with public sector organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with government agencies, public institutions, and partner organizations serving the government to identify where AI can advance critical missions, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, Security, Global Affairs, and specialist delivery teams to help public sector customers adopt advanced AI responsibly and effectively.

About the Role

As an AI Architect, you will be the senior technical owner for a named portfolio of customers and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership teams. You will shape each customer's AI strategy and guide their journey from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable mission impact.

You will own the technical account plan across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate mission priorities into a focused use-case portfolio, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable customer value. The Account Director leads the overall account strategy and relationship, while you lead the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production impact.

You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, and partners to provide deeper expertise and execute work where needed. This role calls for strong public sector fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy and hands-on technical conversations.

This role is based in Munich or London. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for a named portfolio of public sector customers and pre-sales prospects.

  • Partner with Account Directors on account strategy while owning the technical account plan, technical milestones, adoption priorities, and expansion opportunities.

  • Lead discovery with agency leaders, mission owners, executives, and technical teams to identify, qualify, and prioritize use cases tied to meaningful mission and operational outcomes.

  • Develop clear Applied AI Architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, identity, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, and deployment.

  • Guide customers through technical evaluations, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, and proofs of value, building confidence in both the solution and its path to production.

  • Help customers navigate the security, compliance, governance, and deployment requirements that shape AI adoption in the public sector.

  • Maintain a focused use-case portfolio with clear decision criteria, ownership, blockers, success measures, delivery needs, and adoption plans.

  • Develop trusted relationships and technical champions across CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, Chief Data and AI Officers, program leaders, engineering teams, and other customer stakeholders.

  • Qualify and coordinate support from Deployment Engineering, implementation, training and enablement, security, product and domain specialists, partners, and other delivery teams.

  • Remain accountable for technical progress and customer outcomes while ensuring delivery teams own implementation execution once engaged.

  • Track adoption, usage, account health, production readiness, and measurable mission impact, intervening early when risks threaten value realization.

  • Apply public sector and mission expertise to recognize repeatable patterns, sharpen customer priorities, and identify relevant expansion opportunities.

  • Share customer insights with Product, Engineering, and Research, translating field learnings into better products, architecture guidance, and reusable practices.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have significant experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical customer success.

  • Have guided complex organizations from technical evaluation through production adoption and measurable impact.

  • Have experience working with government agencies, public institutions, or government contractors and understand how mission priorities, security, compliance, governance, and procurement considerations shape technology adoption.

  • Build credibility with senior technical and government leaders while communicating equally well with hands-on engineers and program teams.

  • Bring strong software and cloud architecture foundations, including APIs, distributed systems, data integration, identity, security, and privacy.

  • Understand modern AI systems, frontier models, agentic applications, model evaluation, retrieval, and enterprise AI workflows.

  • Can prototype, explain technical tradeoffs, and work confidently with APIs, SDKs, and languages such as Python or JavaScript.

  • Exercise sound judgment about when to go deep personally, when to involve specialists, and how to establish clear handoffs and ownership.

  • Have experience developing technical account plans, prioritizing complex customer portfolios, and connecting adoption to measurable outcomes.

  • Bring meaningful expertise in a relevant public sector mission or customer segment.

  • Communicate clearly and can turn ambiguity into a practical technical narrative, executive decision, or action plan.

  • Work collaboratively across disciplines and care deeply about helping public sector organizations deploy advanced AI safely and responsibly.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link.

OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy

At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

description:
Thorit GmbH · Böblingen, Germany · Hybrid, mostly on-site · Working student (Werkstudent), 15 to 20 hours per week · Start as early as possible

About the Role

You'll build the agent stack an AI consultancy runs on. We use several LLMs across many internal tools, and today each one is wired up differently. You'll turn that into one LangChain foundation: one model-agnostic layer, shared building blocks and proper tracing, then move our internal tools onto it. Real users, real production, from your first month.

What You'll Do

  • Map every internal tool that uses an LLM: which model, how it is called, what data flows through it

  • Build our internal LangChain and LangGraph reference stack with a model-agnostic LLM layer, tool calling, MCP and structured outputs

  • Migrate existing internal tools and agents onto that shared stack

  • Compare LLMs with evals and tracing and help decide which model fits which use case

  • Create templates and docs so colleagues build new tools the same way, including apps that started in Lovable

  • Connect the stack to our systems through APIs, webhooks and a shared data model

What You Bring

Must-haves

  • Enrolled in a computer science, software engineering, AI, data science or business informatics program

  • At least one project you built yourself with LangChain or LangGraph (show us the code)

  • Hands-on experience with more than one LLM or provider and an idea of their trade-offs

  • Solid Python, plus first experience with REST APIs and SQL

  • Very good English; German is a plus for working with some internal users

  • Living close enough to Böblingen to work from our office at least one day a week

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with LangSmith or other LLM tracing and evals, RAG and vector stores, or MCP

  • TypeScript and experience with Lovable, Supabase or Postgres

  • Interest in writing your thesis on an applied LLM or agent topic

Your Team

You'll report to the Team Lead AI Engineering Germany, joining the AI Engineering Germany team within Thorit's AI & Engineering Practice. Senior engineers set the architecture with you and review your code, and you'll work directly with colleagues across the company who use the tools you build.

Tech Stack

Python, LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, several LLM providers (Claude and others), MCP, vector stores, Supabase and Postgres, TypeScript, Lovable, Git, HubSpot APIs, Jira, Confluence, Microsoft 365.

What We Offer

  • Real ownership: you build the stack our internal tools run on, not side tasks, and your work goes live

  • Hours that fit your studies: flexible working hours planned around lectures and exam phases, more hours in semester breaks if you want

  • Paid vacation pro rata, based on 31 days for a full-time position (above the statutory minimum)

  • Access to several frontier LLMs and senior engineers who review your code

  • MacBook and a modern office in Böblingen with free parking, good public transport and company e-scooters

  • Lunch subsidy of €5 tax-free per working day

  • Free snacks, fruit, coffee and drinks, a dog-friendly office and Corporate Benefits discounts from several hundred brands

  • Team events, offsites, our Christmas party and Lunch & Learns

  • Thesis and next step: the option to write your thesis with us, and a clear path to a Junior AI Engineer role after graduation

About Thorit

Thorit is the AI & CRM consultancy for the agent-native enterprise. As a Diamond HubSpot Partner we work with enterprise clients in DACH and the Nordics, building the agent layer on top of HubSpot and the systems around it, then operating it with them. Agentic means software that acts on goals instead of waiting for clicks. We don't just sell that, we run on it, and that is exactly where you come in.

JusDice is part of the applike group ecosystem, backed by strong financial support from Bertelsmann, and boasts a highly motivated workforce.

We are a team of experts in software development, online marketing, data-driven business intelligence, and app & game design. We are always seeking new creative solutions to complex problems, which has enabled us to release new products fast!

What you will do:

  • Developing robust, scalable, and efficient microservices in Go

  • Planning, developing, and maintaining backend architectures using AWS Cloud Technologies, Kubernetes, Go Microservices and ElasticSearch.

  • Ensuring quality through unit and integration testing

  • Collaborating within agile teams to analyze and implement product requirements

  • Optimizing existing systems for performance and scalability

  • Extensive experience in software development with Golang (at least 2–3 years)

  • Strong knowledge of AWS cloud services: mainly ECS, DynamoDB, CloudWatch

  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes

  • Proficiency with Terraform, Terragrunt

  • Proficiency in working with both relational and noSQL databases

  • Hands-on experience working with Microservices architecture

  • Solid understanding of software architecture and design patterns

  • Experience with CI/CD and DevOps practices

  • Strong sense of ownership, ability to work well in a team, and enthusiasm for innovative technologies

  • Be fluent in English

We support every ambition - from learning German to a relocation bonus that helps you settle in and make Hamburg feel like home.

The Interview Process:

At justDice, we value ownership, honesty, collaboration, and having fun while building something ambitious together.

description:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is the world's leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is at our core and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

KAYAK is looking for a Data Engineer to build the trusted data foundation behind machine learning across the company.

You’ll partner with data scientists to understand their modeling needs and what the available data can (and can’t) support. You’ll transform large-scale raw data into production-ready datasets and build the scalable pipelines that make them dependable and reusable. Working across Data Science, Data Engineering, and Data Platform, you’ll help address data gaps and bring new machine-learning use cases into production.

If you’re excited to shape how teams across KAYAK use data to build and scale machine learning, we’d love to hear from you.

This role will be required to work from our Berlin office 3 days per week.

In this role, you will:

  • Partner with the Data Science teams and help translate modeling needs into dataset requirements, then collaborate with Data Engineering and Data Platform to extend foundational pipelines into ML-ready datasets.

  • Design scalable and efficient dataset workflows and ensure pipeline reliability through validation, monitoring, and alerting; diagnose and resolve issues.

  • Ship production-ready data solutions that enable ML applications and deliver real-world impact on user experience and key business metrics.

  • Identify gaps and opportunities, contributing to technical decisions and roadmap priorities that strengthen the data foundation for current and future ML use cases.

  • Collaborate across Data Science, Engineering, and Data Platform, communicating technical decisions, findings, and trade-offs clearly and concisely to technical and non-technical audiences.

Please apply if you have:

  • Strong technical foundations in data engineering, software engineering, and systems design, backed by a track record of building and operating reliable, large-scale data pipelines. Demonstrated capability matters more than academic credentials.

  • Hands-on experience developing production data pipelines, with the ability to clearly explain the problems addressed, your specific contributions, and the resulting impact.

  • Ownership, sound judgment, and systems thinking, with the ability to navigate technical, reliability, cost, and risk trade-offs while working independently and recognizing when to seek guidance.

  • Fluency with AI-assisted workflows, leveraging modern tools to improve productivity and quality while critically evaluating their outputs and limitations.

  • Curiosity, humility, and a collaborative mindset, with a commitment to continuous learning, sharing knowledge, and improving together.

Bonus qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with technologies relevant to KAYAK’s stack, such as Kafka, Flink, Iceberg, Trino, AWS, Kubernetes, Airflow, Python, SQL, and schema-based data contracts.

  • Experience with feature stores or feature pipelines.

  • Familiarity with Agile ways of working, such as sprint planning and team ceremonies.

Benefits and Perks:

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year

  • Focus on mental health and well-being:

    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth

    • Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace

    • Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)

  • No meeting Fridays

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid volunteer time

  • Focus on your career growth:

    • Development Dollars

    • Leadership development

    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings

  • Travel Discounts

  • Employee Resource Groups

  • 6 weeks paid vacation + a day off for your birthday

  • Free lunch 2 days per week

  • Pension plan contributions

22.000+ Unternehmen verlassen sich auf easybill. Wir sorgen dafür, dass Rechnungen, Prozesse und Integrationen im Alltag einfach laufen. Du bekommst klare Prioritäten, kurze Wege und Raum, um Dinge sauber zu lösen. Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung: für technische Entscheidungen, durchdachte Nutzerführung und eine App, auf die sich unsere Kundinnen und Kunden unterwegs verlassen können.

Das ideale Profil? Du bist Freelancer und in TypeScript, React Native und Expo richtig tief drin, verstehst die Besonderheiten mobiler Anwendungen und möchtest ein Produkt in einer frühen Entwicklungsphase entscheidend prägen. Idealerweise bringst du außerdem Kenntnisse in PHP und Symfony mit, um Funktionen auch auf Seiten unserer REST-API mitzugestalten.

Aufgaben

Du entwickelst easybill-mobile auf Basis von React Native, Expo und TypeScript für iOS und Android weiter. Eine technische Grundlage mit Anmeldung, Dashboard und Dokumentenübersichten ist bereits vorhanden. Darauf baust du auf und gestaltest die nächsten Schritte gemeinsam mit dem Team.

Together with Stefan, our CTO, and our embedded Rust engineer, you'll take on architecture decisions and code reviews and help take us from a tested prototype to a fully certified product. What You'll Do

  • Extend our middleware and independent modules into one real-time system: their control and data flow, scheduling and how they stay predictable under load

  • Mentor other engineers on the team, lead code reviews and raise the bar for code quality across the team

  • Set and evolve the engineering practices that keep the firmware trustworthy: testing, CI/CD, HiL, coverage and end-to-end requirements traceability

  • Debug and trace on real hardware across ARM and RISC-V cores, down to interrupt priorities, the memory map and timing of individual functions

Must have

  • Several years of production Rust on embedded targets (no_std), including features you designed and shipped yourself

  • Experience making, documenting and defending architecture trade-offs for embedded systems

  • A quality mindset: hands-on test experience, CI and coverage as everyday tools, and code reviews with constructive feedback.

  • Critical, analytical, systematic thinking: you reason from first principles, make your assumptions explicit and challenge existing paradigms

Strongly preferred

  • Hands-on debugging and tracing on ARM and RISC-V

  • Knowledge of various communication protocols and stacks: CAN, LIN, BLE, LTE modems

Nice to have

description:
What is Anori Tech doing?

The world talks about batteries, cells and the energy transition. Almost nobody talks about the Battery Management System (BMS) that makes them work.

As battery applications multiply, from robotics and mobility to data centers and grid-scale storage, BMS complexity is exploding. Legacy BMS architectures were never built for this: too rigid to keep up with new requirements, they've turned the BMS into the bottleneck of battery development.

We're building something different: a novel software-defined BMS architecture combined with an AI-driven configuration process. It gets battery manufacturers the right BMS for their exact use case within days, regardless of application or cell chemistry.

We're building the battery management system platform of tomorrow. Delivered in days, not years.

Join us and shape one of the fastest growing markets in the energy sector: The BMS market.

Our Motivation

At Anori Tech, we believe everything is energy, and progress runs on it. With Anori we actively shape the energy transition: from oil to electric, from low to high efficiency. We need batteries for this transition and almost all batteries need a BMS. We strive for Shenzhen speed and German engineering quality. Our objective: put Europe back on the map in the race for the energy transition and build technical leadership out of Hamburg.

About the Role

A BMS is only as good as what it knows about the battery. As our Algorithm Engineer, you'll develop the algorithms that tell the Anori BMS what is happening inside the cells: state of charge, state of health and balancing. And you won't stop at the concept: you'll design algorithms, implement them in our embedded Rust firmware and validate them on real hardware. Later on, the role grows into the cloud, where data pipelines and fleet analytics will build on the models you create today. You'll work closely with Stefan, our CTO, and our firmware and hardware engineers.

Start date: from January 1, 2027

What You'll Do

  • Develop the algorithms that estimate SoC and SoH for different cell chemistries and applications

  • Design balancing strategies that fit the hardware and use case

  • Build battery models (e.g. equivalent circuit models) and parameterize them from measurement data with statistical rigor

  • Implement your algorithms directly in the embedded Rust firmware, efficient enough for constrained hardware

  • Design experiments and evaluation methodologies: analyze failure modes, quantify trade-offs between accuracy, robustness and compute cost

  • Support in building data pipelines and fleet analytics in the cloud

Must have

  • Hands-on experience with state of charge and state of health estimation, shown in a product, publication or substantial project. For example Kalman-type filters, H∞ filters, observers, or coulomb counting with model-based correction

  • Deep understanding of battery behavior and modeling, e.g. equivalent circuit models, hysterisis, ageing or also physics based models

  • Experience implementing numerical algorithms on embedded, constrained hardware (e.g. in Rust or C/C++ - heads-up our firmware is written in Rust, and we'll help you get up to speed)

  • Critical, analytical, systematic thinking: you reason from first principles, make your assumptions explicit and challenge existing paradigms

Strongly preferred

  • Experience with cell balancing algorithms and their effects

  • Working with real cell data from test benches or cyclers

  • Signal processing fundamentals: FIR/IIR filter design, sampling and aliasing, noise characterization of sensor data

description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do.

Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and merchants every day. From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo's (& Doordash's) growth at scale.

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our Event Streaming Systems team. This is a hybrid role.

In this role, you'll provide technical leadership for the event streaming infrastructure that powers business-critical workflows across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt. You'll help define the long-term direction of our messaging and streaming platforms, lead high-impact technical initiatives across teams, and raise the reliability, scalability and operational excellence bar for Tier-0 infrastructure.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the Event Streaming Systems team within the broader Storage organisation. The team builds and operates highly reliable, scalable and efficient event streaming infrastructure, including Kafka, Event Streaming abstractions (internally called EventBus), messaging platform capabilities, and future streaming technologies. The team also partners closely with Database Reliability, Storage, SRE, Data Platform and Core Infrastructure teams to ensure our most critical data and messaging systems remain reliable, operable and cost-efficient at global scale.

These systems support Tier-0 workflows and are foundational to how engineering teams build reliable, event-driven products at scale.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Define and drive the technical vision and roadmap for our event streaming and messaging platforms, balancing reliability, scalability, cost, operability and developer experience.
  • Lead team-level and cross-team initiatives for Kafka, EventBus and related streaming infrastructure, from ambiguous problem definition through architecture, delivery, rollout and adoption.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor for Kafka, messaging, storage-adjacent and DBRE-related platform decisions across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt.
  • Design durable, extensible systems and platform capabilities that can be leveraged by other engineers and teams, reducing duplicated effort and operational risk.
  • Lead the resolution of complex distributed systems problems, including reliability incidents, performance bottlenecks, capacity constraints, data-safety risks and production-operability gaps.
  • Raise the operational excellence bar for Tier-0 infrastructure through observability, automation, incident response, runbooks, operational readiness and continuous improvement.
  • Proactively build alignment with partner teams, including EventBus, Storage, DBRE, SRE, Data Platform and Core Infrastructure, shaping joint goals and mitigating cross-org delivery risks.
  • Mentor and grow engineers through technical guidance, design, feedback, code review, incident review facilitation and knowledge-sharing across the engineering community.
  • Evaluate emerging streaming, storage and automation technologies, including AI-enabled operational tooling where appropriate, and champion pragmatic adoption where they can materially improve quality, velocity or efficiency.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in several of these areas and the judgment to lead others through ambiguity:

  • Significant experience building, operating and evolving distributed systems in production, ideally for platform or infrastructure teams supporting critical workloads.
  • Deep hands-on experience with Kafka or comparable event streaming systems as a platform, infrastructure service or business-critical production dependency.
  • Strong technical leadership skills, with a track record of defining technical direction, shaping roadmaps and leading multi-engineer or cross-team initiatives.
  • Ability to make and own technical decisions in ambiguous situations, using data, operational signals, customer needs and long-term system health to guide tradeoffs.
  • Strong coding ability in Java, Go, Python or similar languages, with a focus on reliable, maintainable, observable and scalable production systems.
  • Experience improving production reliability through automation, observability, capacity management, incident response, operational readiness and sustainable on-call practices.
  • Strong distributed systems fundamentals, including Linux, networking, storage, JVM-based systems, fault tolerance, backpressure, capacity planning and performance tuning.
  • A force-multiplier mindset: you create leverage through reusable technical foundations, clear documentation, strong engineering practices, mentoring and removing single points of failure.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence platform, infrastructure, product and reliability teams without relying on authority.

Nice to have

  • Experience contributing to Kafka or related open source distributed systems.
  • Experience with Redpanda, WarpStream, AutoMQ, Pulsar or similar streaming technologies.
  • Experience with JVM tuning, diskless streaming architectures or multi-region event streaming platforms.
  • Experience operating Tier-0 infrastructure at large scale, including incident leadership and post-incident improvement programs.
  • Experience with database reliability, storage systems, data platforms or DBRE practices in addition to event streaming.
  • Experience using automation or AI-assisted operational tooling to improve reliability, developer experience or incident response quality.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo (Doordash), you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.

We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better.

Working here you can expect to:

  • 🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale. Work on complex, always-on infrastructure that impacts millions every day.
  • 🌱 See your impact, fast. Shape the direction of foundational platforms used by teams across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt.
  • 🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership. Lead ambiguous, high-impact technical problems with strong support from peers and leaders.
  • 🌎 A culture built for builders. High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.
  • 💰 Share in the success you help create. Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.

Who We Are

We're a team of founders, engineers, researchers, creatives, and operators building what we believe will be one of the defining companies of the AI era.

Who We Are Not

  • We are not remote. We value the spontaneous moments that happen when we’re together - over dinner, in the hallway, around whiteboards. We like being around each other because the best conversations here rarely happen in meetings.

  • We are not your typical team. It’s not just the 10 countries we’re from, the languages we speak or our non-traditional backgrounds. We’re solving hard problems with people we respect - we make the most of our time together, we make it special.

  • We are not another “polished” SF startup. We value velocity over speed, raw talent over brands, and genuine human connection above all else. We value being successful, not looking successful.

What You’ll Own & Build

As a Member of Technical Staff within the Research Tribe, you’ll be one of the early engineers shaping the core systems that power Seldon.

You won’t just build agents - you’ll design the infrastructure that governs how they operate: how they coordinate, how they’re evaluated, and how their behavior improves over time.

This is a deeply technical role bridging distributed systems, machine intelligence, and product - turning stochastic models into reliable, production-grade systems.

  • Multi-Agent Systems Architecture: Design and implement agentic systems, rather than prompt chains, at scale. You’ll define agent topologies, robust orchestration layers, structured state management, persistent and scoped memory, tool-use registries and execution, and build structured, inspectable systems. You’re building a long-running harness-based agentic platform, not wiring together LLM API calls.

  • Behavioral & Persona Modeling: Simulate user archetypes with goal-directed behavior. You’ll design data-grounded personas, enable “computer-use” on real interfaces, and develop agents with critique and reflection loops. You’re producing measurable, actionable behavior.

  • Evaluation & Prompt Engineering: Design prompt schemas and reasoning templates as integrated systems. You’ll build frameworks that measure behavioral fidelity and failure modes, and implement automated and HITL feedback. If it can’t be measured, it doesn’t ship.

  • Signal & Insight Systems: Build systems that transform raw agent outputs into high-signal insights. You’ll cluster observations across runs, implement severity scoring, and map behavioral signals to product decisions. Turn noisy outputs into decisions.

  • Production Reliability: Build the infrastructure to operate agents in production. You’ll implement tracing, attribution, and cost monitoring, detect failure modes and design fallbacks, circuit breakers, and evaluation pipelines. The bar is production reliability.

Who You Are

  • Systems, Not Prompts: You prioritize state machines, orchestration layers, and tool-use contracts over prompt hacking. You build for reliability, inspectability, and improvability - you’re uncomfortable with “it just works sometimes.” If it can’t be measured, it doesn’t ship.

  • Production Experience: You have 5+ years building complex software and 2+ years shipping agentic LLM systems. You’ve built harnesses where agents manage tool selection, error recovery, and multi-step execution autonomously in production environments that run, break, and evolve.

  • Orchestration Systems: You’re experienced with multi-agent orchestration, sandboxed execution, and complex backends. You optimize for coordination, scoped memory & context, and how agents degrade gracefully under pressure.

  • Python Mastery: You’re an expert in async programming and structured data modeling (Pydantic), building maintainable, scalable systems designed for extensibility.

  • Fast, Iterative Builder: You thrive when research and product move together. You’re comfortable shipping quickly, learning from real users, and refining systems in tight loops.

  • High Ownership, Low Ego: You take responsibility for what you build. You’re willing to be wrong, change your mind, and prioritize being effective over being “theoretically right.

  • Product Intuition: You prioritize signal over noise because outputs matter. You care that what you build helps someone make a decision.

About us

Most labs still count cells under a microscope by hand. It's slow, repetitive, and error-prone. We're replacing that manual work with software. By combining a standard microscope with a smartphone, we run computer vision models that locate, track, and measure cells automatically in real time. We're starting with semen analysis and expanding to other routine microscopic samples. We're a small, well-funded team in Berlin, founded in 2026. Our goal is to make automated, reliable diagnostic analysis accessible on any phone connected to a microscope.

The role

We're looking for an engineer who wants to own the whole platform behind a medical product: services, data, infrastructure, security and identity. A first version runs today. The hard part is making it trustworthy enough for clinical use: patient data that stays safe, an audit trail that holds up for years, and a system that recovers when something breaks. You'll own all of it, working closely with the founders and our CTO.

What you'll do

  • Own the platform end to end: backend, data, infrastructure and security.

  • Get it ready for clinical use, and keep it reliable as we grow.

  • Build identity, access and data handling that clinics and auditors can trust.

  • Make the architecture calls: what to build now, what to defer, what to cut.

  • Set the engineering standard and help hire the team that follows.

What you bring

  • Platforms you've built and run. You've built backend platforms from scratch and run them in production, through outages, data incidents, migrations and growth.

  • Database depth. You know what happens under the query: indexing, locking, transactions, replication, zero-downtime schema changes, and backups you've actually restored.

  • Security by default. Authentication and authorisation, tenant isolation, secrets, audit logging. You think about how a system gets attacked before it ships.

  • Identity done properly. Identity providers, sessions and tokens, roles and permissions, onboarding and offboarding.

  • Infrastructure. Infrastructure as code, containers, Linux, networking and cloud are everyday tools for you.

  • Beyond the backend. The backend is your home, but when the product needs it, you read and change the app yourself.

  • Systematic troubleshooting. You reproduce first and fix root causes. You work from evidence like logs, traces, metrics and query plans, and you stay calm when production breaks.

  • AI-native engineering. Coding agents are part of your daily work. You give them good context, split work into reviewable steps, and stand behind every line you ship.

  • Ownership. You help shape the roadmap, push back on weak ideas, set your own priorities and raise problems early. Nobody has to chase you. Strong opinions, held with evidence and open to revision.

  • Range. You've worked across several companies, stacks or environments. How you work counts far more than how many years you've done it.

Nice to have

  • Regulated environments with audits: medical devices, health, finance.

  • Serving ML models in production.

What we offer

  • Ownership from day one. As a founding engineer, you're part of the company through our virtual share option plan (VSOP).

  • You grow with us. As the company grows, your role grows with it.

  • Real influence. You decide how we build software, and you shape the engineering team we build.

  • A competitive salary.

  • A product that matters: a medical device for real clinics, built together with clinicians and lab staff.

  • Flexible hours and office days. We work from Berlin and meet in person regularly, up to several days a week. This isn't a fully remote role.

  • English is our working language. German isn't required.

  • We sponsor the EU Blue Card if you're moving to Berlin.

description:
TYTAN Technologies

The PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. We push boundaries, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who are driven by ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. If you're motivated by impact and thrive in dynamic environments, you'll fit right in.

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty.

We are looking for working students supporting the core of our product development: The design – development – testing – improvement loop.

You will have the chance to support data collection from our interceptors at testing sites, analyze the data post flight, present the data to key engineering stakeholders and derive improvement initiatives. In addition, you will be able to support continuous improvement of our data analytics toolchain and of our test database.

Your Roadmap to Make an Impact

Data analytics

  • Join our flight and ground testing teams and support data gathering in the field seeing TYTAN products in action

  • Analyze the collected data points using our analytics toolchain

  • Derive improvement initiatives that, e.g., support development of our onboard AI system

Analytics toolchain

  • Get to know and use the TYTAN toolchain for running data analytics and for training and improving our AI system

  • Support continuous improvement of the analytics toolchain, e.g., by developing scripts and improving visualization

Test database

  • Support maintenance of TYTAN’s database on flight testing data

  • Identify any needs for additional data collection and develop respective test points


  • 3rd year in Bachelor’s studies or 1st/2nd year in Master’s studies in Physics, Computer Science, or Mathematics

  • Experience in using PYTHON and tools for data analytics

  • Strong analytical capabilities – numbers and data-driven mindset

  • Fluency in both German and English is required

Why TYTAN?

  • Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defense systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security

  • Shape scalable defense capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale

  • Contribute to networked air defense: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defense architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors

  • Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback

  • Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact

  • Define a new generation of defense technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company

  • Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

  • Monthly allowances: €68/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit

  • Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us

  • Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team

  • Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together

  • Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands

  • Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process.

Please note that we currently do not offer visa sponsorship, so we’re only able to consider candidates who already have a valid work permit. All qualified applicants are hereby encouraged to apply.
