description:
Your mission

Join our Engineering team and own features from the problem to the shipped product, in a platform used by thousands of construction professionals.

  • Own problems end to end: Take a customer or business problem all the way to production. You shape the solution and its acceptance criteria, design the data model and services behind it, and ship it across backend, API, and front end.

  • Solve hard backend problems: Our domain is complex — tenders, bills of quantities, and millions of price data points. You design the data models, APIs, and services that handle it reliably and at scale.

  • Make product decisions: Decide how a solution should work for the user, down to the interface, which you build on our design system with little guidance.

  • Build our biggest bets: Partner with Product and Design on our most strategic initiatives, and own bringing them to life in the product.

  • Collaborate across teams: Work with Product, Design, and Data to translate business problems into shipped features.

  • Shape our codebase: Architect and implement modular packages and services in our monorepo.

Your profile

  • TypeScript, React, Node: Non-negotiable. You have significant professional experience building, shipping, and maintaining complex web applications. You're comfortable shipping across the whole stack.

  • End-to-end ownership: You've taken features from a loosely defined problem to real users, deciding scope and acceptance criteria yourself.

  • Backend engineering depth: You design data models, APIs, and services, and you care about performance, reliability, and maintainability.

  • UX taste: You care how your work feels to the user, and you make sound interface decisions without a detailed spec.

  • Product mindset: You're comfortable with ambiguity and focus on what makes the biggest difference for users.

  • Sharp problem solver: You look at a complex system, quickly identify what matters, and decide what to do next.

  • Bias for action: When you're unsure something will work, your instinct is to find out with data rather than keep wondering.

  • Excellent communication skills in English.

Bonus points for

  • Experience shipping AI-powered features (LLMs, agents) into a product.

  • Experience with our infrastructure stack (AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform) and with CI/CD pipelines.

How We Build: Our Engineering Culture

We believe in a calm, collaborative, and productive engineering environment. We trust our engineers and give them the autonomy to do their best work. Our approach includes:

  • Agile & Fast-Paced: We practice trunk-based development with daily releases to get value into our users' hands quickly.

  • Quality by Default: We maintain a comprehensive Cypress E2E test suite and enforce strict typing, linting, and formatting rules to keep our codebase clean and maintainable.

  • DevOps Mindset: Our well-oiled CI/CD pipeline deploys to AWS via Kubernetes, with our entire infrastructure managed as code using Terraform.

  • Collaboration & Transparency: We value open discussion, constructive code reviews, and a culture where the best idea wins, regardless of who it comes from.

Why us?

  • Competitive Compensation: A competitive salary above the market average.

  • Work-Life Balance: Choose to work 100% remotely or from our modern office in Berlin. We offer flexible working hours to fit your life.

  • Top-Notch Equipment: A new MacBook Pro to ensure you have the best tools for the job.

  • A Great Team: Regular company off-sites and team events that connect us as people, not just colleagues.

  • Job Security: A permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.

About us

Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology.

We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity.

Why Cosuno?

Artificial intelligence is the key to our solution: it analyzes millions of price data points and helps construction companies create precise and efficient bids. This not only saves our customers time but also helps them avoid unnecessary costs.

But for us, it's not just about technology – it's about the people who drive it. At Cosuno, you will work with creative minds who are reshaping the construction industry. We believe in diversity because we know that the best ideas come from different perspectives. An integrative and inclusive work environment is a matter of course for us.

Join us – Build the future of construction.

We’re looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help shape how data is modeled and governed at Airalo, transforming first- and third-party data into clean, trusted, well-documented datasets that power decisions across product, marketing, finance, and commercial teams, serving 30+ million users and growing. This role carries particular weight in our finance and revenue domain: you’ll steward the models finance relies on directly, including order-to-revenue flows and reconciliation against third-party systems such as our ERP, where precision and auditability matter as much as scalability.

Our analytics engineering function is still maturing, so you’ll have real ownership in establishing standards, defining our semantic layer, and shaping how data is structured as we scale globally, working closely with the rest of the data team to build a production-grade analytics platform on LightDash and beyond.


What You'll Do:

  • Design, implement, and maintain data models using dbt within our cloud data warehouse, ensuring performance, cost efficiency, and alignment with business logic

  • Build and maintain finance and revenue data models, including order-to-revenue flows, recognition logic, and reconciliation against source-of-truth financial systems, that finance and commercial teams can rely on for reporting and forecasting

  • Own the order-to-revenue pipeline: ensuring every order correctly and traceably resolves into recognized revenue, with clear handling of refunds, adjustments, currency conversion, and edge cases

  • Collaborate with other analytics engineers and data engineers to build and scale ELT workflows that ensure data freshness and reliability for mission-critical reporting

  • Partner with Finance and the ERP systems integrator to validate that data models and definitions carry over correctly from legacy systems into the new ERP/EPM platform

  • Implement robust testing, documentation, and monitoring practices, acting as a steward of data quality and governance across the platform, with particularly high attention to detail in domains where small errors compound (e.g., revenue, finance)

  • Collaborate cross-functionally  to translate complex business questions into scalable, production-ready data artifacts

  • Partner with the data analysts and domain leadership to drive the rollout and adoption of self-service analytics, ensuring business users can trust and independently explore the data models you build

  • Contribute to the evolution of our modern data stack, bringing curiosity and pragmatic judgment to new tools and approaches


    • Must Haves:

  • Bachelor's/Master's degree in a quantitative field (statistics, economics, mathematics, computer science, or equivalent work experience)

  • Hands-on experience building finance and/or revenue data models, ideally including order-to-revenue or billing-to-revenue pipelines, revenue recognition logic, or financial reconciliation (ERP, billing platforms or similar)

  • 5+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or analytics roles with significant modeling responsibilities

  • Strong SQL and data modeling skills, with demonstrated experience designing robust, scalable dimensional models

  • Exceptional attention to detail, especially when working with numbers that feed financial reporting, reconciliation, or external disclosure

  • Significant hands-on experience with dbt (Core or Cloud) for managing transformation logic, testing, and documentation

  • Familiarity with cloud data platforms (BigQuery) and data orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, or similar)

  • Experience working with modern BI platforms and semantic layers-LightDash experience is a strong plus

  • Track record of partnering with analysts and business stakeholders to translate requirements into well-structured data products

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex data concepts to diverse audiences

  • Experience building analytics engineering capabilities in low-maturity data environments

  • Previous experience at a scale-up that went through hypergrowth

    Our team is united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact.

    For many of our teammates in Spain, it's the combination of stability, flexibility, and genuine work-life balance that makes Airalo feel like home.

Staff Backend Engineer – Platform 

Join Apaleo and shape the future of hospitality tech 

Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure lets hoteliers customise their tech stack, automate routine work and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay. 

If you're driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human and powered by cutting-edge technology, we'd love to hear from you. 

 

About the role 

You'll join our Platform team as an individual contributor working closely with our Principal Engineer, who leads Platform's technical direction. Platform owns infrastructure, developer experience and security foundations for the whole engineering org, so this is a high-ownership seat: you'll take on large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives and drive them from first analysis through to completion, with real autonomy over how you get there. 

We don't run a groomed backlog or sprint planning. We assign a big topic to someone who owns it end to end. If you thrive with structure handed to you, this isn't the role; if you love spotting the problem worth solving and driving it yourself, you'll fit right in. 

 

What you'll be up to 

  • Architecting and developing scalable, reliable and maintainable backend systems. 
  • Self-identifying and scoping problems and initiatives, not just executing assigned tickets: assessing impact, prioritisation and timing independently. 
  • Leading architectural decisions and design discussions with cross-team alignment. 
  • Driving large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives end to end, including coordination with multiple stakeholders. 
  • Mentoring engineers and driving technical excellence. 
  • Building and maintaining internal tools and infrastructure (AWS, Terraform) that empower teams to deliver faster and more reliably. 
  • Owning observability, logging and operational excellence to keep the platform highly available. 
  • Participating in on-call rotations and stepping in as a reliable problem solver during incidents. 
  • Proactively spotting where AI and automation can drive technical improvement. 

 

Some of the challenges waiting for you 

  • Solving horizontal write-scaling for our database (we already scale reads horizontally). 
  • Modernising our CI/CD pipeline for faster, more reliable delivery. 
  • Migrating our infrastructure-as-code fully from CloudFormation to Terraform, including the ability to recreate an Apaleo environment from scratch. 
  • Extracting and reworking common services (like shared schedulers) to get us ready for our next scale level. 

 

What you'll bring to the team 

  • 8+ years of backend development experience, including several years in a staff-level or technical leadership role. 
  • Strong engineering fundamentals that transfer across languages and cloud platforms: we care more about how you think than which stack you've used. 
  • A track record of owning large technical initiatives from ambiguity through to completion, ideally on a platform or infrastructure team rather than a pure product team. 
  • Experience designing and scaling distributed systems in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred; strong Azure fundamentals with genuine enthusiasm for the switch work just as well). 
  • Comfortable working with containerised services and infrastructure-as-code (Docker, Terraform; CloudFormation exposure is relevant given our current stack). 
  • Confidence writing your own unit and integration tests: we don't have a dedicated QA function. 
  • Fluent English. 

Nice to have 

  • Direct experience with C# (.NET), PostgreSQL, AWS and ECS/Kubernetes: a great fit, though not a hard requirement if your fundamentals are strong. 
  • Experience setting up infrastructure-as-code from scratch and working with it day to day, ideally with Terraform, including migrating or consolidating from other IaC approaches (like CloudFormation). 
  • Experience with Kafka or other event-driven and streaming systems (Azure Service Bus experience is a good transferable equivalent). 
  • Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT, Amazon CodeWhisperer) and a genuine interest in AI-driven engineering improvement. 
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, particularly for introducing new technology, like AI tooling, to other teams. 

 

What we offer 

Culture and growth 

  • A diverse and international team: work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities. 
  • Growth and development: 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and an evolving career framework. 
  • Autonomy and ownership: we empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly in an environment built on trust and transparency. 
  • Shape the future of hospitality tech: your work drives real impact from day one, at a fast-growing scale-up. 
  • Competitive and fair compensation, guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. 

 

Perks and lifestyle 

  • Flexible and remote work options: office, home or hybrid, based on what works for your role and team. 
  • A fully covered Deutschland Ticket for free public transport across Germany. 
  • Regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties and other offsite events. 
  • 30 days of paid holiday to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired. 
  • An EGYM Wellpass membership giving access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options. 

 

Where you'll work from 

This role is based in Munich, with hybrid working from our office there. We're also open to remote within Germany, or remote via an Employer of Record for candidates based outside in the EU/ Europe.

 

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data will be handled with the utmost care and in compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.

Der Plan steht, jetzt fehlst du: Bring unsere Software von Legacy-PHP auf Symfony und React.

Auf einen Blick

  • Stack: PHP 8.1 (Legacy) → Symfony · jQuery/Vanilla-JS → React · MySQL/MariaDB, SingleStore · Git, CI/CD

  • Gehalt: 52.000–62.000 € brutto/Jahr, für außergewöhnliche Profile auch mehr · unbefristet, Vollzeit

  • Arbeitsmodell: hybrid, 3 Tage Büro / 2 Tage remote

  • Standort: Berlin-Zehlendorf, direkt am S-Bahnhof Zehlendorf (S1)

  • Produkt: Konsentas, ein Termin- und Vorgangsmanagement für Behörden

  • Start: so bald wie möglich oder nach Vereinbarung

Die Rolle

Unser Kernprodukt Konsentas ist über viele Jahre gewachsen, und das sieht man dem Code an. Das Backend läuft auf PHP 8.1 ohne Framework. Im Frontend stehen jQuery und Vanilla-JS neben React, und automatisierte Tests gibt es bisher wenige.

Wohin es gehen soll, ist klar: Das Backend wird schrittweise auf Symfony umgestellt, das Frontend auf React vereinheitlicht. Bis Ende 2027 soll die Migration abgeschlossen sein. Was dafür fehlt, ist kein Plan, sondern Kapazität.

Du triffst eigenständig technische Entscheidungen, bringst dich in Architektur- und Modernisierungsfragen ein und sorgst dafür, dass die Codequalität mit jedem Release besser wird. Dabei bleibt das Produkt im Einsatz: Wartung, Support und neue Features laufen parallel zur Modernisierung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Legacy-Module bei laufendem Betrieb schrittweise durch Symfony-Services und React-Oberflächen ersetzen

  • Fullstack-Features von der Datenbank bis zum Frontend entwickeln, teils auch als kundenspezifische Erweiterungen

  • Bestehenden Legacy-Code pflegen, debuggen und weiterentwickeln

  • Code-Reviews durchführen und die Testabdeckung ausbauen

  • Mit Entwicklungsleitung und Geschäftsführung abstimmen, welche Bereiche als Nächstes modernisiert werden

  • Unsere zwei Auszubildenden im letzten Ausbildungsabschnitt fachlich begleiten (ohne disziplinarische Führung)

  • Gelegentlich an Kundenterminen teilnehmen, etwa alle 3–4 Wochen

Nach 6 Monaten …

… setzt du Features eigenständig um, hast spürbar zur Modernisierung beigetragen, die Codequalität verbessert und bist für unsere Azubis eine feste Ansprechperson.

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung: etwa 4–5 Jahre in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung (ein Richtwert, keine harte Grenze)

  • PHP: fundierte Kenntnisse in modernem PHP 8.x mit objektorientierter Architektur, etwa Dependency Injection, Interfaces und SOLID

  • Symfony: nachweisbare Praxiserfahrung mit dem Framework

  • Legacy-Code: Du gehst sicher mit gewachsenen Codebasen um. Du refaktorierst, debuggst und entwickelst weiter, ohne alles neu zu schreiben.

  • JavaScript/React: solide Erfahrung im Frontend, jQuery schreckt dich nicht ab

  • Datenbanken: relationale Datenbanken wie MySQL/MariaDB oder SingleStore und sicherer Umgang mit SQL

  • Tooling: Git und Arbeit mit CI/CD

  • Sprache: Deutsch auf C1-Niveau, Englisch mindestens B1

  • Arbeitsweise: eigenständig, strukturiert, proaktiv und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch

  • Persönlich: Du kommunizierst verlässlich, arbeitest gern im Team, übernimmst Verantwortung, hast keine Angst vor schwierigen Codestellen und gibst dein Wissen gern weiter.

  • Abschluss: Ausbildung oder FH-Abschluss zählen bei uns genauso viel wie ein Uni-Studium. Entscheidend ist deine Praxiserfahrung.

Pluspunkte: REST/API-Design und Schnittstellenentwicklung, automatisiertes Testing (PHPUnit, Jest), Docker, Deployment-Pipelines und Cloud, Software-Architektur und Design

-

Patterns, produktiver Einsatz von KI-Tools wie Claude Code oder Codex. Erfahrung mit Software für den öffentlichen Sektor ist nicht nötig.

Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen: Daniel (Developer Lead), Nico (Geschäftsführer & Projektmanager), der selbst aktiv mitentwickelt, ein externer Entwickler und zwei Auszubildende. Ihr stimmt euch täglich ab. Daniel und Nico übernehmen dein Onboarding persönlich.

Seit über 25 Jahren entwickelt die Girona Softwareentwicklung GmbH in Berlin Software für die öffentliche Verwaltung. As a Defect Inspection Engineer/Expert, you will be responsible for ensuring the defect-free quality of semiconductor wafers using Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) systems and unpatterned wafer inspection.

You will detect defects such as particles, scratches, haze, and surface roughness that could impact the yield of our integrated graphene photonics process flow. Working in a cleanroom environment, you will collaborate with process, equipment and integration teams to set up, qualify and optimize inspection recipes, troubleshoot issues, and continuously improve defect detection and classification.

What You’ll Do

  • Perform AOI and unpatterned wafer inspection on materials such as bare silicon, epitaxial layers and polished wafers

  • Set up, qualify and optimize inspection recipes

  • Fine-tune inspection tool and recipe parameters to improve defect-detection sensitivity, inspection quality, repeatability and overall performance

  • Analyze defect data to identify trends, root causes and potential process excursions

  • Interpret defect data and translate findings into actionable insights for process teams

  • Generate defect maps, Pareto charts and reports to communicate findings

  • Participate in Design of Experiments (DOE) to optimize inspection parameters

  • Troubleshoot inspection-related issues and support continuous improvement in defect detection and classification

  • Collaborate with process, equipment and integration teams

What You Bring

  • A bachelor’s degree or above in electrical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field

  • 5+ years of experience in semiconductor inspection, with a focus on AOI and unpatterned wafer inspection

  • Hands-on experience with unpatterned wafer inspection systems, such as SPx, and AOI tools such as Eagle or Dragonfly

  • Understanding of semiconductor process flows, including polishing, epitaxy and cleaning

  • Familiarity with defect classification, SEM review and Statistical Process Control (SPC)

  • Proficiency in AOI and defect-review software, such as KLA Klarity and Camtek Inspecta

  • Ability to optimize inspection tools and recipe parameters for sensitivity, inspection quality and repeatability

  • Ability to interpret defect data and identify relevant trends and improvement opportunities

description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re looking for an Android Engineer to join our growing mobile team and build the Creative App (Android), bringing our audio AI to millions of users. You’ll ship features that integrate tightly with our AI-driven audio models, and work out where focused bets or incremental improvements will move the product most.

You’re impact-driven and autonomous, and good at drawing clear conclusions from experimental results. You’ll work closely with design, product and research, and help shape the app’s architecture and technical direction.

Requirements

  • Strong native Android development (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose) with a track record of shipping features that improved engagement

  • Have designed and run A/B tests, using data to decide what to build next

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and fast-changing priorities, and able to add structure where it’s needed

  • Experience owning performance, quality and responsiveness in a production app

Bonus

  • Experience with audio playback or streaming on Android

  • Experience building mobile infrastructure for build, test and release pipelines

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere, with the ability to operate in GMT to GMT+4 timezones preferred. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, Warsaw, Dublin, Amsterdam and Paris.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

description:
About the role

Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our Agent team.

We are building a platform for creating, publishing, and executing AI-powered agents that help teams automate complex workflows in financial services. The Agents team owns the agent execution runtime, tool orchestration, and platform infrastructure that makes this possible, including the conversational copilot experiences built on top of it across the product.

We are hiring a Full-Stack Engineer to help build and ship production features across this entire stack, from the agent runtime and tool orchestration layer in the backend, to the conversational copilot experiences users interact with every day. You'll work alongside experienced engineers, contribute to real product impact from day one, and grow your skills in a fast-moving, high-ownership environment.

What You'll Do

  • Build and ship features end-to-end for Taktile's AI agent platform: backend in Python (FastAPI) on AWS serverless infrastructure, and frontend in React and TypeScript.

  • Build conversational copilot experiences end to end: chat UI components, streaming responses, rich in-chat interactions, and human-in-the-loop approvals.

  • Improve how agents run, how they connect to external tools, and how they behave when something goes wrong.

  • Own your work end-to-end: collaborate on scope, implement, test, release, and iterate based on real usage and customer feedback.

  • Use leading-edge AI tools (e.g. Claude) on a daily basis to move faster, improve quality, and build AI-native capabilities where it makes sense.

  • Review pull requests with depth, improve test coverage and CI/CD, and raise the bar on reliability and engineering excellence.

  • Engage actively in team rituals such as daily syncs, planning sessions, demos, and technical deep-dive discussions.

  • Grow as an individual and accelerate your career by learning from experienced team members, contributing to a foundational layer of the product, and joining cross-team learning groups.

  • For career growth at Taktile, this role will involve daytime ops duty and at some point joining an on-call rotation, so you need to have passion for owning systems end to end and grow your DevSecOps skills as well.

Team's tech stack

  • Backend: Python (FastAPI, Pydantic)

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript

  • Data: DynamoDB, Postgres

  • Cloud: AWS serverless (Lambda, API Gateway)

  • AI: LLM orchestration, tool-use frameworks, streaming execution

Requirements

  • Strong engineering fundamentals with a passion for simplicity and precision.

  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken, is essential as we operate in an hybrid environment requiring clear and effective communication. Strong English skills are also crucial to efficiently interacting with AI.

  • Prior industry experience building full-stack web applications (this is not an entry-level position).

  • Proficiency with React and TypeScript, and experience building rich, interactive user interfaces.

  • Experience with Python back-end development, building and operating RESTful APIs, and working with databases.

  • Experience integrating into AWS or similar cloud providers.

Nice but not required

  • Experience building chat or conversational UIs, real-time/streaming interfaces, or data visualization.

  • FastAPI and Pydantic experience.

  • DynamoDB or Postgres, SQLAlchemy.

  • Exposure to LLM application development, agent frameworks, MCP, or building developer tools.

  • Prior ops or on-call experience.

  • Experience with distributed systems, async task processing, or observability tooling (tracing, metrics, logging).

Our Offer

  • Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here.

  • Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo.

  • Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe.

  • Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package.

  • Get access to a self-development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books or take classes.

  • Receive a new Apple MacBook Pro, as well as meaningful home office set-up.

 

Our Stance

  • We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply.

  • We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears.

 

About Us

Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents.

With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions—approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, stopping fraud before it spreads, and financing every business worth funding.

Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Mercury, Monzo, Faire, and Pleo.

With offices in New York, Berlin, London, São Paulo, and Iași, the company has raised $184M from Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital, and Y Combinator. Learn more at taktile.com.

Depending on the location of this role, your employment or engagement will be with Taktile LLC (US), Taktile GmbH (Germany), Taktile Ltd (UK), or Taktile SRL (Romania). description:
About Peec AI

Peec AI is the analytics platform for AI search. People increasingly discover products and make buying decisions through ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews instead of traditional search, and most brands have no idea where they show up in those answers. Peec gives marketing, SEO, and growth teams the data to see exactly that: how visible their brand is across AI platforms, how they compare to competitors, and where to win.

We are defining this category, and the market is moving with us. Peec is a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, that went from $0 to $15M ARR in 18 months, with a 100+ person team across our Berlin HQ and our New York office.

About the role

Peec AI is building the data plane for AI visibility: millions of chats, scrapes, citations, sources, model responses, and customer-facing insights running through a fast-moving backend.

This role is for an engineer who wants to own the systems behind that. You will not just add endpoints or close tickets. You will make our scraping, chat-processing, source-ingestion, and analytics infrastructure more reliable, cheaper, faster, and easier for the rest of the team to reason about.

The best fit looks like someone who can debug a provider outage in the morning, design a better queueing model before lunch, ship a TypeScript service change in the afternoon, and write the postmortem or follow-up ticket clearly enough that the next engineer immediately knows what to do.

We are especially interested in people who have built or operated systems with real constraints: rate limits, flaky third-party APIs, queues, webhooks, retries, distributed locks, data migrations, observability gaps, customer pressure, and cost ceilings.

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of backend, platform, infrastructure, or distributed systems engineering experience in a production environment.

  • Deep hands-on TypeScript experience. We run TypeScript services on Bun, and we care about people who can design clean, reliable backend systems rather than only write application code.

  • Strong understanding of queues, workers, retries, rate limits, idempotency, distributed locks, webhooks, and failure handling.

  • Experience operating systems under real production pressure: incidents, provider outages, customer escalations, noisy alerts, slow dependencies, and incomplete data.

  • Comfort with cloud-native infrastructure. Our stack includes GCP, Kubernetes, Cloud Tasks, Pub/Sub, RabbitMQ, Redis, Postgres, Firestore, ClickHouse, Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry.

  • Ability to debug across layers: application code, logs, metrics, queues, provider APIs, databases, network behaviour, and deployment state.

  • Product-minded judgement. You can separate internal detail from customer-safe explanation, and you understand when a “small infra change” has customer, security, or cost implications.

  • High ownership and low ego. We want people who take responsibility for ambiguous systems, ask sharp questions, and make the team better through clear thinking and kindness.

  • A bias toward durable fixes. You do not stop at “restart the pod” if the real issue is retry amplification, missing backpressure, an unsafe parser assumption, or a provider limit we do not model.

Tech stack

  • Languages: TypeScript, Python

  • Runtime/frameworks: Bun, Elysia, Node-compatible services

  • Cloud/infrastructure: GCP, Kubernetes, Cloud Tasks, Pub/Sub, Firebase/Firestore, Postgres, ClickHouse, Redis, RabbitMQ

  • Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, structured logging

  • Product/data domain: LLM chats, AI search, source scraping, citation extraction, provider integrations, customer-facing analytics

  • AI/model providers: OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Mode / AI Overview, plus scraping/provider APIs around them

What we offer

  • Exciting and challenging work with real impact and ownership at one of Europe’s fastest-growing Series A startups

  • Regular team events and off-sites

  • Aggressive equity compensation package

  • Paid Dinner & Uber home when working late

  • The most beautiful office space and work environment in Berlin

Compensation: €100K – €150K • Offers Equity

About Tensordyne 

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!

About the role

Tensordyne builds high-performance, power-efficient inference hardware, backed by our novel AI math approach.

You will work within a team working on the inference backend software. Your focus will be on a part of a software stack of a future Tensordyne product.

In this role, you will

  • Design and develop distributed cloud services in Rust
  • Maintain Rust software developed in-house, as well as work with external frameworks 
  • Build APIs for generative AI
  • Collaborate across different teams to derive design specifications and decisions
  • Orchestrate agent teams to implement features

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with modern Rust

About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

About the role

Andercore runs global trade end to end, from sourcing and pricing to sales, logistics and financing, and AI agents do a growing share of that work. Order values are high and prices and stock change daily, so the systems underneath have to be fast, correct and reliable at all times.

As a Staff Engineer, you own our hardest technical problems and set the architecture across teams. You focus on what a fast-growing trading business cannot afford to get wrong: speed, reliability, security and observability. You report to our VP Engineering and work closely with our Senior Product Engineers, QA and product managers. You stay hands-on: you write code, review designs and raise the bar for everyone around you

Tech stack

Java 21 and Spring Boot 3, Python, LangGraph and LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), PostgreSQL, Kinesis, AWS with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and TypeScript with Node.js, Next.js and React. Including Salesforce, which we are moving our transaction core out of.

 

What you will do

  • Set the technical direction across teams: define the target architecture, write the RFCs behind big decisions, and make sure teams build towards the same picture.

  • Lead the hardest technical work yourself, from design to production, instead of only advising on it.

  • Shape the carve-out of our transaction core from Salesforce into a modern, modular core system, with a migration path that never disrupts daily trading.

  • Make reliability, security and observability part of how we build: monitoring, alerting, incident response and postmortems that lead to real changes.

  • Design how our AI agents act safely on money-touching paths, with evaluations, guardrails, audit trails and human review where it matters.

  • Set standards for correctness and data integrity, including idempotency, validation and testing, together with QA.

  • Mentor engineers through design reviews, pairing and direct feedback, and help us hire by defining what great engineering looks like at Andercore.

 

In your first six months, you might

  • Design the architecture of our pricing engine so it scales with a growing assortment and more markets, and serves correct prices to sales, and later directly to customers, in milliseconds.

  • Lay out the target architecture and first steps for moving our transaction core off Salesforce.

  • Build the observability and incident setup that lets us catch problems before customers or colleagues notice them

     

What you bring

  • At least 8 years of experience building and running software in production, including systems where errors cost real money.

  • Deep backend expertise at production scale in Java or a comparable language such as Kotlin, C# or Go, and willingness to work in Java and Spring Boot.

  • A track record of setting architecture across several teams, through influence rather than a management title.

  • Experience designing transactional, distributed and event-driven systems, with a strong focus on correctness, failure modes and performance.

  • Hands-on depth in reliability, security and observability, and experience leading incidents and postmortems.

  • Experience in a fast-growing company, and a track record of solving business problems, not only technical ones.

  • AI is part of your daily work. Experience building or evaluating AI agents in production is a strong plus.

  • Experience with re-platforming or carving out systems from a platform like Salesforce or an ERP is a plus

 

Practical details

  • Location: Berlin, hybrid

  • Working language: English

  • A learning budget for your development

  • Start date: As soon as possible

description:
About Prefiro

Asparagus cost up to 25 euros per kilo this season! That’s because, like most of the produce on the shelf, it’s harvested exclusively by hand. Here at Prefiro, we’re the first to automate these processes! We use artificial intelligence, and robotics to bring next-generation agricultural equipment to the field.

Are you excited about applying new technologies in real-world conditions, solving interesting and varied problems, and seeing firsthand the impact your ideas have?

Then join our growing team and help us deliver the first autonomous asparagus harvester to farms.

Your responsibilities

  • Integrate robots and IO into the robotics stack – from startup and service to error handling and recovery.

  • Work on MPC-based trajectory planning and optimal control: from approach to implementation on the robot in real time.

  • Help optimize cycle times in real-world applications

  • Scale the stack from one robot module to several per machine: networking, robot setup and calibration.

  • Tune the robot computers for real-time control: Docker, CPU pinning, ROS 2 scheduling and multithreading.

  • Build remote access, data collection and robotics CI/CD (e.g. rosbag-playback tests) to improve the robots with real field data.

  • Review code, contribute to architecture decisions and debug the stack as a team.

  • Run the robots during pre-season field tests and the harvest season.

What you bring

  • Master's Degree in robotics, mechatronics, mechanical engineering, computer science, or a related technical field.

  • At least 2 years of professional experience in robotics, including hands-on work with real robots (not only simulation).

  • Strong modern C++ (C++17) and Python 3.

  • Hands-on experience with ROS 2 (ideally Jazzy): nodes, lifecycle nodes, executors, QoS, launch files.

  • Experience with trajectory controllers and trajectory planning.

  • Solid grounding in robot kinematics and dynamics (URDF, Pinocchio or similar).

  • Proven experience with optimal control and model predictive control for trajectory planning; reinforcement learning is a plus.

  • Comfortable with CMake/colcon builds and Git on Linux.

  • Experience with real-time robot control and an understanding of soft real-time constraints on Linux (scheduling, latency, threading).

  • Fluent English, our working language.

Nice to have

  • Industrial arms, especially Denso SCARA (b-CAP, RC8) or Universal Robots.

  • Optimal-control frameworks such as acados or CasADi; control barrier functions.

  • MoveIt 2 or Ruckig for motion planning.

  • Docker, GitLab CI and automated testing (GoogleTest, launch_testing).

  • DDS or Zenoh tuning and multi-robot setups.

  • Debugging tools such as RViz, Foxglove, PlotJuggler or Nsight Systems.

  • Field deployment with systemd, tmux and shell scripting.

  • Basic German.

What we offer

  • Real fields from your first season. Your code runs on our machines on farms in Germany.

  • Short way from code to robot. New ideas usually run on the real machine within a few days.

  • A problem worth solving. Green asparagus is still harvested entirely by hand.

  • A small, motivated team that gets a lot done together. When you join, we're 8 full-time, plus 2 interns and a working student.

  • Open culture, flat hierarchies. We are still early, so your opinion counts in technical decisions.

  • Lunch and coffee together in the kitchen in our hall.

  • Employee stock options.

How to apply

Send your CV and a few lines on a robotics project you built on real hardware (links to code welcome) via the "Apply now" button. Please include your earliest start date, salary expectations and vegetable you want to automate next.

About GeneralMind

GeneralMind builds AI Systems of Action for complex enterprise workflows. We deploy AI employees that automate messy operational handovers across supply chains - processing orders, validating invoices, coordinating suppliers, and handling exceptions directly on top of enterprise systems like SAP, Oracle, JDE, and Dynamics.

Our platform combines AI agents, operational context graphs, and real transaction data to achieve Autopilot-grade automation in real operational environments.

We work closely with leading global companies across manufacturing, retail, and logistics to deploy AI into mission-critical workflows.

About the role

As a Value Engineer at GeneralMind, the customer is yours from the first pitch onwards - through the close, the rollout, and everything that follows. You work at the core of our go-to-market, side by side with the founders, marketing, product, and sales ops, refining how we sell and keeping the pace high.

You join a small, ambitious team and help define how we win customers and grow them across international markets. Whether you come from a generalist background or have years of selling behind you matters less than this: you pick things up quickly, you are comfortable with complex problems, and you can explain value in plain terms.

The job sits where AI, SaaS, and operational excellence (supply chain, for example) meet. You will use AI tools in your daily work and get noticeably better at your job because of it.

What You'll Do

  • Take ownership of the customer after the first pitch and carry the relationship through close, integration, and later expansion.

  • Build lasting relationships with C-level executives and their teams inside large, complex enterprises.

  • Lead customers through deep dives and product Go-Lives, then keep the relationship growing over time.

  • Develop a thorough understanding of what our customers struggle with, particularly in operational areas such as supply chain.

  • Work closely with product engineers and founders, bringing what you hear in the market back into messaging, strategy, and roadmap.

  • Keep the pipeline clean and the forecast accurate in our CRM.

  • Help shape our product and go-to-market strategy, and keep testing, learning, and improving how you work.

What we are looking for

  • 3-8 years of professional experience in a demanding setting: top-tier management consulting, venture capital or growth equity, a fast-moving high-growth startup, or B2B SaaS / enterprise software sales.

  • Driven and quick to learn, with an appetite for complexity. You want to build rather than just execute, and you take responsibility early.

  • Able to grasp complex products and business processes fast and explain their value clearly to buyers without a technical background.

  • A structured, analytical, and highly proactive way of working.

  • Someone who gets their hands dirty. Nobody here is above any task, and that is a big part of why we move fast.

  • Real curiosity about AI tools and the willingness to make them part of how you work. Excited to help define what modern, AI-driven go-to-market looks like.

  • Keen to become a top commercial operator, whether or not you have a classic sales background.

  • Strong academic record. A well-regarded university is a plus.

  • Excellent communication skills in German and English. Additional languages are a plus.

Become a Part of ACCURIDS

Join us and help shape the future of pharmaceutical data!
At Accurids, we're building the data backbone behind life-science innovation. Our system identifies, links and standardizes critical enterprise data in compliance with global standards such as ISO IDMP. We help global life-science companies launch products faster, more safely and with better patient outcomes.
At Accurids, you'll join a collaborative, growth-driven environment where your work makes a real impact from day one.
As a member of our Product Development team, you will work with a high degree of autonomy while collaborating closely with backend and frontend engineers, QA, DevOps and product owners. You will work directly with cross-functional engineering stakeholders, and the features and fixes you deliver reach our customers. Our CTO is directly available to you as a mentor and technical sparring partner.

How you’ll make an impact:

  • Own features end-to-end, backend first: Design and build services, APIs (GraphQL and REST) and the data layer in modern Java and Spring Boot, then take the feature all the way into our React/TypeScript frontend. AI agents write most of the UI code, so your eye for good interfaces is what makes the difference.
  • Extend the platform: Build integrations with the systems our pharma customers rely on and extend the platform for customer-specific needs.
  • Bring AI into the product: Work on AI features inside the platform, from integrations with AI assistants to LLM-powered capabilities.
  • Amplify velocity with AI: Be part of our AI-native engineering culture. You use tools like Cursor, Claude or Gemini to speed up scaffolding, refactoring and test writing, while keeping architectural integrity, security and quality in view. As agents take on more of the routine coding, your role moves up a level. You direct them, help shape the architecture and own the quality of what ships.
  • Contribute to the architecture, hands-on: Help develop our modular architecture (Spring Modulith, platform and feature modules), optimize PostgreSQL and Elasticsearch queries and work with RDF semantic data structures.
  • Raise the bar on quality: Maintain solid test coverage (JUnit, Testcontainers, Playwright) and give thoughtful merge request reviews, including on AI-generated code.

What helps you succeed:

  • Backend experience: 3+ years building backend services in production. Solid knowledge of modern Java (21+) and Spring Boot (Spring Security, Spring Data JPA), PostgreSQL with Flyway and API design with REST and GraphQL. A Computer Science degree, Fachinformatiker training or strong hands-on experience as a career changer are all welcome.
  • Eye for good UI: You have a feel for good UI principles and are happy to own the frontend part of a feature. Experience with React and TypeScript is a plus.
  • Architectural thinking: You think in modules, boundaries and trade-offs, and you enjoy building what you design.
  • AI-native mindset: AI tools like Cursor, Claude and Gemini are part of your daily workflow. You treat AI as an output amplifier and combine curiosity with sound judgment about what ships.
  • Quality & delivery: Experience with testing at all levels (unit, integration, E2E) and GitLab CI/CD.
  • Location & work permit: You are based in Germany within a reasonable commuting distance to our Cologne office (NRW) and hold a valid German work permit.
  • Languages: Business-fluent English is required, and German skills are a strong plus.
  • Bonus: DevOps experience (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS), semantic web (RDF, SPARQL, Apache Jena), Elasticsearch, LLM or MCP integration, Material UI, or pharma/life-sciences domains (FHIR, IDMP).

Why you’ll love working here:

  • Grow your expertise: Deepen your specialization in semantic data platforms, AI features or platform architecture as we scale.
  • Epic Office & Hybrid Work: Work from our brand-new office in the KölnTurm, featuring breathtaking views over the city (even higher than the view from the Cologne Cathedral!). Enjoy flexible hybrid options. (Note: On-site presence in Cologne/NRW is required, and fully remote work is not offered.)
  • Community & Industry Events: Connect and grow your network through exclusive industry events hosted regularly right in our scenic office space.
  • Competitive Compensation: Fixed salary package of €60,000 to €100,000 per year, depending on experience, for a full-time, permanent position.
  • Work-Life Balance & Perks: 30 days of paid vacation, a personal learning budget, hardware of your choice (Mac, Linux, Windows), and your choice between a subsidized Urban Sports Club membership or a €50/month City Plus Card.
  • Empowered Culture: High trust, flat hierarchies and an environment where your decisions directly shape the product.

Not ticking every box?

We encourage you to apply anyway! We know great talent doesn't always follow a checklist, and we care more about your potential, curiosity and motivation to learn.
At Accurids, we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially encourage women and people from underrepresented backgrounds in tech, science and data to apply.

description:
About pplwise
pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics.

About our client: Filics
Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Senior Electrical Engineer (m/f/d) at Filics, you will design the electronics at the core of the next generation of robots.

About the role
This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly.

Filics doesn’t just use off-the-shelf components. It builds its own custom IP. The robots run on advanced boards that cover a wide range of electrical engineering. On one end is high power, such as battery and motor controllers. On the other end are high-speed interfaces like PCIe, USB and MIPI CSI. The real challenge is making all these subsystems work together as one system. Many of these problems have no textbook solution. Solving them takes solid experience, a deep understanding of the physics and a creative mind.

The EE team is small, and the robot is far from finished. You’ll own your boards end to end: requirements, system design, schematic, layout, design review, sourcing, manufacturing, testing and validation. You’ll keep owning them for as long as they’re in production. You’ll work closely with Embedded Software, Mechanical Engineering, Software and the Production team. As Filics moves from prototypes to series production, your designs need to work reliably at scale, not just in the lab.

What you’ll do

  • Take full ownership of a complex PCB project and get it running in as few revisions as possible

  • Design high-power and high-speed circuits and make sure they work together at system level

  • Design for EMC, manufacturability and testability, and take boards through EMC testing and certification

  • Bring new technical approaches to the team, for example a new converter architecture that enables higher charging power in a smaller package

  • Introduce useful processes from your experience, such as simulation workflows that validate a layout before it goes to production

  • Help with board bring-up and debugging together with Embedded Software, and support Production with clear documentation and training

  • Take over ownership of existing boards so the team shares responsibility

About you

  • Several years designing electronics in an R&D environment at a smaller hardware company driven by innovation (e.g. robotics, e-mobility, aviation, autonomous vehicles, motion control)

  • A proven record of taking PCBs within a larger system from requirements to a validated product

  • Strong skills in schematic design and PCB layout (Altium, KiCad, OrCAD or similar)

  • Hands-on debugging experience with an oscilloscope, logic analyzer, VNA or spectrum analyzer, plus soldering

  • Experience with designs that went through EMC testing or CE certification

  • An innovator’s mindset: you have built something new or significantly improved an existing concept

  • Basic simulation know-how (e.g. LTspice, ANSYS, thermal/EM/tolerance analysis); deeper experience is a strong plus

  • Basic experience with Linux and embedded software

  • You work independently, take ownership and thrive without rigid structures

What Filics offers

  • Real ownership of your designs, from first draft to series production

  • Space to innovate and a wide range of technical challenges, from power electronics to high-speed design

  • A small, high-caliber team with close collaboration across disciplines

  • Fast growth: one year at Filics teaches you what usually takes many years at a large company

  • An on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to Engineering and Assembly

Sound like you? Apply with your CV.

description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

     

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

     

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

     

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

     

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

 

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

description:
Why this role is exciting

Rohlik is the leading Central European e-grocer. More than a million customers buy their groceries from us through Rohlik.cz, Knuspr.de, Kifli.hu, Gurkerl.at and Sezamo.ro, choosing from over 17,000 items, delivered within a couple of hours in 15-minute windows.

We are building the autonomous grocer. Maia, our AI assistant, already talks to customers and builds their orders; agents are moving into our buying and logistics; vision models are learning to watch quality. The next frontier is physical: robots taking over more and more of the work in our fulfilment centres, until fresh food moves from producers to households at a cost nobody else can match.

We are setting out to record how our own people handle groceries and to turn those recordings into a training corpus for manipulation policies. Our warehouses already log what happened on every pick and every quality check, so the recordings can carry labels most datasets never get. Making that hold is part of the job.

You decide what makes an hour of footage trainable — before we bank hundreds of them.

What you will own and deliver

  • The capture spec. Cameras, mounts, calibration, and what disqualifies an episode. You write it before we buy the fleet and enforce it after. When the spec and the floor disagree, you go to the floor and find out which one is wrong.

  • Ground truth. Hand pose is the signal that transfers from human video to robot policies, and warehouse reality — work gloves, occlusion, cold halls — is exactly where the published models struggle. You own how we measure that and how we close the gap.

  • The evaluation harness. The corpus only counts if a policy can train on it. You build the harness that decides which hours make the bank, and you hold the trainability bar as the volume grows.

  • The first training runs. Once hours bank, you post-train open robot-learning models on our data and run the first task evaluations.

  • Judgment before spend. The field moves monthly. You read what is published, reproduce the claims we depend on, and steer our capture before the money is spent, not after.

The scope

This is a seat on a small, newly created team: an operations lead who runs capture on the floor, a data engineer who owns the pipeline, and you: the machine-learning voice in the room. This is not a research-scientist role, and no publication record is required. The job is to make a corpus trainable and to train the first policies on it.

What we are looking for

  • PyTorch, and computer vision with real 3D geometry. Camera calibration, pose estimation, SLAM fundamentals. You have debugged an extrinsic calibration at least once in your life and know why it drifted.

  • You can read a paper and reproduce it. Our pipeline is assembled from published work, and your job is knowing which claims survive contact with a chilled warehouse hall.

  • You know what policies train on. Familiar with the current robot-learning stack and policy classes well enough to know what the training side will demand of the data before the data exists.

  • Dataset instincts. You have trained on data you collected yourself, and you know the failure modes that only show up at training tim..

  • Comfortable as the only ML voice. You make the call, write it down, and revisit it when the pilot data says otherwise.

  • AI is how work gets done here. Our engineers use Claude Code and Devin daily, and we expect you to direct agents for the unglamorous parts — harness code, data plumbing, reproduction scripts — while keeping the quality bar exactly where it was.

  • Particularly relevant. Hand-pose estimation or egocentric video in production; multi-camera rigs and time sync; experience post-training robot-learning models; ROS 2.

What success looks like in 90 days

You have written the capture spec and we set up the first rigs against it. Your pilot gates have numbers, the first hours have passed your harness, and you can tell the people who sign the budget, with data, what the next hundred hours should look like.

Are we a good fit?

Take this role if you would rather own the spec that decides whether a dataset becomes an asset or a write-off than tune someone else's model on someone else's data, if a fulfilment centre at 6 a.m. sounds like a lab to you, and if you want the shortest possible line between your technical judgment and a capital decision. Read our culture code and are we a good fit?.

What we offer

  • The physical-AI side of the autonomous grocer, with the capture spec and the first training runs yours from day one

  • A data asset few teams in the world get to build, in fresh groceries, a domain as hard as manipulation gets

  • Off-the-shelf hardware, a managed cloud estate, and a mandate that has already started

  • Benefits — see what we offer

Are you in?

Instead of a cover letter: pick a published human-video-to-robot-policy pipeline you rate, and tell us where it breaks on a warehouse floor where every hand wears a work glove.

description:
Why this role is exciting

Rohlik is the leading Central European e-grocer. More than a million customers buy their groceries from us through Rohlik.cz, Knuspr.de, Kifli.hu, Gurkerl.at and Sezamo.ro, choosing from over 17,000 items, delivered within a couple of hours in 15-minute windows.

We are building the autonomous grocer. Maia, our AI assistant, already talks to customers and builds their orders; agents are moving into our buying and logistics; vision models are learning to watch quality. The next frontier is physical: robots taking over more and more of the work in our fulfilment centres, until fresh food moves from producers to households at a cost nobody else can match.

We are setting out to record how our own people handle groceries and to turn those recordings into a training corpus for manipulation policies. Our warehouses already log what happened on every pick and every quality check, so the recordings can carry labels most datasets never get. Making that hold is part of the job.

You decide what makes an hour of footage trainable — before we bank hundreds of them.

What you will own and deliver

  • The capture spec. Cameras, mounts, calibration, and what disqualifies an episode. You write it before we buy the fleet and enforce it after. When the spec and the floor disagree, you go to the floor and find out which one is wrong.

  • Ground truth. Hand pose is the signal that transfers from human video to robot policies, and warehouse reality — work gloves, occlusion, cold halls — is exactly where the published models struggle. You own how we measure that and how we close the gap.

  • The evaluation harness. The corpus only counts if a policy can train on it. You build the harness that decides which hours make the bank, and you hold the trainability bar as the volume grows.

  • The first training runs. Once hours bank, you post-train open robot-learning models on our data and run the first task evaluations.

  • Judgment before spend. The field moves monthly. You read what is published, reproduce the claims we depend on, and steer our capture before the money is spent, not after.

The scope

This is a seat on a small, newly created team: an operations lead who runs capture on the floor, a data engineer who owns the pipeline, and you: the machine-learning voice in the room. This is not a research-scientist role, and no publication record is required. The job is to make a corpus trainable and to train the first policies on it.

What we are looking for

  • PyTorch, and computer vision with real 3D geometry. Camera calibration, pose estimation, SLAM fundamentals. You have debugged an extrinsic calibration at least once in your life and know why it drifted.

  • You can read a paper and reproduce it. Our pipeline is assembled from published work, and your job is knowing which claims survive contact with a chilled warehouse hall.

  • You know what policies train on. Familiar with the current robot-learning stack and policy classes well enough to know what the training side will demand of the data before the data exists.

  • Dataset instincts. You have trained on data you collected yourself, and you know the failure modes that only show up at training tim..

  • Comfortable as the only ML voice. You make the call, write it down, and revisit it when the pilot data says otherwise.

  • AI is how work gets done here. Our engineers use Claude Code and Devin daily, and we expect you to direct agents for the unglamorous parts — harness code, data plumbing, reproduction scripts — while keeping the quality bar exactly where it was.

  • Particularly relevant. Hand-pose estimation or egocentric video in production; multi-camera rigs and time sync; experience post-training robot-learning models; ROS 2.

What success looks like in 90 days

You have written the capture spec and we set up the first rigs against it. Your pilot gates have numbers, the first hours have passed your harness, and you can tell the people who sign the budget, with data, what the next hundred hours should look like.

Are we a good fit?

Take this role if you would rather own the spec that decides whether a dataset becomes an asset or a write-off than tune someone else's model on someone else's data, if a fulfilment centre at 6 a.m. sounds like a lab to you, and if you want the shortest possible line between your technical judgment and a capital decision. Read our culture code and are we a good fit?.

What we offer

  • The physical-AI side of the autonomous grocer, with the capture spec and the first training runs yours from day one

  • A data asset few teams in the world get to build, in fresh groceries, a domain as hard as manipulation gets

  • Off-the-shelf hardware, a managed cloud estate, and a mandate that has already started

  • Benefits — see what we offer

Are you in?

Instead of a cover letter: pick a published human-video-to-robot-policy pipeline you rate, and tell us where it breaks on a warehouse floor where every hand wears a work glove.

  • Du hast Freude daran, weniger erfahrene Entwickler:innen zu unterstützen und weiterzuentwickeln

  • Wir stellen unsere Ambitionen über unser Ego. Wir sind ein junges, sehr ambitioniertes Team – deine Ambitionen sollten stärker sein als dein Ego

Wünschenswert: Erfahrung mit der Composition API sowie Kenntnisse in der Backend-Integration mit Node.js

Ein paar Worte zum Schluss

Bei uns hast du die Möglichkeit, vom ersten Tag an Verantwortung zu übernehmen: Gestalte innovative Lösungen und bring deine Expertise in die Entwicklung eines wegweisenden KI-Produkts ein.

Klingt spannend? Dann werde jetzt Teil unseres Teams und sende uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf. Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören!

Bitte beachte, dass wir für diese Position ausschließlich Kandidat:innen suchen, die sich in Deutschland befinden.

Lass uns gemeinsam etwas Großes aufbauen! 🚀
