Du kannst Beziehungen zu börsennotierten AGs aufbauen, denn alle Unternehmen ab SDAX aufwärts gehören zur Kernzielgruppe (und teils schon bestehenden Nutzerbasis) unseres Mandanten.

In dieser Rolle übernimmst du innerhalb des Sales- & Marketing-Teams die Verantwortung für die Neukundenakquise, die Weiterentwicklung bestehender Accounts sowie den Ausbau strategischer Partnerschaften.

Du bist Software Sales Manager und Marktgestalter:in in einem und trägst entscheidend dazu bei, die Nutzung einer führenden Corporate Reporting SaaS-Plattform im DACH-Markt und perspektivisch im europäischen Raum weiter auszubauen.

Diese kollaborative Content- & Design-Plattform wird u.a. genutzt für die Erstellung von Finanzberichten für Investoren und Analysten, z.B. von börsennotierten AGs, oder ESG Reports berichtspflichtiger Unternehmen (u.v.m.).

Du arbeitest eng mit dem Team in Frankfurt/Main sowie mit Kolleg:innen in der Schweiz aus Marketing, Produktmanagement, Consulting und Partnernetzwerk zusammen. Gleichzeitig bist du nah an Kunden dran und mit diesen im engen Austausch.

Für wen ist dieser Job?

Dieser Job ist ideal für dich, wenn du mind. 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich B2B Software-Sales / SaaS hast. Relevant ist in dem Kontext, dass du Software-Lösungen sicher & routiniert demonstrieren kannst.

Aufgaben

1) Sales & New Business (ca. 60% unterjährig)

  • Aktive Akquise neuer Kunden in Deutschland, der Schweiz, Österreich und perspektivisch in weiteren europäischen Märkten.

  • Aufbau und Pflege eigener Leadlisten sowie aktive Recherchen in relevanten Branchen & Zielkontakten.

  • Steuerung des gesamten Sales-Cycles: Qualifizierung, Bedarfsanalyse, Software-Demos, Angebotsentwicklung, Verträge, Übergabe in Delivery.

  • Begleitung neuer Kunden bei Kick-offs, internen Debriefings und frühen Projektphasen – du sorgst für einen perfekten Start.

  • Laufende Betreuung und Ausbau des eigenen Kundenportfolios, inkl. Up- und Cross-Selling (z. B. Plattformwechsel, Add-on-Module, Services).

  • Zusammenarbeit mit zertifizierten Partnern & Agenturen, um Markttrends und Kundenbedürfnisse aus erster Hand zu verstehen.

  • Reporting, Forecasting und Pflege aller Kundendaten.

2) Business Development & Market Shaping (ca. 40% unterjährig)

  • Durchführung von Markt- und Wettbewerbsanalysen (SaaS, Reporting, Corporate Publishing).

  • Entwicklung neuer Marktstrategien, Segmentfokusse und Wachstumsinitiativen – insbesondere für Deutschland & Nordics.

  • Identifikation neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten: Standalone-Lösungen, Modulpotenziale, Produktideen aus Marktfeedback.

  • Aufbau von strategischen Partnerschaften (z. B Reseller, Agenturverbünde).

  • Teilnahme an internen Schulungen, Webinaren, Knowledge-Transfer-Sessions.

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Produktmanagement – du bringst Kundenstimmen direkt in die Roadmap.

  • Mitwirkung an Events, Messen, Webinaren sowie gemeinsamen Marketingkampagnen.

Qualifikation

Sales-DNA & SaaS-Mindset

  • Aktuelle Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-, Cloud- oder Software-Vertrieb

  • Sicherer Umgang mit B2B Software-Lösungen. u.a. für Kunden-Demos

  • Du magst und machst aktiven Vertrieb und baust Beziehungen auf+

  • Hunter-Mentalität mit B2B-Fokus

Kompetenzen & Persönlichkeit

  • Präsentationsstark, begeisterungsfähig, kommunikationsstark – du kannst Menschen „abholen“.

  • Technisches Grundverständnis und echtes Interesse an komplexen Softwarelösungen.

  • Hohe Motivation für den Abschluss von Leuchtturmprojekten und die Arbeit mit großen Unternehmen.

  • Neugier für Marktentwicklungen im Umfeld Corporate Reporting / ESG / Finance.

  • Belastbar, resilient, lösungsorientiert – du kannst mit Widerständen umgehen und bleibst am Ball.

  • Hohe Erreichbarkeit, Selbstständigkeit und Organisationsfähigkeit.

  • Neben sehr gutem Deutsch auch sehr gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Souveräner Umgang mit IT-Tools.

  • Reisebereitschaft: 5–8 Kundentermine pro Monat im DACH-Raum.

Nice-to-have

  • Ein Hintergrund in BWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Finance, Marketing, IT u.ä.

Benefits

  • Ein attraktives, leistungsbezogenes Gehalt: €60-70k Fixum / €86k++ OTE p.a. VHB bei ungedeckelten Provisionen, d.h. Jahresgehalt auch deutlich höher möglich, je nach Performance

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Hybrid am Standort Frankfurt/Main (Prio #1) oder remote in Baden-Württemberg bei regelmäßiger Präsenz-Bereitschaft am Standort Frankfurt/M. oder in der Schweiz.

  • Offene Kultur, kurze Wege, flache Hierarchien.

  • Moderne, wachsende Branche mit hoher Relevanz (ESG, Digitalisierung, Reporting-Automatisierung).

  • Umfangreiche Weiterbildungen, Trainings und persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit einem erfahrenen Team aus Sales, Marketing, Consulting & Produkt.

  • Perspektive auf internationales Wachstum.

Über das Unternehmen

Unser Mandant ist ein innovatives Schweizer Technologieunternehmen, das sich mit leistungsstarken SaaS-Plattformen für Corporate Reporting und Corporate Publishing im DACHLI-Raum eine führende Marktposition erarbeitet hat.

Die bewährten Cloud-Lösungen ermöglichen es Unternehmen, ihre regelmäßigen Finanz-, ESG- und Unternehmensberichte nicht nur zu digitalisieren, sondern in einem durchgängig automatisierten, hochgradig kollaborativen Prozess gemeinsam zu erstellen – von der ersten Datensammlung bis zum finalen PDF, Printprodukt oder Online-Report.

Mit einem konsequenten Single-Source-Ansatz und einer tiefen Integration in moderne Publishing- und Design-Workflows bieten die Lösungen etwas, das im Markt selten ist: Eine technisch hochentwickelte Produktionsplattform, die Compliance & Effizienz miteinander vereint. Ergänzt durch ein professionelles Service-Ökosystem aus Beratung, Implementierung, Support und Customer Success, das den Kunden eine reibungslose Einführung und maximale Wertschöpfung garantiert.

Die Lösungen unseres Mandanten zählen heute zu den führenden SaaS-Produkten im Corporate-Reporting-Umfeld. Sie werden von zahlreichen bekannten Unternehmen aus dem Konzern-Umfeld und Mittelstand sowie von Organisationen genutzt.

Falls du aus dem Umfeld SaaS, Cloud Software, Digital Publishing oder verwandten Branchen kommst, bietet dir dieses Unternehmen ein Umfeld, in dem technologischer Anspruch, tiefer Kundennutzen, Innovationskraft ideal zusammenfinden - und dass du am Markt selbstbewusst positionieren kannst, um weitere tolle Kunden zu gewinnen.

Klingt das interessant & passend für dich?

Wenn ja, nimm jetzt Kontakt zu uns auf - dann können wir dir mehr über diese spannende Stelle erzählen und du kannst in Ruhe entscheiden, ob das eine tolle Option für dich wäre.

Du kannst einen professionellen Prozess und zeitnahe Reaktionen von uns erwarten. Auch unterstützen wir dich dabei, dich optimal zu präsentieren und begleiten dich mit Rat & Tat im Prozess.

Wir freuen uns schon sehr über deine Kontaktaufnahme!

- Ilias & Team #germperdu

description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

The Music team owns music and sound effects end to end at ElevenLabs. We turn research breakthroughs into APIs and creative tools, from the backend systems that bring in new models to the interfaces creators use inside ElevenCreative. Five new research engineers have just joined the music research group, and models for stem separation and MIDI transcription are in progress.

You’ll join as a Full-Stack Engineer with a backend lean. You’ll work with research and research engineering to bring model improvements into production, and build and run the APIs behind them. You’ll also sync with go-to-market to decide which features, including bespoke enterprise ones, get built next. Occasionally you’ll join customer calls when a customer wants someone technical.

Engineers act as PMs. You’ll be handed ambiguous goals and expected to break them down. That means working through the legal questions, choosing the engineering approach, and planning the launch with growth. Models set the limits, so you’ll design systems that let a better model be swapped in later. Engineering is often only half the job.

Requirements

  • A strong Full-Stack Engineer with a backend lean. You’ve built and shipped production APIs and backend systems.

  • A product decomposition mindset. You’ve taken a vague goal, weighed trade-offs and shipped without analysis paralysis.

  • Proactive ownership. You drive work end to end without a ticket board or someone assigning tasks.

  • Comfortable working across research, legal, safety, growth, design and enterprise customers.

  • Genuinely excited about music and AI. You’re the kind of person who prototypes ideas for fun and pushes the good ones into production.

Bonus: music or audio experience (even as a hobby), or experience shipping ML models into production.

Location
This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe or on the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in Central European timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Dublin, London, New York and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

About CircuitHub

CircuitHub is reshaping electronics manufacturing with The Grid, a factory-scale robotics platform that makes small-batch, high-mix electronics assembly radically more efficient. Think semiconductor-fab precision applied to the chaotic world of prototyping and low-volume production: a 10x throughput improvement in one of the world's most foundational industries.

We've raised $45M from top-tier investors including Plural, Y Combinator and Google Ventures, and we're already profitable. Our customers include a major EV maker, a top AI lab and many of the worlds largest companies.

The Grid isn't a prototype. It's live, scaling fast and delivering real revenue, and we're building the team that will scale it further.

The Role

CircuitHub makes electronics on demand. Engineers upload a circuit board design; we buy the parts, build the board in our own robotic factory and ship it. More and more of that business is now run by AI agents, and we want you to help build them.

These aren't chatbots. Our agents have real jobs:

  • They inspect boards. An agent checks camera images of every panel we build for wrong, rotated or missing parts.

  • They program robots. Agents read datasheets so our pick-and-place machines know how to handle each new part.

  • They watch the factory. They spot stray parts in robot storage, diagnose printer faults and clear stuck machines.

  • They run the back office. They book supplier invoices, chase late orders, explain quotes and triage bugs.

  • They write our code. Most of what our team ships starts in an agent session.

What you'll do

Find a process people still do by hand and automate it end to end: decide what needs judgement and what needs plain code, build the tools, and prove it works before it runs alone. Then make it cheaper, faster and right more often. You'll also improve the platform every agent runs on, and work closely with the people your work serves, from factory operators to finance.

How we build

  • Evals first. An agent earns the right to work alone: blind tests against people's verdicts, shadow runs beside the humans, replays of past decisions. We track accuracy and cost per run, and re-test whenever we change a model, a prompt or the effort level.

  • Agents judge, code writes. Agents return structured answers. Plain code checks them against a second source and makes every change.

  • Classical first, model second. Cheap vision and maths narrow the problem so the model only looks where it matters.

  • Safe by construction. Agents work in sandboxed cloud machines that never hold real credentials, and tool calls are built so a business action can't run twice.

Recent work

  • Image alignment ranks the parts on each board photo. The worst 20% of parts hold about 90% of real defects, so the agent only inspects those. In a blind re-run it caught all 13 defects operators had marked.

  • A photo check for stray parts in robot storage scored 10 out of 10 blind, at about 8¢ a photo. The model it replaced caught about half.

  • Agent tool calls leave durable receipts, so a session killed mid-deploy resumes without sending the same email or order twice.

  • Invoices extracted from supplier emails matched what a person had entered 66 times out of 66.

  • A constraint solver replans the whole factory every two minutes, across robots, ovens and people.

What we look for

  • You've put LLM agents into production and can tell us what broke and how you knew it was working.

  • You're a strong software engineer first. Most of this job is real engineering, not prompting: concurrency, idempotency, data modelling, security.

description:
Who we are

Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.

We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi. The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level.

We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter, Noah Hollmann, and Sauraj Gambhir, and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun.

In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years.

The role

You will be our first dedicated engineering leader, reporting to the CTO with a direct line to both founders - no layers in between.

Today, engineering at Prior Labs is a small, very senior team. We plan to grow it substantially over the next 18 months, and your job is to build and run that organization.

We want to be honest about what this job is. It is a hands-on operator role: managing engineers, building the hiring machine, setting standards, running compliance, and working closely with our partners at SAP. If you light up at making an organization fast rather than at owning the biggest possible headcount, this is your role.

What you'll do

  • Directly manage and grow the engineering team, including building out its management layer.

  • Build the hiring machine: run hiring operations across our hiring managers, design interview loops that hold up in the AI era, and keep a very high bar while the team grows.

  • Own engineering standards and velocity: how we review, test, and ship - and how the team gets real leverage from AI coding tools.

  • Own our security and compliance program - SOC 2, GDPR, ISO 27001 - right-sized, so the lab keeps its speed.

  • Own the engineering side of our collaboration with SAP.

  • Treat the deployment layer as a product surface: our models reach customers through a managed API, customer VPCs, and self-hosted open weights, and the engineering behind that needs customer empathy, not just platform craft.

  • Act as a sparring partner to the founders on org design and engineering direction - we're hiring someone who will argue with us.

What we're looking for

  • You have directly led an engineering organization of 10+ people, including through managers or leads, and you can talk concretely about how you built it.

  • You have owned platform or infrastructure scope at scale: serving, APIs, availability, cloud and vendor budgets.

  • You have worked in both startups and large organizations - you can create structure from scratch and hold your own with a very large partner.

  • You scaled an engineering org through a real growth phase (25 to 60+ or similar), building the management layer along the way.

  • You have led engineering in a research- or ML-heavy organization and know how research code and production code differ - and how to bridge them without slowing research down.

What sets you apart

  • You have led engineering through an acquisition, working directly with the parent company.

  • You have personally changed how your team works because of AI coding tools, and can show what it did to output.

  • You have operated under SOC 2 / ISO-style audit regimes; having built or run the function yourself is a plus.

Life at Prior Labs

You'll work alongside researchers and builders who hold themselves to a very high bar - in the quality of their work and in how they work with each other. We move fast and still take the time to do things right.

Our teams are based in Berlin, Freiburg, and New York - when you're working on something as hard as TabPFN, being in the same room matters. But great people come from everywhere, and in exceptional cases we're open to remote, which usually means frequent travel to one of our offices. Wherever you're based, the whole company comes together regularly for offsites to build and celebrate together.

Our Commitments

The best products and teams are built by people with a wide range of perspectives and backgrounds. We welcome applications from all identities and walks of life - especially if you've ever felt discouraged by "not checking every box" - and provide equal opportunities regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disability, or any other trait that makes you who you are.

We care about how your data is handled - see our Recruiting Data Privacy page

description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Wolt is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Front-end-leaning) to join our Operations Foundations team. The team sits within the DoorDash Client and AI Development group and is responsible for the foundation that hundreds of engineers across Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo rely on to build internal operations tools. Our platform hosts 250+ micro-frontends (MFEs) used to operate every part of the business.

Our team is focused on building a scalable, reliable, and high-quality internal tooling platform that supports Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo's operations and business.

The team plays an important role in improving how engineers build, test, and ship software across the organization, with a strong emphasis on reusable libraries, micro-frontend architecture, and agentic development: building the platform where AI agents can take changes from task to merged PR safely and reliably without lowering the quality bar.

Currently, we are focused on unifying our frontend platforms, evolving shared components and library development, improving developer productivity, and enabling teams to deliver more independently through better architecture and tooling.

It's an exciting time to join because the team has strong ownership and a broad technical impact.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who can take ownership of complex technical initiatives across both frontend and sometimes backend and infra domains. In this role, you'll work primarily with TypeScript, React, Node.js, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Buildkite), and MFE architecture to build scalable, maintainable solutions that support multiple product teams and business areas.

Success in this role means becoming a trusted technical owner who consistently delivers reliable solutions and helps the team execute more effectively. Six months into the role, we'd expect you to be independently leading technical initiatives and contributing meaningfully to architecture and delivery planning.

This role offers the opportunity to solve challenging engineering problems with visible impact across the business. It's especially exciting for someone who enjoys combining product engineering with platform thinking, improving developer workflows, and building systems that scale across teams and domains.

What you'll be doing

  • Owning the Foundation: the runtime, build, deployment, and developer experience that 250+ MFEs and hundreds of engineers depend on every day.
  • Evolving Our Micro-Frontend Architecture: improve composition, isolation, and shared dependency strategies so feature teams can move fast.
  • Product and Planning: Independently drive projects from idea to production: breaking down ambiguous problems into clear technical plans, estimating delivery, identifying risks early, and delivering high-quality solutions in a timely manner.
  • Supporting Engineering Excellence: Champion best practices, raise the bar for code quality, and turn lessons learned into platform improvements.
  • Long-Term Thinking: Balance short-term feature unblockers with the long-term health, security, and maintainability of the platform.
  • Agentic Development: Build the foundations that let AI agents work autonomously on our platform, including agent instructions, reusable skills, tool integrations, guardrails, and the automated checks that make agent-authored changes safe to ship.
  • AI Fluency: Work agent-first in your own day-to-day: delegate implementation to agents, and focus your judgment on direction, architecture, and verifying outcomes.

📍This role can be based in our Berlin tech hub. Read more about our hybrid setup here.

Feel free to check out the Wolt Tech Blog for more insight into our culture and technology.

Our humble expectations

  • Proven expertise in building production frontend applications using TypeScript and React.
  • Solid backend knowledge, comfortable owning and operating Node.js services that support frontend infrastructure.
  • Strong knowledge of frontend build tools, bundlers, and module systems, and the ability to evolve them as the platform grows.
  • Track record of diagnosing and resolving complex performance, reliability, or DX issues in large frontend codebases.
  • Experience driving technical initiatives across multiple engineering teams and stakeholders.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills: aligning priorities, managing expectations, and communicating trade-offs clearly with partner teams and leadership.
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative, platform-mindset approach to working with feature teams.
  • Strong documentation skills, including experience writing RFCs or ADRs.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with micro-frontend architecture.
  • Frontend platform engineering experience.
  • Experience building shared component libraries used by many product teams.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, deployment processes, and cloud infrastructure for frontend workloads.
  • Experience or interest in observability and reliability (SRE).
  • Experience building tooling or workflows for autonomous AI coding agents (e.g., agent instructions, skills, MCP servers, or evaluating agent-generated code).

What's in it for you

  • Impact: Build and shape the platform that thousands of people depend on.
  • Scale: Work on real platform problems behind 250+ MFEs with hundreds of monthly contributors.
  • Collaboration: Partner with talented engineers, designers, and operators across companies to make their daily work faster and better.
  • Growth: Take on deep technical challenges across frontend architecture, agentic development, DX, and improving engineering efficiency.
  • Culture: Be part of a diverse, open-minded team that values creativity, autonomy, and continuous learning.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

description:
At SumUp, the Global Bank team builds the core infrastructure and services that give merchants a digital bank account, helping small businesses manage their money easily and reliably. 

The Balance Management Squad sits at the core of the Global Bank Platform. Right now, our team is completing a major milestone: consolidating and modernizing our balance management system in Europe. The next big step is creating a global transaction history service; a single, shared platform used by all regions to give merchants consistent and transparent views of their financial activity.

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll help modernize existing systems while balancing innovation with stability, collaborate with teams across regions, and build reliable services that manage diverse markets with different regulations.

If you enjoy solving complex problems on high-load systems, are curious about banking, and are looking for a team that tackles challenges head-on, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

  • Build and evolve the SumUp's core banking services that powers ledger operations and transactions, transforming our regional systems into a unified, scalable global platform.
  • Tackle complex distributed systems challenges, ensuring resilient services that continue to perform under high transaction volumes.
  • Support modernization initiatives by improving observability, adding test coverage, refactoring code for long-term maintainability, and gradually introducing new architectural patterns without disrupting live banking operations.
  • Contribute to key architectural decisions - build ledger and transaction history systems from the ground up, ensuring a globally scalable banking solution for our clients.
  • Collaborate with teams across Risk, Treasury, Finance, and Infrastructure to ensure smooth, compliant, and reliable global operations
  • Take ownership from design to production, running the services you build, monitoring their performance, and continuously improving how we deliver high-quality software at scale.

You'll be great for this role if

  • You have solid backend experience building reliable, high-volume services and you think carefully about system design, APIs, data modeling, and how services interact.
  • You are proficient in Golang and comfortable learning and working with other languages as needed, e.g. Kotlin or Elixir.
  • You write maintainable, well-tested code, follow CI/CD best practices, and take responsibility for the software you build from development to production.
  • You're comfortable building, deploying, and running services in cloud environments like AWS using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Are fluent in relational databases that perform well under load and maintain data consistency.
  • You are a collaborator who enjoys working across regions, communicating clearly, exchanging feedback effectively, and making thoughtful technical decisions together.
  • You have a curiosity for building reliable financial services and banking domain

It's a plus if you have

  • Deeper PostgreSQL experience - we rely heavily on Postgres, so if you've done performance tuning, complex queries, or schema design, that's a plus
  • Experience with event streaming platforms (Kafka preferred) and modern observability stacks (Grafana, Honeycomb, etc.)

Why you should join SumUp

  • Be part of a company that values diversity and celebrates unique perspectives.
  • Work with a global team of skilled professionals in an environment that fosters collaboration, learning, and growth.
  • Be part of a global tribe building a banking solution from the ground up and delivering impactful solutions to the real-life problems of millions of SumUp merchants all over the world
  • Career growth and learning opportunities: We invest in your development through regular training, mentorship programs, SumUp University leadership cohort and a yearly learning budget (2,000 EUR)
  • Sabbatical program for tenured SumUppers
  • Join a global team where you belong: Check out our D&I Initiatives and Employee Resource Groups such as Pride Club, SumAfro, Neurodiversity, Grupos Mais, Women in Tech, and more
  • Health & wellness benefits: in-house fitness classes, gym in the office, subsidized Urban Sports Club and available psychotherapy sessions
  • A lot of other benefits such as Subsidized Public Transport Card, Kita placement assistance, Pension Scheme, Language Learning platform/courses etc.
  • Enrollment onto our virtual stock ownership program - you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

About SumUp

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing a vast set of simple and affordable business tools to help them start, run, and grow their businesses. Today, over 4 million businesses in 36 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster an inclusivity and continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.

SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited.

Explore career opportunities with us and join a team driven by collaboration, innovation, and a shared vision of creating a world where everyone can build a thriving business. Discover more about our vibrant and inclusive work culture and how we work on our careers website, and follow our journey on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

description:
tl;dr

  • After 14 years in construction tech, Lea & Jonas are building the AI foundation for the construction industry

  • 6 of Europe's 20 largest construction companies already rely on Kuro, with leading construction enterprises representing over €40bn in combined annual construction volume using the platform every day

  • Construction has some of the most complex, unstructured data you can throw at an LLM. At Kuro, you can tackle some of the hardest problems in applied AI every day

  • Curious about the bigger engineering challenge? Explore the vision and open problems at kuro.build.

About us

Lea and Jonas scaled two of Europe's leading construction tech companies - Capmo and alcemy - and saw firsthand the challenges holding the industry back. Now they're tackling the root cause: the 50% of construction work still lost to manual data handling.

Kuro is building the AI foundation for construction. We're reimagining how construction professionals get work done and make decisions by leveraging AI to augment back-office workflows and make core data accessible. We are not pursuing marginal improvements, but a step change for construction.

After one year on the market, leading construction enterprises with a combined annual construction volume of >€40 billion use Kuro every day to automate workflows and make faster, better decisions. Backed by an €10 million seed round, we already process more than 1 million pages every month and expect that volume to grow 10x over the next six months.

We are 15 people based in Berlin. You will join a group of technical ex-founders and builders who are ambitious and kind.

Learn more: Join Kuro - Berlin

What You'll Do

Set the technical direction

  • Own the architecture decisions for the platform, from document ingestion to the chat UI

  • Write and review RFCs. The technical roadmap for the next two to three quarters is yours.

  • Make the build-or-buy decisions: which models we use, and which retrieval and orchestration stack we build on.

  • Turn a vague customer request (“show me where the bid deviates from the BoQ”) into a scoped plan with the risks named.

Raise the bar for the team

  • Mentor engineers: Review their designs and their code.

  • Define the engineering standards. Find what slows the team down, in tooling or in the CI/CD pipeline, and fix it.

  • Interview and hire engineers.

  • You have no direct reports. You change decisions in product and in other teams with a written argument.

Build and own end-to-end (AI) features

  • Design and implement new features to solve a specific user problem, such as document versioning or our agentic Chat.

  • From concept to DB schema, to optimizing LLMs, to UI. Own the full development lifecycle of customer-facing features.

  • Manage evaluations and scoring, and perform error analysis on new and shipped AI features.

Build the platform that abstracts workflow building

  • Contribute to the workflow harness, decision-trace standard, and eval tooling so a new use case ships in ~1 month

  • Build reusable human review & approval surfaces where trust in AI output is earned

Work on the construction ontology & project graph

  • Help model and evolve canonical entities of our customers

  • Contribute to entity resolution across sources: recognizing the same requirement, position, or price across BoQs, contracts, drawings, and bids

  • Build features so answers are evidence-linked and auditable, and decisions flow back into the graph

Contribute to scalable data pipelines & integrations

  • Extend our multi-modal ingestion of unstructured documents - PDFs, scans, drawings, and 3D models - orchestrated and cost-efficient at scale

  • Build read/write integrations with customer systems (document management, ERP/AVA), so workflows complete work end-to-end

Projects you would be involved in

Current & Past projects

  • Project & document versioning guaranteeing data lineage in construction projects

  • German tokenizer for construction-specific search

  • Document pipeline ingesting 10,000s of PDFs per day

  • Native BIM/DWG file support: ingesting and processing 3D models

  • Design the ontology v1 + graph schema: core construction entities, evidence links, and per-customer extension model

  • Build out our workflow harness to run agentic workflows for customers

Current Tech Stack

It is still day 0 for Kuro. Therefore, we are highly pragmatic with our tool choices. We believe in keeping it simple and moving quickly. You significantly help shape our tech stack decisions.

  • Web-App: Typescript

  • Database / Vector DB and File Storage: AWS RDS / Trubopuffer / AWS S3

  • Backend: Fastify API + Prisma ORM

  • Workflow Orchestrator: Prefect (Python)

  • Hosting: AWS Elastic Beanstalk

  • AI: Azure / OpenAI, Gemini, Cohere, AWS

  • Obsv., Eval. & Tracking: Langfuse, Datadog

Your profile

This is the perfect role for an experienced engineer who wants to join an early stage company that builds a high impact applied AI product

  • Bring 6+ years of experience as a Staff (full-stack) software engineer or Technical Lead, in a fast-paced environment

  • Have proven experience delivering production-grade applied AI features to customers

  • Take full ownership of solving customer problems by designing and implementing AI features

  • Thrive in a small, accountable team with a high degree of ownership and a drive to make an impact

  • Communicate fluently in both spoken and written English

  • Enjoy working onsite with the team at our office in Factory Berlin Mitte every day

Bonus Points

  • You’ve started a company before or worked at a very early stage startup

  • You built side projects in the past - we’re excited to hear about these!

  • German-speaking (definitely not a must, we’re fully international)

Why Kuro

You’ll join at a point when customer demand is proven, but our product and platform are still yours to shape. You’ll own customer-facing features end to end while building the foundations beneath them, from ingestion pipelines and workflow infrastructure to our construction ontology and project graph.

As Kuro grows, you can grow with it, whether as a leading individual contributor, technical leader or people manager.

 

The Process

  • Talent Acquisition Call – Intro, motivation, logistics & fit (30 min)

  • Impact Interview – Deep dive into your experience, ownership & impact (60 min)

  • On-site Day

    • System Design – Designing under ambiguity & LLM craft (45 min)

    • AI-Native Coding – Hands-on coding with AI (45 min)

    • Final Culture Interview (approx. 60 min)

  • Reference calls

  • Decision

description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

About the role

Andercore runs global trade end to end, from sourcing and pricing to sales, logistics and financing, and AI agents do a growing share of that work. Order values are high and prices and stock change daily, so the systems underneath have to be fast, correct and reliable at all times.

As a Staff Engineer, you own our hardest technical problems and set the architecture across teams. You focus on what a fast-growing trading business cannot afford to get wrong: speed, reliability, security and observability. You report to our VP Engineering and work closely with our Senior Product Engineers, QA and product managers. You stay hands-on: you write code, review designs and raise the bar for everyone around you

Tech stack

Java 21 and Spring Boot 3, Python, LangGraph and LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), PostgreSQL, Kinesis, AWS with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and TypeScript with Node.js, Next.js and React. Including Salesforce, which we are moving our transaction core out of.

 

What you will do

  • Set the technical direction across teams: define the target architecture, write the RFCs behind big decisions, and make sure teams build towards the same picture.

  • Lead the hardest technical work yourself, from design to production, instead of only advising on it.

  • Shape the carve-out of our transaction core from Salesforce into a modern, modular core system, with a migration path that never disrupts daily trading.

  • Make reliability, security and observability part of how we build: monitoring, alerting, incident response and postmortems that lead to real changes.

  • Design how our AI agents act safely on money-touching paths, with evaluations, guardrails, audit trails and human review where it matters.

  • Set standards for correctness and data integrity, including idempotency, validation and testing, together with QA.

  • Mentor engineers through design reviews, pairing and direct feedback, and help us hire by defining what great engineering looks like at Andercore.

 

In your first six months, you might

  • Design the architecture of our pricing engine so it scales with a growing assortment and more markets, and serves correct prices to sales, and later directly to customers, in milliseconds.

  • Lay out the target architecture and first steps for moving our transaction core off Salesforce.

  • Build the observability and incident setup that lets us catch problems before customers or colleagues notice them

     

What you bring

  • At least 8 years of experience building and running software in production, including systems where errors cost real money.

  • Deep backend expertise at production scale in Java or a comparable language such as Kotlin, C# or Go, and willingness to work in Java and Spring Boot.

  • A track record of setting architecture across several teams, through influence rather than a management title.

  • Experience designing transactional, distributed and event-driven systems, with a strong focus on correctness, failure modes and performance.

  • Hands-on depth in reliability, security and observability, and experience leading incidents and postmortems.

  • Experience in a fast-growing company, and a track record of solving business problems, not only technical ones.

  • AI is part of your daily work. Experience building or evaluating AI agents in production is a strong plus.

  • Experience with re-platforming or carving out systems from a platform like Salesforce or an ERP is a plus

 

Practical details

  • Location: Berlin, hybrid

  • Working language: English

  • A learning budget for your development

  • Start date: As soon as possible

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength.

description:
Description

Our quantum sensing technology is already operating in customer environments across Taiwan, the United States, and Europe. As our installed base grows and we move from first deployments to repeat orders, ensuring the reliability and performance of every system becomes increasingly important.

As our Field Service Engineer, you'll take hands-on ownership of our systems throughout their operational lifecycle — from installation and commissioning to preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair.

You'll work directly with leading semiconductor foundries, IDMs, and OSATs, ensuring our systems operate reliably and consistently meet their specifications. You'll collaborate closely with our Engineering and Applications teams, combining technical problem-solving with a strong customer focus.

This is also an opportunity to help shape our global service function from an early stage, introducing the processes, tools, and standards that will support our growing international installed base.

Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

Why join Quantum Diamonds?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us?

  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible!

What will you do

  • Install, commission, and qualify our quantum sensing systems at customer sites across Europe, the US, and Asia, working closely with our Munich-based engineering teams.

  • Perform preventive maintenance, calibration, troubleshooting, and repairs across optical, laser, mechanical, electronic, and software subsystems.

  • Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues systematically, collaborating with Engineering and R&D when deeper technical expertise is required.

  • Take ownership of system reliability and technical service, working closely with Field Application Engineers who focus on measurement execution and customer applications.

  • Manage spare-parts availability for your installed base, including inventory tracking, consumption planning, replenishment, and coordination of service logistics.

  • Document service activities, technical findings, and root causes, feeding recurring issues and improvement opportunities back into Product Development.

  • Build trusted relationships with customers by providing clear technical communication, reliable support, and professional service in demanding semiconductor environments.

  • Help establish and continuously improve our global service processes, including maintenance procedures, troubleshooting guides, documentation, and training materials.

What is expected of you

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience as a Field Service Engineer, Equipment Engineer, or in a comparable technical service role, ideally working with semiconductor, optical, laser, inspection, or metrology equipment.

  • Strong practical troubleshooting skills across complex electromechanical systems, ideally combining optics, lasers, precision mechanics, electronics, and control software.

  • Experience working in semiconductor fabs, cleanrooms, or similarly demanding technical environments, with an understanding of relevant safety and operating procedures.

  • Familiarity with laser safety and interlocked systems, or willingness to complete the necessary technical and safety qualifications.

  • Experience with spare-parts management, service documentation, and ERP or service ticketing systems is an advantage.

  • A structured, independent, and solution-oriented approach to technical challenges, even when working under time pressure.

EggAI Labs · Working Student · In Person (Tübingen, Germany)

Designing lifecycle evaluation for nondeterministic domain-specific AI systems.

EggAI Labs

We're opening the EggAI Labs in Tübingen. The Labs purpose is to test new AI capabilities, identify what works, how they'd improve delivery, and then build assets to support teams and clients. EggAI's mission cannot be achieved through one-off client projects alone and the Labs is the way to adapt and scale.

As part of the first cohort, you will join a small peer group and work directly with EggAI's CAIO, a Tübingen alumnus. You will also collaborate with our engineering, product, and project leads, who will bring you insights from client problems, help you understand their context and challenge your solutions for them. Your fellow AI Builders will be deliberately chosen to span different passions and strenghts. You will have room to explore and be expected to turn that exploration into something useful. This is not a client-facing role.

The problem: EvalOps

How do we prove an AI system acts as expected under various conditions?

We will explore EvalOps: the methods and tools used to check whether domain-specific AI systems meet their behavioral requirements. Among the key challenges for operating AI systems are nondeterminism, ground-truth curation, evaluation metric-design, latency and costs. EvalOps need to overcome all of them in a disciplined way.

These questions will guide the initial work:

  • Regression suites: How can domain experts turn traces, code, and prompts into useful evals in a way that scales?

  • Coverage estimation: How can we quantify the gaps between an eval suite and the range of expected agent behaviors?

  • Live monitoring: Is it possible to detect anomalous behaviour in production with a similar precision to regression evals?

  • Eval analysis: How much evidence is enough to act (e.g., deploy, debug, roll back a feature, choose a different model)? You will help refine them, test approaches, create assets, and pose new questions.

The role

As an AI Builder, you will take an open EvalOps problem from investigation to a working prototype, ready to be tested. Whatever your focus, you will be expected to take a problem through to a useful result. Here is what that means in practice:

  • Research emerging AI and evaluation capabilities and distinguish substance from hype.

  • Understand the user, workflow, domain, and organisational problem around the work.

  • Evaluate usefulness, quality, safety, and reliability with appropriate evidence.

  • Communicate decisions and learning clearly.

  • Create assets that other people can understand, use, and improve.

  • Code and build end to end.

This shared foundation leaves room for different strengths and interests. Each AI Builder will then develop greater depth in one of three pillars.

Three pillars, different passions

Pillar

Driving question

Possible EvalOps focus

Product

What should we build?

Workflows and interfaces that help domain experts create evals, inspect traces, understand results, and make decisions.

Engineering

How should we build it?

Dependable and scalable evaluation infrastructure, trace processing, monitoring, and governance tooling.

Data Science

How do we know it works?

Coverage measures, sampling strategies, scoring methods, statistical tests, anomaly detection, and reasoning under uncertainty.

We expect every AI Builder to develop a practical foundation across all three pillars and to pursue greater depth in the one that most strongly matches their passion.

What we value

  • Problem obsession. A difficult question captures your curiosity. You keep returning to it, pursue ideas without waiting for instructions, and care deeply about finding an answer that works.

  • Initiative and follow-through. You turn uncertainty into something you can investigate, test, and improve—and stay resourceful when the first approach fails.

  • Evidence of making things work. Show us something you created, the decisions you made, and what you learned along the way.

  • Independent judgment. You test new capabilities yourself, distinguish evidence from enthusiasm, and change your mind when the findings warrant it.

  • Generosity in collaboration. You explain your thinking, seek candid feedback, act on it, and help others make progress. 

What is required

  • You are pursuing a Master’s degree.

  • You can write code and turn an idea into working, tested software.

  • You can work from Tübingen and communicate fluently in English, our company language.

Relevant fields include Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Physics, Bioinformatics, Computational Neuroscience, Medical Informatics, Quantitative Data Science, Cognitive Science. We also welcome candidates from other disciplines who can demonstrate strong problem-solving and practical technical ability.

What you will gain

  • Industry insight. Learn what works and what breaks in real enterprise AI systems, with access to problems from EggAI’s client work

  • Meaningful ownership. Take an EvalOps problem from investigation to a working, evaluated solution, with freedom to shape the approach.

  • Close mentorship. Work directly with EggAI’s Chief AI Officer and sharpen your judgment through feedback from engineering, product, and project leads.

  • Room to develop. Deepen your strengths, learn from peers with complementary perspectives, and use modern AI-development tools on unresolved problems.

  • A say in the Lab’s direction. Help establish its working practices, propose new questions, and influence what it pursues next.

  • Competitive compensation, including recognition for exceptional contributions, and a potential path to a full-time EggAI role after graduation.

How to apply

A short cover letter is required.

Your CV tells us what you have done so far, but we're also interested in the why. Use the letter to explain why you made those choices, what drives you, and why the AI Builder role at EggAI Labs feels like the right next step in your career. 

We are looking for exceptional students, and excellence takes many forms, e.g., academic results, research or ambitious projects. Whatever form yours takes, show us the appropriate evidence, be it grades, publications, something you've built or other evidence of impact.

This is an in-person role in Tübingen. We can only consider candidates who live within commuting distance.

fal is the generative media ecosystem powering the next generation of AI products. We build the infrastructure, tools, and model access that teams need to move from idea to production, and do it at scale without compromise. For developers and enterprises, fal is the foundation that makes generative media not just possible, but practical: a unified platform where high-performance inference, orchestration, and observability come together to unlock new categories of AI-native products.

As generative media reshapes industries across a market projected to grow by hundreds of billions over the next decade, fal is becoming the ecosystem that ambitious teams build on.

About fal

fal is the generative media platform for developers. We give the world's most ambitious AI teams the fastest way to run image, video, audio and 3D models in production. We also provide the GPU infrastructure they need to train, fine-tune and serve models of their own.

Our inference engine was built from the ground up for generative media. It has made fal the platform builders reach for when speed, scale and reliability matter. Our customers range from the fastest-growing AI companies in the world to the Fortune 500. More and more of them are coming to us for raw compute as well as inference and model APIs.

We're a small, high-output team, and we're growing fast. If you want to be in the room while the infrastructure layer of generative AI gets built, this is that room.

About the Role

As an Account Executive on our Compute team, you'll own new-logo acquisition across AI-native startups and neolabs. You'll sell fal's full compute offering: dedicated GPU clusters, reserved and on-demand capacity, and the inference platform that developers already build on. This is a pure hunter role. You won't inherit a book. You'll build one, and with it you'll help define how fal takes compute to market.

What You'll Do

Build and own your pipeline

  • Own all net-new logo acquisition across a defined set of AI-native startups, neolabs and research-driven model builders.

  • Build pipeline from scratch through founder and investor networks, targeted outbound, community and events, and the market signals that tell you a team is about to need compute: a fresh fundraise, a new model release, a hiring spree in research.

  • Use fal's product data to spot developers and teams already building on our platform whose usage shows they're ready for a larger compute commitment.

  • Keep a focused, prioritized target list. Know which 30 companies matter most this quarter and why.

Lead technical, consultative sales cycles

  • Engage founders, CTOs, heads of research and infrastructure leads early, often before a formal buying process exists.

  • Run deep discovery on each customer's workloads: training vs. fine-tuning vs. inference, model architecture and scale, GPU generation and cluster topology, storage and networking, utilization targets and timeline.

  • Partner with Solutions Engineering on benchmarks, proofs of concept and architecture reviews that show fal's performance and reliability on the customer's own workloads.

  • Translate technical requirements into a clear business case: time-to-cluster, price-performance, flexibility and total cost.

Structure and close compute deals

  • Design commercial agreements that fit how fast-growing AI companies actually operate: reserved clusters, on-demand and burst capacity, prepaid commitments, and blended platform agreements.

  • Work with our capacity, finance and deal desk teams to secure supply and structure deals that work for both the customer and fal.

  • Run the full cycle from first conversation through negotiation and signature, keeping momentum through commercial, technical and legal review.

Grow with your customers

  • Land with an initial workload, then expand as customers scale from experimentation to large training runs to production inference.

  • Build multi-threaded relationships so fal is the first call when a customer's next capacity need appears.

  • Hand off smoothly and stay aligned with Account Management and Customer Success as accounts mature.

Shape the business

  • Bring structured customer and market feedback to Product, Infrastructure and Leadership: what's winning, what's missing, and what competitors are doing.

  • Help build the playbook. You'll be among the first sellers dedicated to this segment, and your input will shape how the motion scales.

  • Keep forecasting accurate and pipeline up to date in Salesforce.

Qualifications/Nice to Have:

  • 5+ years of full-cycle B2B sales experience, with a consistent record of meeting or beating quota in a closing role.

  • 2+ years selling cloud infrastructure, GPU compute, AI/ML platforms or developer tools. You've sold technical products to technical buyers and you're fluent in the conversation.

  • Startup and AI-native buyers are your home turf. You understand how funding cycles, runway and competitive pressure drive buying, and you know how to move at their pace.

  • Technical credibility. You can hold a real conversation with an ML engineer or research lead about GPU generations, interconnect, cluster sizing, training vs. inference economics, and why utilization matters. You don't need to be an engineer, but engineers should be glad you're on the call.

  • A builder's approach to pipeline. You've generated a large share of your own pipeline and you're energized, not intimidated, by a blank territory.

  • Strong commercial judgment. You know when a long-term reservation is the right answer for a customer and when flexibility matters more. You structure deals that set customers up to grow.

  • Low ego, high ownership. You collaborate closely with Solutions Engineering, Product and Finance, and you take accountability for outcomes.

  • Experience at a GPU cloud, neocloud, hyperscaler startup team, or AI infrastructure company

  • Existing relationships across the AI startup, research and venture capital ecosystem

  • Experience with usage- or consumption-based business models

  • A track record of turning self-serve or product-led adoption into larger committed contracts

  • Familiarity with generative media (image, video, audio, 3D) or foundation model development

  • Familiarity with structured sales methods such as MEDDPICC


What we offer at fal

  • Interesting and challenging work

  • A lot of learning and growth opportunities

  • We offer visa sponsorship and will help you relocate to San Francisco.

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance (US)

  • Regular team events and offsites

description:
Why SDK Engineering at Langfuse

Your work will have an outsized impact.

Our SDKs are downloaded 26M+ times per month. When you ship a new integration or improve SDK performance, thousands of developers benefit the same day — and they'll tell you about it in GitHub issues, on Twitter, and in our community channels. Everything you build is open source (MIT-licensed) and immediately visible.

The SDK is often the very first thing a developer touches when they try Langfuse, so your work directly shapes their first impression.

You will also have direct exposure to how cutting-edge LLM-applications are built. The users you serve are some of the best and most ambitious software engineers in the world and that leverage Langfuse to improve their applications. Deeply understanding the problems they solve will help you design the best possible SDK experience and along the way makes you an expert on LLM engineering yourself.

 

You will grow at Langfuse by

  • Owning our SDKs. We maintain SDKs in Python and TypeScript both built on OpenTelemetry. You'll be responsible for their reliability, performance, and developer experience. These SDKs run inside our users' production systems, which means they must never fail, must have minimal impact on CPU and memory, and must work flawlessly across every environment — from serverless functions to long-running agent loops. You'll think deeply about the exposed interfaces, error handling, batching, async flushing, and graceful degradation.

  • Designing APIs that developers love. How are functions named, how are parameters structured, how are breaking changes communicated, how does the documentation read? Developer experience is a core differentiator for Langfuse and you'll own every detail of it. When we shipped the Python SDK v3 and TypeScript SDK v4, both were full rewrites on OpenTelemetry — that's the kind of thoughtful, high-impact SDK work you'll lead. Apart from tracing, we also support core workflows of engineers building with LLMs with our SDKs, see our Experiment Runner SDK for example.

  • Integrating with every major AI framework: Langfuse integrates with 40+ frameworks and model providers: OpenAI SDK, Vercel AI SDK, AI SDK, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Pydantic AI, OpenAI Agents, CrewAI, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, LiveKit, and many more. You'll maintain these integrations, ensure new Langfuse features are supported across all of them, and add new integrations as the ecosystem evolves. When a new framework gains traction, you'll be among the first to instrument it.

  • Maintaining our OpenTelemetry endpoint: some users send traces directly to our OTLP endpoint instead of using our SDKs. You'll ensure this path is robust, well-documented, and supports the full range of Langfuse features. This also extends our language support to Java, Go, and any language with an OpenTelemetry SDK. You can work with the OpenTelemetry community to steer the GenAI conventions.

  • Writing public documentation: you'll own the SDK docs, integration guides, and migration paths. At Langfuse, docs are part of our core product. When you ship a new SDK version or integration, the docs ship with it.

What we're looking for

  • Strong engineer who gets excited about developer experience, API design, and writing code that runs reliably in other people's production systems

  • Experience building or maintaining SDKs, client libraries, or developer tools — ideally in Python and/or TypeScript

  • Deep understanding of performance: you know how to profile, benchmark, and minimize CPU/memory overhead in hot paths

  • Someone who can manage projects themselves — you know how to develop strong conviction about what to build and how to ship it

  • Thoughtful about versioning, backwards compatibility, and migration paths

  • Interest in open source software and genuine excitement about talking to developers about their integration challenges

  • Thrives in a small, accountable team where your output is visible and matters

  • CS or quantitative degree preferred

 

Bonus points:

  • Experience with OpenTelemetry internals or observability instrumentation

  • Former founder or early startup experience

  • Contributions to popular open source SDKs or developer tools

  • ML/AI background or familiarity with the LLM framework ecosystem

 

No candidate checks all boxes. If you feel you are a good fit for this role, please go ahead and apply.

 

Learn more about

  • SDK Overview — architecture and design of our Python and TypeScript SDKs

  • All Integrations — the full list of frameworks, model providers, and gateways we support

  • OpenTelemetry Integration — how we use OTEL as the foundation

  • SDK Upgrade Paths — how we think about versioning and breaking changes

  • Project you could have built: TypeScript SDK v4 (GA)

  • Project you could have built: Python SDK v3 (GA)

  • Our codebase: GitHub Repository

  • Ben Kuhn on Impact, Agency and Taste

  • Who we are & how we work

 

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today.

We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our Government Affairs & Communications team, help build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands.

Our founding team's research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field.

About the Role

As Head of Government Affairs & Communications, you'll own and lead SE3's policy, public affairs and communications function. You'll set the strategy that shapes how governments, parliaments, armed forces and the press across Germany and Europe understand SE3, and build the team and relationships that turn that positioning into institutional trust and political standing. You'll work directly with our founders and act as one of the company's senior voices.

What You'll Work On

  • Strategy: Own SE3's government affairs and communications strategy, setting priorities across policy, public affairs and press.

  • Parliamentary Relations: Hold senior institutional relationships, in particular with the German parliament, and represent SE3 with governments and armed forces.

  • Policy Positions: Shape SE3's positions on the security, procurement and regulatory questions that will define the operating environment for autonomous systems in Europe.

  • Thought Leadership: Lead SE3's thought-leadership agenda so the company helps set the terms of the European debate on autonomy and AI in defence.

  • Senior Engagements: Lead SE3's most significant political and press engagements as a senior voice of the company.

  • Team Building: Build, lead and develop the government affairs and communications team as the function scales.

Your Profile

  • You take ownership of outcomes and remove obstacles without waiting for direction. You turn discussions into clear decisions and decisions into deliverables, and you hold yourself and your team to a consistently high standard.

  • You hold a degree in political science, international relations, security studies, communications, public policy or an adjacent discipline. A postgraduate qualification is welcome.

  • You bring significant senior experience in government affairs, political or strategic communications, or in a ministry, parliament or comparable institution.

  • You have built and led a function or team, and you have owned senior stakeholder relationships.

  • You speak native-level German and have full professional fluency in English, written and spoken. Given the nature of SE3's work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to work on defence-related projects and, where required, obtain the relevant security clearance.

Especially Valued Bonus Skills
