description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Data Enrichment Platform Team

Our Enrichment Orchestration team builds the platform that enables Wayve’s teams to deploy, run, evaluate and continually improve machine-learning models. Processing petabytes of driving data across large GPU fleets, the team creates dependable, self-service capabilities that help model engineers understand model performance, improve quality and reduce operational effort and cost.

As our Staff Software Engineer, you’ll own the platform’s technical vision and long-term direction. You’ll combine hands-on engineering with cross-team technical leadership, shaping how model engineering, infrastructure, compute and data capabilities come together to accelerate model development.

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Own the technical vision and architecture for the end-to-end Data Enrichment Platform, translating user needs into a clear technical direction.

  • Lead the design, development and operation of backend services, APIs, model-execution workflows, versioned outputs, annotation capabilities and dataset catalogues.

  • Make architectural decisions for petabyte-scale data and large GPU fleets, addressing data locality, scheduling, capacity, backpressure, failure recovery, observability and cost.

  • Evaluate when to build, buy, reuse, integrate, consolidate or replace technologies as Wayve’s needs and the technology landscape evolve.

  • Establish clear technical boundaries and ownership across model engineering, AI Platform, infrastructure, compute, storage and data teams.

  • Remain hands-on while leading cross-team delivery, mentoring senior engineers and raising standards for maintainable, tested and observable software.

  • Drive adoption of reusable, self-service capabilities so teams can onboard and operate workflows independently.

  • Define measurable service levels and success metrics covering reliability, throughput, cost, automation and adoption.

🧩 What you’ll be working on

  • A scalable platform for large-scale inference, automated evaluation, model monitoring, active learning and retraining.

  • Self-service backend services and APIs that enable dozens of model engineers to deploy and operate repeatable workflows independently.

  • Reproducible dataset selection, versioned outputs, annotation workflows and dataset catalogues with clear metadata, provenance and lineage.

  • Reliable model-execution workflows operating across petabytes of driving data and large GPU fleets, scaling towards thousands of GPUs.

  • Monitoring and operational tooling that make model quality, platform reliability, throughput, cost, runtime and workflow status visible.

  • The foundations for continuous evaluation, drift detection and automated model-improvement loops across robotics and computer-vision workloads.

  • Architectural improvements that reduce inference costs, duplicate compute and manual operational effort.

🙌 You should apply if

  • You have owned the long-term technical direction of a complex, multi-system platform or capability and can demonstrate the measurable outcomes of your decisions.

  • You have strong production software-engineering experience in Python, building maintainable, tested and observable backend services, APIs and data-processing systems.

  • You have deep experience designing and operating large-scale distributed systems for data-intensive or compute-intensive workloads.

  • You have a track record of turning internal platforms into widely adopted, reliable and usable self-service products.

  • You bring excellent architecture and technology judgement, balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term platform direction.

  • You remain hands-on while leading delivery across organisational boundaries, influencing technical decisions and aligning teams around clear ownership and shared outcomes.

  • You communicate complex ideas clearly and have experience mentoring senior engineers and strengthening the technical capabilities of those around you.

  • Experience with workflow orchestration, batch inference, ML platforms, model deployment or registries would be an advantage. Relevant technologies include Flyte, Airflow, Dagster, Argo, Spark, Databricks, Ray, Kubernetes and GPU infrastructure.

  • Experience with annotation or dataset-catalogue platforms, including provenance, versioning, lineage and quality control, would also be valuable.

  • Experience with production robotics or computer-vision platforms—including annotation, inference, evaluation and model monitoring—is particularly desirable. Computer-vision research expertise is not required.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay!

If you’re passionate about autonomy and the impact you could make at Wayve, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end-to-end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real-world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand-coded rules or pre-mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once-in-a-generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human-driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware-agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2+ through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real-world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻 — Locations & Flexible Working

This role is based in London. Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

🔍 The Interview Process

Our process is clear and respectful of your time.

Initial call / Talent Partner screen (30 mins)

Competency interviews: Python coding (60 mins), System design (60 mins)

Deep Dive Interviews: Technical Leadership, Hiring Manager interview (45 mins)

Final interview: Mission, values and Staff-level calibration (45 mins)

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What’s in it for you (location dependent)

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually

📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long-term success of Wayve

✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable

✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands-on in vehicle workshops and labs

📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth

🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

Role - Senior Data Remediation Project Manager

Location - London (Hybrid)

Employment Type - 6 months FTC

Joining - Immediate

About the Role:

Delta Capita is seeking an experienced Senior Data Remediation Project Manager to lead a high-profile regulatory and customer remediation programme within the financial services sector. The successful candidate will be responsible for driving complex data remediation initiatives, coordinating multiple delivery workstreams, and ensuring the successful execution of large-scale remediation activities impacting customer data, operational processes, and technology landscapes.

This is a highly visible role requiring exceptional stakeholder management capabilities, strong programme governance experience, and a deep understanding of data, technology, and regulatory remediation environments.


Key Responsibilities:

• Lead the delivery of a large-scale data remediation programme within a regulated financial services environment.

• Consolidate multiple data-related workstream plans into a single integrated delivery roadmap, ensuring clear dependencies, milestones, risks, and governance are maintained.

• Drive execution across business, data, technology, operations, and change teams to ensure delivery objectives are met.

• Engage and influence senior stakeholders, including Executive leadership, Programme Sponsors, Risk, Compliance, Technology, and Operations teams.

• Assess and manage data remediation impacts across systems, data architecture, operating models, controls, and manual processes.

• Provide strong programme governance, tracking delivery progress, risks, issues, and remediation plans.

• Identify opportunities to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve remediation effectiveness, customer outcomes, and operational efficiency.

• Collaborate with technical teams to understand data lineage, data quality issues, system dependencies, and remediation approaches.

• Ensure remediation activities are aligned with regulatory expectations, governance standards, and customer outcome requirements.

• Support decision-making through robust reporting, stakeholder communications, and programme documentation.

Required Experience:

• Proven experience leading large-scale data remediation or regulatory remediation programmes within financial services.

• Strong project or programme management background with experience delivering complex, multi-workstream initiatives.

• Demonstrated ability to manage senior stakeholders and operate effectively within highly visible and regulated environments.

• Strong understanding of data remediation methodologies, data quality management, and data governance principles.

• Experience working across business, technology, data, and operational teams.

• Good understanding of technology architecture, system landscapes, data flows, and remediation impacts.

• Ability to build and manage integrated delivery plans across multiple parallel workstreams.

• Experience managing programme risks, dependencies, governance forums, and regulatory scrutiny.


Desirable Experience:

• Experience delivering customer remediation programmes within banking, lending, or retail financial services organisations.

• Knowledge of regulatory remediation, customer data management, conduct risk, or operational risk frameworks.

• Experience working on large-scale customer contact and claims remediation programmes, including PPI, complaints remediation, redress, or similar customer outcome initiatives.

• Understanding of AI use cases, automation opportunities, and advanced analytics within remediation and operational environments.

• Exposure to data lineage, data governance, and enterprise data management programmes.

Key Skills:

• Data Remediation

• Regulatory Remediation

• Programme & Project Management

• Senior Stakeholder Management

• Data Governance & Data Quality

• Delivery Planning & Execution

• Risk & Issue Management

• Financial Services Transformation

• AI & Innovation

• Technology & Data Architecture Awareness

• Customer Remediation Programmes

• Change Management

Why Join Delta Capita?

Delta Capita is a leading global consulting, managed services, and technology provider to the financial services industry. We partner with leading financial institutions to help solve complex operational, regulatory, and transformation challenges through innovative and outcome-focused solutions.

How We Work:  

Delta Capita is an equal opportunity employer. We positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of age, colour, disability, national origin, ancestry, race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require any reasonable adjustments through your interview process, please use the designated space within the application questionnaire.  

This is a fixed-term position located in London with hybrid working. As the selection and interview process is ongoing, please submit your application in English as soon as possible, if your profile is selected, a member of our team will contact you within 4 weeks. For this role, a valid working permit for the UK is mandatory.  

Who We Are:  

Delta Capita Group (a member of the Prytek Group) is a global managed services, consulting, and solutions provider with a unique combination of experience in Financial Services and technology innovation capability. Our mission is to reinvent the financial services value chain providing technology based mutualized services for financial institutions for non-differentiating services.  

Our 3 offerings are:  

  • Managed Services  

  • Consulting & Solutions  

  • Technology  

To know more about Delta Capita and our culture click here: Working at DC - Delta Capita.

The Role

You’ll own the whole lifecycle, analyze → design → implement → release → operate, applying systems thinking to model dependencies and identify leverage points in the system, making clear engineering decisions to turn ambiguity into shippable software.

You’ll collaborate directly with customers, clients, and teammates to clarify problems, present designs and trade-offs in writing and demos, and communicate crisply throughout execution.

What You’ll Do

  • Build with AI: use generative tools, evals, and our components; contribute new patterns back into our blueprint.

  • Engineer solutions and make decisions: evaluate trade-offs, pick patterns, make the architecture designs, develop and commit.

  • Pair daily with product and design; turn ambiguous problems into shippable increments.

  • Build scalable services, APIs, data pipelines, and frontends; instrument, observe, and optimize them in prod.

  • Own the solution. Reliability, scalability, performance, availability.

  • Work directly with the clients: clarify requirements, validate solutions, and close the loop. Fast.

  • Document clearly and present effectively to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Required Skills

  • Senior-level expertise in designing, engineering, and implementing large-scale solutions. Node.js + TypeScript, React/Next.js, PostgreSQL; Python; Rust or anything else of your taste

  • Data and systems fundamentals: schema design, pragmatic caching, event-driven architectures (Kafka/Redis)

  • Cloud and edge: AWS or Azure; Cloudflare (Workers/Durable Objects/KV) experience is excellent

  • Systems thinking mindset; comfortable writing specs, design docs, ADRs, etc.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to analyze, design, solution, and present

  • Experience building internal platforms or templates that speed up other engineers

Typical Stack

  • Languages / Frameworks: Node.js, TypeScript, Python, Rust or Ruby

  • Data: PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, Airflow

  • Messaging/Streaming/Workflows: Kafka, Temporal

  • Cloud / Edge: GCP, Azure or AWS is OK but our love goes to Cloudflare (Workers, Durable Objects, KV, R2, etc.)

  • Infra/Tooling: Docker, GitHub Actions, IaC (Terraform)

Perks and Benefits

  • Competitive salary + bonus; equity where applicable.

  • Up to 30 days PTO; public holidays (location-based); high-end laptop + tools; learning budget; extensive AI tooling.

  • Fully remote from the EU, the UK or the US, with occasional travel.

FAQ

Remote?

Yes, fully remote from anywhere in Germany after a successfull onboarding.

Visa?

Case by case.

Tech stack?

Whatever works; we prefer JS/TS + Python (see stack above). Rust or Ruby sometimes happens.

AI tools?

Extensively.

Work-life?

Work hard. Rest well. No weekends unless prod is on fire.

Growth path?

Build products → Lead practices → Build the company.

Who shouldn’t apply?

Process evangelists, architecture astronauts, meeting enthusiasts, or anyone needing constant supervision.

Equal Opportunity

We’re an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate only on the ability to ship great software.

description:
The Role

You’ll help build real products across the software lifecycle: understand the problem → design → implement → release → improve. You’ll take ownership of well-defined tasks and features, with guidance, code reviews, and feedback from experienced engineers.

You’ll work closely with engineering, product, and design, and join customer conversations to understand requirements and share progress. We value curiosity, systems thinking, and a practical approach to turning ideas into working software.

You don’t need to know our entire stack. Bring solid foundations, some hands-on experience, and the motivation to learn by building.

What You’ll Do

  • Build with AI: use generative tools, work with our reusable components, and help test and evaluate AI-powered features.
  • Contribute to engineering decisions: explore solutions, discuss trade-offs with the team, and implement practical approaches.
  • Ship useful features: work with product and design to turn requirements into manageable tasks and working software.
  • Work across the stack: contribute to services, APIs, data pipelines, and frontends, depending on your strengths and the project.
  • Build with quality in mind: write maintainable code, test your changes, and help improve reliability and performance with support from the team.
  • Collaborate with clients: join discussions, help clarify requirements, demo your work, and incorporate feedback alongside experienced teammates.
  • Communicate clearly: document your work, ask questions early, and keep the team informed about progress and blockers.

Required Skills

  • Currently enrolled at a university, ideally in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • Practical experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and some familiarity with Node.js and React/Next.js. Personal projects, coursework, internships, and open-source contributions all count.
  • Basic understanding of SQL and relational databases such as PostgreSQL, including how to structure and query data.
  • Familiarity with Git, APIs, debugging, and basic testing.
  • Interest in how systems fit together and a willingness to think through dependencies and trade-offs.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining your approach and documenting your work.
  • Initiative and follow-through: you can make progress on a defined task, use feedback, and ask for support when you need it.

Nice to Have

  • Some experience with Python, Rust, or Ruby.
  • Familiarity with caching, Redis, or event-driven systems such as Kafka.
  • First experience with AWS, Azure, GCP, or Cloudflare, especially Workers, Durable Objects, or KV.
  • Exposure to Docker, GitHub Actions, or infrastructure as code.
  • Experience with AI tools, evals, reusable components, internal tools, or project templates.
  • Experience writing short technical specs or documenting design decisions.

These are useful starting points. You’ll have opportunities to learn them on the job.

Typical Stack

You won’t be expected to work with every tool from day one.

  • Languages / Frameworks: Node.js, TypeScript, React/Next.js, Python; sometimes Rust or Ruby.
  • Data: PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, Airflow.
  • Messaging / Streaming / Workflows: Kafka, Temporal.
  • Cloud / Edge: GCP, Azure, or AWS; we particularly like Cloudflare—Workers, Durable Objects, KV, R2, and more.
  • Infra / Tooling: Docker, GitHub Actions, IaC with Terraform.

Perks and Benefits

  • Competitive compensation.
  • Paid time off aligned with your working schedule, plus applicable public holidays.
  • High-end laptop, learning budget, and extensive AI tooling.
  • Hands-on experience with real products, regular feedback, and support from experienced engineers.
  • Fully remote within Germany after successful onboarding.

description:
Das erwartet Dich

Caspar Health builds digital rehabilitation products that enable patients to continue their therapy beyond the clinic and help therapists support them more efficiently.

As a Senior Fullstack Engineer in our Healthcare Professionals Squad, you will build and improve the interface therapists use to manage their daily work. Working across our Ruby on Rails backend and React and TypeScript frontend, you will shape solutions with Product and Design and take them from an initial problem through to production.

You will join a cross-functional team of four engineers and a UX/UI Designer. Together, you will improve how healthcare professionals communicate with patients and deliver therapy—while shaping the architecture, reliability and maintainability of the underlying software.

We appreciate your expertise and wish to provide full transparency regarding the compensation range for this role. Your starting salary will be aligned with your qualifications, relevant experience, skill set, and market benchmarks. Remuneration for this position follows our internal salary bands and ranges from €76,000 to €82,000 gross annually (based on a full-time 40-hour work week).

This role is located in Germany and requires full physical presence within the country. Due to our existing payroll and social security framework, permanent remote employment from abroad is not supported. Candidates must be eligible to work in Germany and resident from their first day. Please be advised that we cannot offer visa sponsorship or relocation assistance at this time.

Deine Herausforderungen

In this role, you will:

  • Learn the workflows supported by our therapist interface, become familiar with our architecture and ship your first improvements during your first three months
  • Take ownership of larger full-stack features—from shaping requirements with Product and Design to implementation, testing, release and iteration
  • Build and improve features across our Ruby on Rails backend and React and TypeScript frontend
  • Make technical implementation decisions about code structure, testing approaches and incremental refactoring
  • Decide how to break down and deliver work within agreed priorities and engineering standards
  • Lead technical recommendations for changes affecting shared architecture, other teams or delivery commitments
  • Improve the therapist experience as well as the reliability and maintainability of the underlying software

Dein Profil

  • Several years of experience building and operating web applications in production
  • Strong experience with Ruby on Rails and experience with React and modern TypeScript
  • Strong understanding of relational databases (PostgreSQL), APIs, and testing
  • The ability to navigate ambiguous requirements, make sound technical trade-offs and turn problems into maintainable solutions
  • A product mindset: you seek to understand the intended outcome rather than treating implementation as an isolated task
  • The judgement and independence to take work from an initial problem through to a production result
  • Professional working proficiency in English

You do not need to meet every requirement perfectly. If the role interests you and you believe your experience could help us improve the platform, we encourage you to apply.

Warum Caspar Health?

  • Remote-first with flexible working hours – office optional in Berlin-Mitte or up to 90 days a year outside of Germany
  • To match this, we support you with a monthly home office allowance and an additional meal subsidy
  • Plenty of time to recharge – with 30 vacation days per year
  • Budget for learning & development, conferences, and coaching – tailored to your potential and growth opportunities
  • High level of ownership and decision-making freedom – no micromanagement. We hire experts who know what they’re doing. #MakeAnImpact!
  • Genuine collaboration – no silos, no egos. After all, we’re all working toward the same vision. #ValueFocus!
  • Access to all Caspar offerings for mental and physical well-being #HealthyTogether!
  • And yes – all the snacks your heart desires, group sports sessions, a never-empty drinks fridge, and a healthy dose of humor are included too

What defines us as a team

  • We live diversity – it's not a marketing slogan, it's part of our everyday reality
  • Feedback isn’t a tool – it’s part of our culture
  • We believe that technology only makes sense when it truly helps people
  • Our drive is purpose – but our standard is professionalism

description:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

We are looking for our first dedicated Senior Product/Application Security Engineer to build our AppSec practice from the ground up. This is a greenfield opportunity with a real attack surface: public partner-facing APIs and payment flows. You will own secure development, define what gets reviewed, implement security gates, build the "paved road" for ~150 engineers, and see the impact of your work in production within weeks.

What you will do:

  • Lead threat modeling and secure design reviews for high-risk changes, partner integrations, and payment flows.

  • Implement, tune, and enforce security gates in GitLab CI/CD (SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, and DAST) while minimizing developer friction.

  • Act as the primary technical owner for triaging, reproducing, and prioritizing findings from bug bounties, partner pentests, and automated scanners.

  • Work hands-on with the DevOps team to implement GCP organizational policies, IAM least-privilege architectures, and Cloud Armor (WAF/rate limiting).

  • Establish a security-champions network across engineering squads and leverage automation/AI-assisted tooling to scale code reviews effectively.

  • Own vulnerability management end to end: a risk-ranked backlog, remediation SLAs, an escalation path, and closing findings together with the teams.

  • Scope and coordinate the annual external penetration test and produce secure-development evidence for PCI-DSS and ISO 27001.


Workplace:

We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe and a HQ in Berlin.


Who you are:

  • You bring 5+ years in Product/Application Security (or 3+ years plus a strong software engineering/web-pentesting background), with a track record of true ownership.

  • You read and write production code (Python, Go, TypeScript, Ruby, etc.) and deeply understand web frameworks, CI/CD, and Kubernetes.

  • You have deep knowledge of web and API security, specifically authentication/authorization models (OAuth2, JWT), rate limiting, tenant isolation, IDOR, and XSS.

  • You have strong cloud security fundamentals (GCP preferred), specifically regarding public exposure, secrets hygiene, and WAF rules.

  • You have run threat modelling and secure design reviews on real systems (STRIDE or similar).

  • Hands-on with SAST/SCA/secrets scanning in CI (Aikido, Semgrep, Snyk or similar).

  • You prioritize by real-world risk, propose trade-offs rather than demanding perfection, and communicate complex risks plainly to engineers and leadership.

  • Bonus Points: You have experience securing high-volume, multi-tenant B2B APIs and utilizing AI tooling to accelerate triage and review.

What you can expect:

  • You will join a fast-paced travel tech company with a flat organizational structure.

  • You will have exciting opportunities, ownership, and responsibility and contribute directly to the success of the company.

  • You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day!

  • We have a flexible work policy with the option of working remotely and international opportunities arising as we continue to expand our global footprint – Our heart is in Berlin, but you’ll find us across the globe.

  • You will get a competitive salary.

Our hiring team for this role:
Your Talent Partner (TP) and point of contact is Lorena Rebenciuc, and the Hiring Manager (HM) is Ilya Isakov.

Wir sind MOUTH Propaganda aus Köln. Wir entwickeln und produzieren außergewöhnliche Produkte und Marketingkonzepte für Marken und Unternehmen. Von individuell gestalteten Eiskreationen bis hin zu kreativen Markeninszenierungen.

  • Vernetzung bestehender Systeme über APIs und Schnittstellen

  • Entwicklung einer zentralen digitalen Infrastruktur für Vertrieb, Produktion, Verwaltung und Marketing

The essentials

Team: Product & Engineering

Start date: As soon as possible

Location: Berlin — hybrid, 3 days in the office

Working language: English (German: a plus)

Salary band: Shared before your first interview

Your impact

As (Senior) Backend Engineer at Gymondo, you build and improve the scalable backend systems that power our platform for hundreds of thousands of active users. You work with a modern tech stack, establish new services using clean architecture principles, and help translate legacy concepts into maintainable, future-proof code. Your work directly shapes the technical foundation that enables Gymondo to grow — reliably, efficiently and at scale.

What you’ll drive

  • You build, improve and maintain scalable backend services using Golang and Gin-Gonic, following clean architecture and established design patterns

  • You design and implement REST APIs following OpenAPI standards, with a focus on clarity, reliability and long-term maintainability

  • You contribute to our microservice architecture — working on reliability, scaling, stateless applications and event-driven systems

  • You rebuild legacy concepts and translate them into well-known programming patterns with transparent and maintainable business logic

  • You develop data-driven features and are involved in all stages of the development process — from design to deployment

  • You work on our scalable, automated infrastructure using AWS, Kubernetes and Terraform

  • You participate in peer code reviews, write unit tests and champion agile development practices

  • You share knowledge, discuss better solutions openly and grow together with the team

What defines you

Must-have

  • 4+ years of professional experience in backend-focused development, including infrastructure

  • 3+ years contributing to microservice architectures with a focus on reliability, scaling, stateless applications, event-driven systems and clean architecture

  • 3+ years designing REST APIs following OpenAPI standards

  • Proven hands-on experience with Golang and Gin-Gonic

  • Ability to design proof of concepts and prototypes

  • Standardised coding practices: peer code reviews, unit testing and a preference for agile development

  • An open mindset and genuine interest in state-of-the-art technologies and methodologies

  • Fluent English

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with JVM languages (Kotlin / Java) and frameworks such as Ktor, Spring or Node.js

  • A Product Engineer mindset: balancing technical excellence with business impact, proactively identifying trade-offs that prioritise user value and speed-to-market without compromising long-term system health

  • Strong communication skills across the Product & Engineering team and additional stakeholders

  • A collaborative, humble approach — you promote good relationships in your guild and are always willing to learn from others

Our tech stack

Golang, Kotlin, Node.js, Java 17 · Gin-Gonic, Ktor, NestJS, Spring Boot · Elasticsearch, MySQL, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB, Redis · Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes · Event-Driven Architecture · AWS

Benefits

Success requires positive energy. That's why we ensure the right conditions are in place — physically, mentally, and within the team:

  • 🏖️ 30 days of vacation per year + Christmas Eve & New Year's Eve as additional paid days off

  • 🏠 Hybrid working model — 60% in the office, 40% from home, applicable to all working hours

  • 🌍 Up to 4 weeks of work from abroad per year (Berlin-based roles)

  • 🏋️ Free Urban Sports Club M membership & access to Nilo Health for mental health and personal development

  • 📱 Free access to 7Mind, Gymondo & Buddyfit — our own digital wellbeing products

  • 🚲 €30 monthly mobility budget via Navit

  • 🐶 Pet-friendly office — four-legged colleagues are very welcome!

These benefits apply to full-time and part-time permanent employees. Working students and interns receive a pro-rated selection.

People who make things happen

Gymondo is one of the leading digital fitness and nutrition platforms in the DACH region — with over 2,000 workouts, holistic training programmes and smart nutrition plans. As part of 7NXT Health Group, we help millions of people make movement a lasting part of their everyday lives.

Our team pushes each other, thinks critically and grows together. We take responsibility — for our users, our products and our planet.

Everyone counts

We welcome what makes you unique.

At Gymondo we believe in diversity, openness and team spirit. No matter which gender you identify with, whether you have a disability, what your neurotype is, where you come from, what you believe in or how you love — you are welcome here.

Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. The Role

That's why we're not looking for someone to implement tickets. We're looking for a Senior Mobile (iOS) Engineer who thinks like a product builder — someone who cares deeply about the "why" behind what they're building, challenges assumptions when needed, and proactively spots opportunities to create better outcomes.

You'll be embedded in a cross-functional domain team — Backend, Mobile, ML/AI, QA, Design, and Product — that owns a shared product area end-to-end. No handoff culture, no "not my layer": everyone in the team is solving the same customer problem, and you'll shape solutions from the first product conversation to the moment the feature is live in users' hands. Fewer silos means more flow — and real, end-to-end ownership.


What You Will Be Doing

Agentic development is table stakes at Finom — for every craft, mobile included. Our engineers work with Claude Code and similar harnesses daily, and we've made it a first-class part of how the company operates, not an individual productivity hack. We follow a shared SDLC approach built around Spec-Driven Development (SDD): features start as clear, reviewable specs that both humans and AI agents execute against, powered by a shared AI development toolbelt and a growing library of skills, rules, and context maintained across guilds. You won't be figuring out AI-assisted development alone — you'll join an engineering organization that has already invested in the infrastructure, standards, and shared practices, and you'll be expected to use them, improve them, and raise the bar for others.

Who You Are

You're pragmatic, learn quickly, and have a proven track record of shipping products that matter. Above all, you're curious — about the product, the users, the business, and how your technical decisions impact all three.

Curiosity. You want to understand the "why" behind every feature. You ask what problem it solves, question whether there's a simpler path, and explore how your decisions ripple into product, users, and revenue.

Nous recherchons un partenaire capable aussi bien d'optimiser des dispositifs existants que de construire une stratégie paid media de A à Z pour de nouvelles marques ou de nouveaux marchés. Cette première mission pourra déboucher sur une collaboration récurrente.

Vos missions

1. Audit et optimisation de l'existant

  • Auditer les comptes Google Ads, Meta Ads et TikTok Ads.

  • Identifier les principaux freins à la performance (tracking, structure des campagnes, ciblages, créas, audiences, budget, attribution).

  • Construire un plan d'actions priorisé selon l'impact business, puis le mettre en œuvre.

  • Suivre les performances et formuler de nouvelles recommandations.

2. Amplification des contenus créateurs

  • Sélectionner les contenus UGC et créateurs à fort potentiel publicitaire.

  • Mettre en place les autorisations (Spark Ads, whitelisting, Partnership Ads) avec les créateurs.

  • Tester les hooks, formats et angles, puis industrialiser ce qui performe.

3. Construction d'une stratégie d'acquisition sur un nouveau marché

Sur l'un des projets, vous définirez et déploierez une stratégie d'acquisition payante sur les réseaux sociaux pour accompagner le lancement d'un concept sur le marché américain : choix des plateformes et des formats, architecture des campagnes, audiences, premiers tests, optimisation continue.

Selon les projets, la mission pourra évoluer vers un pilotage mensuel des campagnes.

Nous recherchons un profil senior, opérationnel, qui pilote lui-même les comptes.

  • Indispensable : une expérience réelle des Spark Ads, du whitelisting ou des Creator Ads, avec des résultats à montrer.

  • Une excellente maîtrise de Meta Ads et TikTok Ads.

  • Une solide expérience sur Google Ads (Search, Shopping, Performance Max).

  • Un tracking propre : GA4, GTM, Pixel, API Conversions.

  • Une approche orientée rentabilité : ROAS, CPA, marge.

  • Une expérience de marques e-commerce D2C (cosmétique, beauté, nutrition, santé) sera particulièrement appréciée, tout comme une expérience à l'international.

Conditions

  • Mission freelance, 350 à 380 € par jour selon profil.

  • 100 % à distance, depuis l'Europe : nous travaillons sur le fuseau de Paris et les échanges se font en journée (UTC-1 à UTC+3).

  • Statut d'indépendant en règle.

Pour postuler

Merci de nous donner un résultat chiffré avant / après sur une campagne que vous avez pilotée (ROAS, CPA ou CAC, budget mensuel, période). Les candidatures sans aucun chiffre ne seront pas étudiées.

Joignez aussi :

  • deux ou trois références de missions similaires, idéalement avec des contenus créateurs ;

  • votre niveau sur Google Ads, Meta Ads et TikTok Ads ;

  • votre disponibilité pour démarrer.

At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

About the role

Join a growing data team and take ownership of our tracking data infrastructure, which captures millions of user events across our web platform every day.

You will focus on operating, improving, and scaling existing data systems, ensuring data is reliable, cost-efficient, and accessible for analytics teams.

This is a hands-on role with strong ownership and visibility across engineering and analytics.

What you’ll do

  • Own and manage tracking data pipelines and infrastructure (event data, web tracking)

  • Ensure data quality, governance, and cost control (e.g. retention, storage optimization)

  • Build and optimize ELT pipelines using Python and SQL

  • Improve data ingestion and orchestration (Airflow, Prefect, APIs, S3, Iceberg, databases)

  • Support the shift toward streaming and modern analytics use cases

  • Collaborate with engineering teams (data producers) and analytics teams (data consumers)

  • Enable internal users by making data reliable, well-documented, and easy to use

Your profile

  • Experience in data engineering within cloud environments (AWS preferred)

  • Strong skills in Python and SQL

  • Hands-on experience with data pipelines, orchestration tools (Airflow, Prefect), and APIs

  • Familiarity with large-scale data systems and event-based data (tracking, logs, or similar)

  • Experience with Snowflake (or similar DWH)

  • Knowledge of infrastructure as code (Terraform) and CI/CD (GitHub Actions)

  • Understanding of data architecture, testing, and best practices

  • Bonus: experience with DBT, streaming tools, or BI tools

What success looks like

  • You take ownership of a high-volume data domain and keep it stable and scalable

  • You improve data reliability, usability, and cost efficiency

  • You collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • You bring structure to evolving systems while staying flexible in a dynamic environment

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

  • Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year

  • Hybrid work and flex-time

  • International team and social events

  • Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options

  • Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

  • Career & training opportunities

  • Attractive locations and modern offices

  • Mental health support with OpenUp

Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above.

Der Fachkräftemangel ist real, die Digitalisierung in diesem Bereich steckt noch in den Kinderschuhen, und die Lösungen, die es heute gibt, sind nicht für die Nutzer gebaut, die sie eigentlich brauchen.

Das wollen wir ändern.

Wir bauen gerade eine digitale Plattform auf, die den medizinischen Arbeitsmarkt im DACH-Raum neu strukturiert. Datengetrieben, mobil-first, mit einem klaren Fokus auf echten Nutzen fuer Praxen und Bewerber. Du entwickelst und pflegst eine skalierbare Web-Plattform auf Basis von Next.js und Django. Du baust die Datenbankstruktur in PostgreSQL und Supabase mit auf. Frontend: Next.js (React), App Router, SSG/ISR

Datenbank: PostgreSQL und Supabase

Deployment: Vercel und Cloud-Infrastruktur

description:
About ScholarshipOwl

ScholarshipOwl is the largest scholarship marketplace in the US, using AI to connect 14 million students who are looking for scholarships with companies that are looking for students. Our mission is to make education financing more accessible and engaging, while giving brands a way to connect with the next generation.

We’re powered by AI technology that simplifies scholarship discovery, streamlines the application process, and delivers measurable results for both students and partners. Whether it’s helping students secure funding or enabling brands to run impactful campaigns, we’re reshaping how education is funded — and discovered.


The Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled and innovative Senior Full-Stack Engineer to architect high-performance web applications and accelerate our development velocity across our B2B platform. You’ll play a pivotal role in bridging modern Nuxt 3/4 frontend applications—including customer management portals and embeddable widget engines—with a robust Laravel and Doctrine ORM backend API, delivering seamless experiences that connect millions of students to funding opportunities.

You will own the technical implementation of core products across our entire stack, working with PHP 8.2+, Laravel, MySQL, and Vue 3 / Nuxt 3/4. Beyond traditional engineering, this role champions efficiency: you will deeply integrate AI-native workflows (using tools like Cursor and Google Gemini) to double shipping velocity, automate test coverage, and build intelligent LLM-driven platform features. If you are passionate about full-stack architecture, widget infrastructure, and leveraging AI to build smarter and faster, this role is for you.


What You’ll Do

  • Full Lifecycle Development: Architect, build, and ship end-to-end B2B features across the stack- from Laravel/Doctrine JSON:API endpoints to reactive Nuxt 3/4 Vue components and server routes.

  • Embed & Analytics Engine: Develop and optimize high-performance embedded widget systems, Nitro server engine logic, iframe cross-origin messaging, client event-tracking SDKs, and data ingestion pipelines.

  • API & Database Architecture: Design robust relational database schemas (MySQL), Doctrine entity mappings, clean migrations, performant RESTful/JSON:API contracts, and Redis caching layers.

  • AI-Native Acceleration: Integrate AI coding tools (Cursor, Gemini) into daily development for rapid feature prototyping, code refactoring, test generation, and building LLM-driven product features (e.g., automated applicant evaluation).

  • Third-Party Integrations*:* Integrate and maintain core third-party services and APIs, including CRM platforms, error tracking systems, payment gateways, and cloud data services

  • Automated Testing & Quality: Establish comprehensive automated test coverage (PHPUnit for backend, Playwright and Vitest for E2E/components) integrated into CI/CD pipelines to guarantee zero regressions.

  • Mentorship & Code Reviews: Conduct thorough, constructive code reviews and collaborate closely with product managers, QA engineers, and leadership to elevate team standards.


Required Qualifications (Must Haves)

  • Experience: 4+ years of professional full-stack web development experience, with at least 1+ year actively incorporating AI coding assistants into daily engineering workflows.

  • Backend Expertise (PHP & Laravel): Strong commercial experience with PHP 8+ and Laravel (clean service architecture, queues/jobs, middleware, and OAuth2/Passport authentication).

  • Frontend Mastery (Vue 3 & Nuxt 3/4): Deep proficiency in modern Vue 3 (Composition API), Nuxt 3 or Nuxt 4, TypeScript, Pinia state management, and Tailwind CSS.

  • Database & ORM Skills: Strong relational database modeling and query optimization in MySQL, along with solid experience using ORMs (Doctrine ORM / DBAL or deep Eloquent experience with the ability to adapt to Doctrine quickly).

  • API Design & Caching: Deep understanding of RESTful / JSON:API standards, server-side validation error mapping, request formatting, and Redis performance caching.

  • AI-Native Workflow: Active daily use of AI coding tools (Cursor, Gemini) as a force multiplier for coding, debugging, and test creation.

  • Automated Testing: Hands-on experience writing backend test suites (PHPUnit) and frontend/E2E tests (Playwright, Vitest, or Cypress).

  • DevOps & Tooling: Solid working knowledge of Git, CI/CD release pipelines, Docker containerization, and Linux/container environments.

  • Async Communication & Autonomy: Exceptional written technical communication skills for authoring PRs, architectural design docs, and issue tracking; high autonomy to navigate multi-service codebases, solve complex blockers independently, and drive initiatives.

Good to Have

  • Education & Background: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical software engineering experience.

  • Certifications*:* Advanced degree or formal certifications in Cloud Architecture, Modern Software Engineering, or AI Engineering.

  • Doctrine ORM: Direct production experience with Doctrine ORM / DBAL in Laravel environments.

  • Widget & SDK Systems: Experience developing embeddable web widgets, lightweight JavaScript tracking SDKs, iframe cross-origin communication, or browser fingerprinting.

  • Modern Tooling: Experience with Nitro server engines, Bun runtime, PrimeVue components, or streaming data into data warehouses (e.g., BigQuery).

  • Payment Gateways: Integration experience with payment processors (Stripe/Braintree) and B2B subscription billing lifecycles.

  • Gemini LLM Integration: Practical experience integrating Google Gemini models (prompt engineering, structured JSON outputs, Gemini API / SDKs).

  • Cloud Infrastructure (GCP): Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Kubernetes, Cloud Build).

    Bonus Skills (The "X-Factor")

    • Technical Leadership: Prior experience in a Tech Lead or Team Lead capacity—driving architectural decisions, coordinating delivery, and unblocking team members.

    • Domain Knowledge: Background in high-growth B2B SaaS platforms, grant/applicant management systems, EdTech, recruitment/ATS tools, or conversion tracking ecosystems.

    • Product-Minded Execution: Strong product ownership mindset—evaluating engineering trade-offs through the lens of user experience, conversion funnel impact, and tangible business value.


Why Join ScholarshipOwl?

  • Mission-Driven Work: Build technology that helps students unlock education opportunities and reduce financial barriers.

  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in the world while collaborating with a global team.

  • High Impact & Ownership: You aren't just a cog in a machine; you own your domain and directly drive results.

  • Computer Upgrade Budget: Up to $1,600 to invest in your ideal primary work computer.

  • Workspace Upgrade Program: Up to $800 to set up your home office.

  • Monthly Coworking Allowance: $200/month to rent desks or workspace passes whenever you want a change of scenery.

  • Owl Shine Program: Monthly employee recognition and awards celebrating extraordinary contributions.

  • Continuous Learning Culture: Dedicated support for curiosity, bold experimentation, and career growth.

  • Annual Global Off-sites: Connect with your teammates in person at exciting locations around the world.

Ready to lead and build something meaningful?

Apply now and help us shape the future of AI-powered education.

description:
eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Quantum computing is a new computing paradigm rapidly approaching commercial viability. Our unique approach combines laser-cooled trapped ions with microwave control and tailored magnetic fields. Our next-generation computing machines under development will be able to find solutions to problems that are out of reach today, thus enabling new innovative products and services for a brighter future.


Role Overview:

We are looking for a Senior IT Infrastructure, Network & Secure Access Engineer to support and evolve our internal IT environment at eleQtron.
This is a hands-on role focused on implementing and operating secure, scalable IT systems across multiple locations.
In this role, you will act as the primary IT representative for our Hamburg site, working across infrastructure, networking, secure access, and engineering environments to support both research and business operations.
You will work closely with IT Leadership to execute eleQtron's infrastructure, networking, and secure access strategy.

Responsibilities: 

  • Implement and operate IT infrastructure across cloud, network, endpoint, and secure access environments

  • Act as the primary IT contact and technical representative for the Hamburg site while supporting users and infrastructure across all eleQtron locations 

  • Implement and maintain monitoring, observability, and alerting solutions across infrastructure, networks, engineering platforms, development systems, and secure access environments 

  • Support Microsoft 365 services, Azure infrastructure, identity management, and endpoint management platforms (Intune, Autopilot, Entra ID)

  • Support and maintain internal development platforms, including GitLab, CI/CD environments, and license servers

  • Design, implement, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure, including switching, segmentation, wireless networking, and secure connectivity 

  • Support secure access solutions, including Microsoft Global Secure Access, Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), VPN technologies, and identity-based access 

  • Support the integration of engineering systems, laboratory environments, and customer deployments, including secure connectivity and site integration activities  

  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, networking, and connectivity issues

  • Contribute to documentation, operational procedures, and the continuous improvement of IT systems and services


Required Skills:

  • 4–7 years of experience in IT infrastructure, network engineering, or similar technical roles

  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, endpoint management, and cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure

  • Solid understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, VLANs, routing, switching, and network segmentation 

  • Experience with enterprise networking technologies such as Palo Alto, Aruba, HPE/HP, or equivalent enterprise platforms   

  • Understanding of modern security concepts, including MFA, Conditional Access, Zero Trust, and identity-based access 

  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills

  • A structured, hands-on approach with the ability to work independently and take ownership

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with GitLab, CI/CD, or DevOps platforms

  • Experience with PowerShell, Bash, or other scripting and automation tools

  • Experience with Microsoft Global Secure Access, ZTNA, Zscaler, WireGuard, OpenVPN, or similar solutions

  • Experience supporting engineering, laboratory, manufacturing, or customer environments

  • Experience with monitoring platforms such as Grafana, Prometheus, Azure Monitor, or Microsoft Sentinel

  • Microsoft certifications (AZ-104, AZ-500, SC-300, MD-102, or equivalent)


Why Join Us:

  • Work in a cutting-edge quantum technology company 

  • Be part of building a modern, secure, and scalable IT environment from the ground up 

  • Take on a hands-on role with real impact across infrastructure, networking, engineering, and secure access systems

  • Help build the IT foundation supporting world-class quantum research and future commercial quantum platforms


What You Can Expect from eleQtron:

  • Competitive salary: We value our team members and therefore provide remunerations that reflect this, additionally rewarding achievements.

  • Flexible working hours: We offer personal freedom through a variety of flexible work schedules.

  • Team spirit: In our international and diverse team, and with our regular team events, having fun at work is simply part of the game.

  • Further development: We want to grow together and so we offer our team members’ needs-based, individualized further training as well as plenty of room for personal development.

  • Wellness Package: We offer health-promoting benefits such as fitness programs like UrbanSportsClub to support your well-being.

  • Moving Benefits: A warm welcome! We are happy to support employees who move for us with a bonus.

  • At the forefront: Work at the forefront of technology, where academic research meets commercial applications.

  • Modern workplace: We have a high-quality infrastructure with laboratory space, offices, and meeting rooms.


How to Apply:

If you enjoy hands-on infrastructure and network engineering and want to contribute to building secure and scalable systems in a deep-tech environment, we would love to hear from you.

description:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

We are now looking for an ambitious Engineering Manager - Robot Intelligence (m/f/d) to help us establish RobCo as a leading provider of autonomous automation solutions.

In this key role, you will lead the “brain” of our autonomous robots - the physical AI harness that works with different models and skills. Managing a full-stack team of software and machine learning engineers, you will balance applied research with business value delivery on a daily basis.

Your mission is to translate the latest advancements in physical AI foundation models and complex robotic functionality into a stable, scalable product that thrives in real-world factory environments.

Your Responsibilities:

  • Drive Engineering Excellence: Set rigorous standards for code quality, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines to ensure 24/7 reliability of our robots.

  • Lead Senior Talent: Act as a people-first leader for a team of Senior and Staff engineers, fostering a culture of high ownership and steady delivery.

  • Bridge Software and Hardware: Oversee the lifecycle of products spanning from ML training, AI inference to Linux-based industrial interfaces.

  • Balance Research and Delivery: Establish a strong applied research and experimentation culture, and build a process where the results directly contribute to delivery and practical outcomes.

  • Management Framework: Work with real-time metrics and steer the team to continuously improve productivity, predictability and quality of what we ship.

  • Operational Governance: Manage technical debt and architectural health to ensure long-term system stability as we scale.

  • Strategic Alignment: Partner with Product Management to transform customer needs into concrete technical requirements and actionable sprints.

  • Cross-Team Leadership: Mentor junior EMs and help evolve company-wide engineering best practices and software-first principles.

We are looking for someone who has:

  • Completed a university degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Engineering, Data Science or a related field.

  • 3+ years of experience leading high-performing teams in complex technical environments like robotics or industrial IoT.

  • Deep experience with AI and machine learning, including dataset curation, model training and optimization techniques and hands on experience building agentic harnesses.

  • Proven track record of driving an AI-first engineering culture and implementing agentic workflows that measurably accelerate team velocity and system efficiency.

  • Expert knowledge in modern SDLC practices, with a track record of improving deployment frequency and system stability.

  • Culture-aligned mindset characterized by hardware empathy, a passion for software-defined hardware, and a strong culture of high ownership.

  • Strong experience with full-stack software development, robotics engineering is a big plus.

  • Very good English skills with the ability to navigate complex architectural discussions with Staff engineers while clearly communicating risks to stakeholders.

Why join RobCo?

  • Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

  • Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

  • As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

  • Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

  • Wellpass membership (7,200+ studios across Germany), regular team events, and a team that takes both the work and the culture seriously.

  • Flexible working hours, a modern office, and - depending on the role - the option to work from home.

  • Regular team events - from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that adapts to your use case, improves over time, and requires zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. With $160M raised from investors including Lightspeed, Lingotto Innovation, and Sequoia, 200+ people globally, and 2.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our RobCo Bay Area Demo Lab in San Francisco.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At RobCo, applicants are selected regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements.

description:
About RA

Resident Advisor has been a home for electronic music culture since 2001. Event discovery, ticketing, news and long-form editorial, artist profiles, original films, and a weekly mix series two decades deep. Around 7 million people use the web platform every month, with a wider audience across our apps and other channels. Underneath the platform sits a network of contributors and city managers across dozens of cities, which is how we stay connected to the scenes we cover rather than reporting on them from a distance. RA is 25 years old, independent, B.Corp certified and intent on being indispensable to the artists, promoters and audiences who make this culture.

Purpose of the role

As our Senior QA Engineer, you'll look after the quality of ra.co, our iOS and Android apps, and RA Scan, the app promoters use to scan tickets at the door. You'll work across five product teams. Each team writes and runs its own tests. You'll help them do it well, keep the automated test suites healthy, and test the riskiest releases yourself.

Some of what we ship carries real risk: payments, checkout, and getting people into venues on the night. Other changes are a line of copy. You'll help us tell the two apart and test each one accordingly. We use AI tools across development, and you'll help the teams use them to write better tests, faster.

Key responsibilities

  • Keep the web end-to-end test suite healthy: fix flaky tests, add coverage for new features, and make sure a failing suite gets fixed quickly
  • Grow automated testing for our iOS and Android apps and RA Scan with the app developers, so mobile tests run on every change
  • Test high-risk releases yourself, such as payments and checkout, including edge cases and what happens when things fail
  • Review the test plans teams write, and help them improve
  • Use AI tools to write and maintain tests, help developers do the same, and check what the tools produce
  • Brief our external testing partner and review the results they send back
  • Report bugs clearly, and follow them through with developers and product managers
  • Track a few simple measures, such as bugs that reach production and how reliable the automated tests are

We’re looking for

  • Several years in QA or test engineering, typically four or more, testing web and mobile products
  • Hands-on test automation: you've built and maintained automated tests that run in CI, for web (for example Playwright, Cypress or Selenium) and ideally mobile. We use XCUITest on iOS and Espresso with Kotlin on Android
  • Enough coding to write and fix tests alongside developers, in a language such as JavaScript, TypeScript, Kotlin or Swift
  • You can test APIs and check data with SQL
  • Good judgement about risk: what to test deeply, what lightly, and what not at all
  • You've used AI tools in your testing work, and know where they help and where they don't
  • Clear writing: bug reports and test plans other people can act on

If you meet most of these but not all, we'd still like to hear from you. Nobody arrives with all of it, and we'll help you grow into the rest.

Nice to have

  • CircleCI or a similar CI tool
  • Working with an external testing partner
  • Payments, checkout or ticketing systems
  • Testing apps used at live events, with poor networks
  • Test management tools such as Qase or TestRail

What we offer you

  • Generous annual leave policies aimed at promoting work-life balance.
  • Matched pension, or 401k for US staff.
  • Comprehensive staff wellbeing initiatives, featuring regular activities and workplace programmes to support mental and physical health. This includes discounted ClassPass memberships and custom-fitted earplugs.
  • Company-led social events, team lunches, and discounts on merch.

description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

About the Role

As Data Engineer on our Healthcare Platform, you will own the foundational data ingestion, entity-resolution, and platform infrastructure end-to-end. You will design and operate scalable batch/streaming data pipelines, harden platform orchestration, and ensure system reliability, security, and cost efficiency.

A central challenge of this role is building and operationalizing our unified healthcare data ontology—a consistent semantic model covering hospitals, departments, specialties, metrics, and classification standards. Working closely with Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, and Methodology experts, you will turn heterogeneous, multi-country hospital data into a coherent, highly queryable data asset.

Key Responsibilities

  • Pipeline Infrastructure & Orchestration: Build, optimize, and operate reliable ELT pipelines (using Python, SQL, and Prefect/Airflow) to ingest data from heterogeneous international sources, APIs, databases, and lakehouse storage (S3, Apache Iceberg).

  • Healthcare Ontology & Entity Resolution: Drive the implementation of entity resolution and master data management (MDM) for international hospital entities, mapping raw source data to canonical structures and maintaining standardized vocabularies (e.g., ICD/OPS, specialty taxonomies).

  • Data Contracts & Schema Governance: Establish strict data contracts (Pydantic, dbt contracts) and schema management, ensuring dataset reproducibility, data lineage tracking, and automated validation across all platform pipelines.

  • Platform Efficiency & Cloud Infrastructure: Optimize data storage, query execution, and compute costs across AWS and Snowflake, keeping data assets performant, secure, and cost-effective.

  • Automation & CI/CD: Implement automated testing and deployment workflows for data pipelines using GitHub Actions and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).

  • Cross-Functional Data Enablement: Partner directly with Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, and domain experts to deliver documented, research-grade, and production-ready datasets.

Qualifications

Core Requirements (Must-Haves)

  • Data Ingestion & Pipeline Orchestration: Advanced Python and analytical SQL for complex data ingestion across diverse file formats, REST APIs, databases, and cloud lakes (S3/Iceberg). Hands-on experience with modern orchestrators (Prefect, Airflow, or Dagster).

  • Entity Resolution & Data Governance: Practical experience with entity resolution/record linkage frameworks (e.g., Splink, dedupe, recordlinkage) and schema management/data contracts (Pydantic, dbt contracts, or JSON Schema).

  • Cloud Platform & Warehouse Infrastructure: Deep hands-on experience in an AWS production environment (S3, ECS/EC2) combined with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake).

  • Automated CI/CD & Workflow Automation: Proven track record of automating data pipeline deployments, integration tests, and validation workflows via GitHub Actions.

Nice-to-Haves (What Will Make You Stand Out)

  • Knowledge Graphs & Healthcare Terminologies: Exposure to ontology/semantic frameworks (RDF/OWL, SKOS, Neo4j, LinkML) or international medical classifications/vocabularies (SNOMED CT, ICD/OPS, FHIR).

  • Metadata & Lineage Tooling: Experience operating metadata registries and lineage catalogs (e.g., OpenMetadata, DataHub, dbt docs).

  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Proficiency in using Terraform to declaratively manage cloud resources and environments.

Your Profile

  • Degree: Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

  • Experience: 3+ years in data engineering building production pipelines and data platforms; including a sustained period within one organization seeing a core platform or product through build → launch → iteration.

  • Domain Knowledge: Healthcare domain experience is a plus (basic understanding of healthcare KPIs, quality metrics, or benchmarking concepts; familiarity with hospital structures and medical classification systems like ICD/OPS is especially valuable).

  • Mindset: Strong analytical and systems mindset, with a proven ability to transform messy, heterogeneous international data into a clean, well-governed, and highly structured data asset.

  • Languages: Fluent in English, German is a plus.

  • Working Style: Highly structured, curious, detail-oriented, and motivated to collaborate closely with analytics engineers, data scientists, and methodology experts in an international environment.

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

  • Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year

  • Hybrid work and flex-time

  • International team and social events

  • Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options

  • Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

  • Career & training opportunities

  • Attractive locations and modern offices

  • Mental health support with OpenUp

Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above.

description:
About

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 

Role

Build and improve ML systems that power our AI-native applications.

Work on classification, retrieval, ranking, personalization and evaluation, taking ownership from model development to production deployment.

This role is for engineers who enjoy solving practical ML problems, improving model quality and shipping reliable systems used by real users.

 

Focus

  • Build and improve ML models for classification, ranking, retrieval and personalization.

  • Develop efficient classifiers and optimize model accuracy, precision, latency and cost.

  • Improve search relevance and context retrieval using embeddings, hybrid search and reranking.

  • Build personalization models that learn from user behavior while respecting privacy.

  • Develop evaluation pipelines, labeled datasets and metrics to measure model quality.

  • Fine-tune and adapt existing models when supported by sufficient data.

  • Build and maintain ML training, inference and deployment pipelines.

  • Debug production issues, monitor model performance and ship improvements based on real-world feedback.

 

Tech Stack

  • Python

  • PyTorch / JAX

  • Embeddings, vector search and ranking models

  • Production ML systems and inference pipelines

 

Ideal Experience

  • Strong foundations in machine learning and modern neural architectures.

  • Hands-on experience building and deploying ML models in production.

  • Experience in classification, ranking, retrieval, recommendation systems or personalization.

  • Understanding of model evaluation, experimentation and performance metrics.

  • Comfortable writing production-quality code and working with real-world datasets.

  • Able to balance model quality, latency, cost and reliability.

  • Strong ownership, problem-solving skills

 

Outcomes

  • ML models in production meet expected accuracy, relevance, latency and reliability targets.

  • Classification and ranking improvements deliver measurable gains in model quality.

  • Evaluation pipelines identify regressions and support reliable model releases.

  • Training, inference and data pipelines are robust, reproducible and maintainable.

  • Model improvements are driven by real-world feedback and measurable results.

  • Collaborates effectively with engineering and product teams to deliver reliable ML-powered features.

 

How We Work

The best products in the world are built by small, world-class teams. We are a high-talent-density, hands-on team. We make decisions collectively and move quickly, balancing high-quality work with continuous learning.

Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment and execute independently. Our goal is to put a truly magical product into the hands of our users.

 

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted virtually and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us.
