description:
Hybrid working one day per week in our London, Edinburgh or Bath office.

About us

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

 

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.

 

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

 

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

 

If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

 

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

 

The role

Seccl is growing fast, and so is the opportunity to make better use of our data. Our Data Engineering team has built strong foundations for reliable, scalable data delivery, and we’re now expanding our capabilities to make that data more accessible, actionable, and valuable to our teams and clients.

As a Data Analytics Engineer, you’ll sit at the intersection of data engineering and analytics. You’ll use strong software engineering and data modelling practices to develop production-quality datasets, while working closely with stakeholders to understand how data can help solve real business problems.

You’ll also help us evolve how data moves through our platform, including opportunities to work with streaming and event-driven technologies as we move towards more timely and incremental data processing.

 

On a typical day you will be…

  • Designing, building, and maintaining robust data models using SQL and DBT, transforming complex source data into clear, reusable datasets for analytics and downstream consumers

  • Working with Product managers, Engineers, Operations, and client-facing teams to understand requirements, clarify business logic, and translate problems into scalable data solutions

  • Helping define and maintain consistent metrics, modelling standards, and analytical best practices across the business

  • Supporting our journey towards more real-time and incremental data processing, including working with technologies such as MongoDB change streams, Kafka, and AWS MSK

  • Helping teams become more self-sufficient with data by making datasets understandable, well documented, and easy to consume

You’ll be successful in this role if you…

  • Have strong SQL and data modelling skills and are comfortable transforming large, complex datasets into reliable, reusable analytical models

  • Have experience with Python and modern analytics engineering tooling such as DBT, including testing, documentation, version control, and CI/CD practices

  • Are familiar with both relational and non-relational database architecture

  • Understand dimensional modelling and how to design datasets that are intuitive and effective for analytics, BI, and downstream data products

  • Have experience working with cloud data platforms and services, ideally within AWS

  • Ideally have experience with event-driven or streaming data architectures, particularly Kafka/AWS MSK, MongoDB change streams, CDC, or similar technologies

  • Have hands on experience working with an orchestration tool such as Airflow

  • Thrive in cross-functional collaboration, working effectively with Product managers, Engineers, Operations, analysts, and client facing teams

  • Communicate clearly and can explain technical concepts and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Take ownership of problems end-to-end, from understanding the requirement and designing the solution through to implementation, validation, documentation, and adoption

This role isn’t for you if:

  • You rely on heavily on top-down direction. Here, you’ll have a freedom and ownership early on – it’s up to you to shape your growth and deliver outcomes

  • You’re uncomfortable in a fast-paced environment. Our ability to move quickly and scale effectively is key to our success – we need people who can adapt and think on their feet

  • You struggle to follow through on ideas. We value people who not only think big, but also deliver

  • You resist change. We’re growing quickly, and the environment can be ambiguous – you’ll thrive here if you see change as an opportunity rather than a hurdle

What’s in it for you…

We offer a generous blend of benefits for the things that really matter to our people, including:

💰A salary between £55,000 and £75,000 – dependant on experience + reviewed annually

🌴27 days holiday + bank holidays (some can be flexible) + day off on your birthday + three days (full time) per year for Dependant leave

💙 Two volunteering days per year

🏅 Length of service award – one month paid sabbatical at eight years

✅ 6% employer pension contribution, and life assurance

🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

👪 Enhanced Parental leave

💻 MacBook and up to £500 home office set up budget

📖 £750 per person learning budget

🌎 Option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

🌻 Health and wellbeing initiatives including free therapy via Wellness Cloud, mental health support via Headspace

🌱 Strong financial wellbeing focus including access to Octopus Money, Octopus Share Incentive Plan, will writing offering via Octopus Legacy and Seccl invest (our own platform for you to manage your investments)

🎁 Perkbox – Flexi-points giving you a range of discounts and perks including free weekly coffee, gym and retail discounts.

🚲 Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

Our culture

We're proud to put people first, creating a culture where we truly listen to what matters most to them. Our transparent and inclusive environment encourages diversity of thought, challenge and experimentation.

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

Interview process

Interviewing is a two-way thing, and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you. Our interviews are conversational, so come with questions and be curious. In general, you can expect the interview process to look a bit like this:

  • Talent screen - 30 mins

  • First round - 40 mins

  • Second round - 60 mins

  • Bar raiser - 40 mins

⏳ We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out and you should expect to hear back from us within one to two weeks of applying.

🌈 Our aim is to build a diverse and inclusive company of awesome people, with unique skills, passions and experiences. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If this sounds like your kind of thing, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to hear from you!

description:
This is the senior computer vision engineering authority for Hawk-Eye's tracking technology, and it is an individual contributor role.

Our tracking sits underneath almost everything Hawk-Eye sells. Goal-line technology, semi-automated offside, electronic line calling, automated ball-strike. Live and post-game data. It runs across football, baseball, tennis, American football, ice hockey, cricket, basketball and rugby, on-premise, in the cloud and increasingly on edge devices, delivered by over 100 engineers in the Tracking and Automated Officiating value stream.

You would be the person who decides how that is built. The role carries two hats. As Software Architect you own the software-level architectural design across tracking, auto-officiating and data delivery. As computer vision authority you lead the core domains: camera calibration, ball tracking, skeletal tracking, and the R&D that feeds them.

It is a hands-on job. You set architecture for new tracking problems as they arrive, you safeguard the shared frameworks, and when a live delivery is at risk you are the escalation point who gets into the code.

What you would own

Architecture across the value stream. You are the lead architect for every tracking and auto-officiating product in T&AO. You set the initial architecture when a new tracking problem enters the business, run the Software Domain Owner model so shared libraries like calibration have named codeowners, and keep designs consistent across sports. You represent tracking in the Engineering Architecture Steering group and feed into architecture conversations across Hawk-Eye and the wider Sony Sports organisation.

Part of that is judgement about reuse. Keeping value streams on a common tracking codebase pays off until it doesn't, and knowing where that line sits is the job.

Computer vision direction. You are the subject matter authority. You decide where our vision processing and ML integration goes next, research new tracking technologies and bring them in, and build prototypes when a proposal needs proving rather than describing.

Modern tooling, properly evaluated. We want agentic coding frameworks, LLM-driven development tools and automated code generation working inside heavy C++ and Python codebases, with guidelines that hold up. You would lead that adoption and decide what earns its place.

Growing other engineers. You coach the Squad Tech Leads, guide junior architects, and run CV Algorithm talks, HawkTalks and tutorials. You also help us hire well, including technical assessment for CV and ML roles.

The awkward bits. Operational health of ML training and synthetic data infrastructure sits with you, including escalating the gaps in ownership and support with options attached.

What we are looking for

The core of it is deep multi-camera computer vision. Camera calibration including intrinsics, extrinsics, distortion models, anti-wobble and bundle adjustment. Triangulation. 3D ball and pose estimation, skeletal tracking, continuous-time modelling, inverse kinematics.

On top of that:

  • Expert cross-platform C++ across Windows and Linux, x86 and ARM, with CMake and real performance profiling ability

  • Strong working knowledge of GPU inference (TensorRT, Triton) and ML pipelines (PyTorch, ONNX)

  • Proven experience running tracking at scale in AWS, on-premise and on edge devices

  • Hands-on use of AI coding agents and LLM orchestration to accelerate algorithm R&D and refactoring in large codebases

  • A working understanding of generative AI, synthetic data generation and where they genuinely help real-time CV

The parts that are harder to put in a bullet point. You can set architecture across many squads and sports and make pragmatic calls on reuse, cost and time to market. You write clearly: design documents, proposals with options, explanations a non-technical stakeholder can follow. You are comfortable in front of external engineering partners, which here means Sony, NVIDIA and AWS alongside sports leagues and federations. And you can size work honestly, state your confidence in it, and say what we should stop or delay.

What this role is not

Worth being direct about, because senior CV engineers are usually offered the other thing.

This is not a people management role. Nobody reports to you. Line management sits elsewhere and we are not planning to move it.

It is not project or delivery management either. Delivery Leads coordinate squad delivery across T&AO. You own technical direction and escalation, not sprint management.

You are not a Product Owner. Product sets the market and problem priorities, you work with them to define the solution.

You are not a Squad Tech Lead. Day-to-day technical leadership of squads sits with the Squad Tech Leads and Engineering Leads. You mentor them and step in on the complex and high-risk problems.

And you are not a gatekeeper for other value streams. You give them alignment and access to shared tracking IP. You do not own their roadmaps.

This is a performance-driven creative role focused on producing high-volume, conversion-oriented video content for paid social campaigns.
Video editing is the primary focus, with static ad creation providing additional creative versatility and speed.
You’ll work across UGC-style videos, testimonials, product demos, founder-led content, and direct-response ads.
The role emphasizes rapid testing, strong hooks, compelling CTAs, and creative variations designed to improve performance.
You’ll use modern editing and AI-powered tools to accelerate ideation, scripting, production, and iteration.
Working closely with strategists and growth teams, you’ll turn raw assets and concepts into effective creative at scale.
The ideal candidate is fast, resourceful, coachable, and motivated by measurable results rather than aesthetics alone.


Accountabilities:
  • Edit short-form direct-response video ads for Meta, TikTok, and other paid social platforms, including UGC, testimonials, product demonstrations, and founder-led content.
  • Develop multiple creative variations by testing different hooks, angles, CTAs, messaging, layouts, and offers.
  • Write and adapt scripts and copy for video concepts with a strong focus on engagement and conversion.
  • Use editing platforms such as CapCut, Premiere, After Effects, and other relevant tools to produce high-quality creative efficiently.
  • Leverage AI tools such as ChatGPT, Runway, Pika, and Descript to accelerate ideation, scripting, editing, and production workflows.
  • Create high-converting static ad creatives for paid social campaigns using templates, creative systems, competitor inspiration, and swipe files.
  • Produce multiple static variations for testing, including different headlines, layouts, messaging, and offers.
  • Work closely with strategists and growth teams to execute creative concepts and respond quickly to performance feedback.
  • Source, organize, and manage creative assets such as UGC, stock footage, hooks, B-roll, and other campaign materials.
  • Maintain a high-volume creative workflow while prioritizing effectiveness, consistency, and timely delivery.

    • Requirements:

    • 2+ years of experience editing direct-response video ads for direct-to-consumer brands.
    • Strong portfolio demonstrating successful paid social video advertising.
    • Solid experience creating static advertisements for Meta and other paid social platforms.
    • Proficiency with an editing tool such as CapCut, Premiere, and/or After Effects.
    • Working knowledge of Photoshop.
    • Strong understanding of performance marketing principles, including hooks, CTAs, creative angles, conversion, and testing.
    • Experience writing or adapting copy for advertising creatives.
    • Familiarity with AI-powered creative and productivity tools such as ChatGPT, Runway, Pika, or similar platforms.
    • Ability to work quickly, manage multiple projects, and consistently deliver several creative assets per week.
    • Strong English communication skills.
    • Motion graphics experience is a plus.
    • Familiarity with Creative OS, Foreplay, Butter, AdCreative.ai, or similar creative platforms is a plus.
    • Understanding of marketing funnels, offers, and paid social strategy is a plus.
    • Performance-oriented mindset with a focus on measurable results rather than aesthetics alone.
    • Resourcefulness, adaptability, coachability, ownership, and reliability in a fast-paced creative environment.

      • Benefits:

      • Full-time remote opportunity.
      • High-output creative environment with frequent testing and iteration.
      • Opportunity to work across both video and static paid social advertising.
      • Exposure to AI-powered creative workflows and modern production tools.

Deine Aufgaben

Das ist dein Beitrag:

  • In deiner Rolle als Data Engineer/ Database Manager bist du für den Aufbau, die Betreuung und die Weiterentwicklung moderner Dateninfrastrukturen verantwortlich und gestaltest unsere Datenlandschaft aktiv mit.
  • Du verantwortest die Datenakquise und -integration, z. B. aus bestehenden Kundensystemen sowie über definierte Schnittstellen, und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team die dafür erforderlichen Konzepte.
  • In engem Austausch mit deinem Team, den Fachkolleginnen und Fachkollegen sowie unseren Nutzern konzipierst und entwickelst du neue Schnittstellen und sorgst für eine zuverlässige Integration unterschiedlicher Datenquellen.
  • Du gestaltest die konzeptionelle und technologische Weiterentwicklung unserer bestehenden Data-Warehouse- und BI-Systemumgebung mit.
  • Du stellst gemeinsam mit dem Team Datenqualität, Verfügbarkeit und eine effiziente Verarbeitung unserer Daten sicher und entwickelst bestehende Datenprozesse kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Du berätst bei analytischen Fragestellungen auf Grundlage der verfügbaren Daten und arbeitest dabei eng mit unseren Fachbereichen und Kundenteams zusammen.
  • Du wirkst bei der Umsetzung von Anforderungen von der Spezifikation über die Implementierung und das Testing bis zum Rollout mit und übernimmst eigenständig Verantwortung für deine Themen.
  • Du dokumentierst Datenstrukturen, Schnittstellen und Prozesse nachvollziehbar und unterstützt damit einen nachhaltigen Wissenstransfer im Team.
  • Du evaluierst neue Technologien und Lösungsansätze und bringst deine Ideen aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Systemlandschaft ein.
  • Im regelmäßigen Austausch mit deinen Teamkolleginnen und -kollegen teilst du dein Wissen und trägst dazu bei, Standards und Best Practices im Database Management weiterzuentwickeln.


Dein Profil

Das macht dich für uns relevant:

  • Du verfügst über einschlägige praktische Erfahrung im Data Engineering, Database Management, Business Intelligence oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld und möchtest den nächsten Schritt nach einer Junior-Position gehen.
  • Du hast ein Studium im Bereich (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Data Science oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung abgeschlossen oder verfügst über eine entsprechende Ausbildung mit relevanter Berufserfahrung.
  • Du verfügst über gute Kenntnisse in SQL und Datenmodellierung und hast praktische Erfahrung im Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken. Kenntnisse in PostgreSQL, PL/SQL, PHP und Python sind von Vorteil.
  • Idealerweise bringst du bereits Erfahrung mit ETL-/ELT-Prozessen, Data Warehouses, Schnittstellen und der Integration unterschiedlicher Datenquellen mit.
  • Du besitzt ein gutes technisches Verständnis und kannst gleichzeitig fachliche und betriebswirtschaftliche Anforderungen nachvollziehen und in geeignete Datenlösungen übersetzen.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig und strukturiert, stimmst dich aber ebenso selbstverständlich mit deinem Team und anderen Fachbereichen ab.
  • Du verfügst über fließende Deutschkenntnisse und sichere Englischkenntnisse.
Du legst für dich persönlich Wert auf:
  • Ownership – Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen, bringst eigene Ideen ein und treibst Aufgaben proaktiv voran.
  • Lösungsorientierung – Du analysierst Herausforderungen strukturiert und entwickelst pragmatische und nachhaltige Lösungen.
  • Teamwork – Du arbeitest gerne interdisziplinär und teilst dein Wissen aktiv mit deinen Kolleginnen und Kollegen.
  • Kommunikation – Du kannst technische Zusammenhänge verständlich vermitteln und kommunizierst sicher mit technischen wie auch fachfremden Ansprechpartnern.
  • Motivation – Du begeisterst dich für Daten, Business Intelligence und neue Technologien und hast Freude daran, aus Daten verlässliche Grundlagen für Entscheidungen zu schaffen.


Dein Extra

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Einen großartigen Teamspirit und spannende Aufgaben in einem innovativen Zukunftsmarkt und einer Kultur der Verantwortung, Teamworks und Ehrlichkeit.
  • Auch Work from Anywhere kann bei uns möglich gemacht werden.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, Home-Office-Tage, kostenlose Getränke, Activity-Raum mit Kicker und anderen Spielen sowie regelmäßige Team-Events.
  • Einsatz aktueller Soft- und Hardware als auch Nutzung innovativer Cloud-Services.
  • Einblick und Arbeit mit vielfältigen Daten aus verschiedenen Phasen des Data Lifecycles.
  • Tatsächliche Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten durch das Einbringen deiner eigenen Ideen und Erfahrungen zur innovativen Weiterentwicklung des DATALOGUE Teams.
  • Eine zentrale Lage und moderne Büros direkt am Gänsemarkt, verkehrsgünstig zu erreichen.
  • Intensive Begleitung und qualifiziertes Feedback im Rahmen des DATALOGUE Entwicklungsprogramms gepaart mit einer offenen Feedbackkultur über alle Ebenen, durch die du gezielt in deiner persönlichen Entwicklung unterstützt wirst.
  • Eine Kooperation mit Urban Sports Club, Jobrad sowie weiteren Partnern zu attraktiven Firmenkonditionen, damit du fit für den Job bleibst.
Rahmenbedingungen: Die Position ist auf zwei Jahre befristet.

description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're looking for a Data Scientist - Product Analytics to join our Growth Data team. You'll own the analysis behind how people discover, adopt and stick with ElevenLabs' products, partnering closely with Product, Growth and the central Data team's certified metrics layer.

  • Define and own product health metrics: activation, feature adoption, retention and engagement across ElevenCreative, ElevenAgents and ElevenAPI.

  • Design, analyse and communicate the results of product experiments (A/B tests, feature launches, onboarding changes).

  • Partner with Analytics Engineering on the certified product KPI layer in dbt, and with Product on turning ambiguous questions into trusted analysis.

  • Work alongside fellow Growth data scientists on marketing- and revenue-adjacent questions that touch the product funnel.

Requirements

Demonstrated experience as a data scientist embedded with a product or growth team, ideally at a product-led company.

  • Strong SQL and Python, with hands-on experience in experimentation (A/B testing) and product analytics.

  • Ability to translate ambiguous product questions into clear, reusable analysis and defensible metrics.

  • Comfort working directly with Product and Growth stakeholders, and pushing back on ill-defined asks.

  • Structured thinker who can move fast without sacrificing rigour.

Bonus

  • Experience with activation / retention modelling or lifecycle analytics at a consumer or prosumer product.

  • Experience with dbt or a modern warehouse, partnering directly with analytics engineers.

  • Experience using AI tools or agents to speed up analysis or enable self-serve data access.

Growth potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Grow into a Senior or Staff Product Data Scientist role as the Growth Data team scales.

  • Expand scope across additional product lines (ElevenAgents, ElevenAPI).

  • Path into a Growth Data Science lead or broader data leadership track.

Location
This role is remote-first. [please fill with specific location / timezone requirements].

About Peec AI

Peec AI is the analytics platform for AI search. People increasingly discover products and make buying decisions through ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews instead of traditional search, and most brands have no idea where they show up in those answers. Peec gives marketing, SEO, and growth teams the data to see exactly that: how visible their brand is across AI platforms, how they compare to competitors, and where to win.

We are defining this category, and the market is moving with us. Peec is a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, past $18M ARR, with a 100+ person team across our Berlin HQ and our New York office.

About the role

We’re looking for an AI Search Strategist to help our customers succeed in the new era of AI-driven search. In this role, you’ll work closely with leading brands and agencies, onboarding new clients and advising them on how to improve their visibility across search engines, AI assistants, and emerging generative surfaces. You’ll combine deep SEO expertise with a consultative approach, analyzing websites and search performance, running strategic advisory sessions, and translating business goals into actionable organic growth strategies. Working closely with Sales, Growth, and Product, you’ll also help shape how we enable customers and define best practices for succeeding in AI-powered search.

What you’ll do

  • Onboard and activate new key clients, and educate them on how to best leverage Peec AI to become top-ranked in AI search

  • Review websites, content, and search performance of key clients to identify AI-search-related opportunities across platforms (search, AI assistants, and emerging generative surfaces)

  • Run advisory sessions with leading brands and agencies, turning their growth and brand goals into actionable GEO strategies and roadmaps

  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Growth, and Product to refine activation journeys, case studies, and customer enablement programs

  • Consult our mid-sized and enterprise clients on GEO-related topics, from overall strategy to hands-on operational execution

What we’re looking for

  • 3–5 years of hands-on SEO or organic growth experience, ideally at a top-tier SEO agency

  • Deep understanding of technical SEO, content strategy, search intent, and how organic performance translates into business outcomes

  • Strong consulting skills: you’re used to advising clients, presenting strategic recommendations, and constructively challenging their thinking

  • Ability to explain SEO concepts in simple, actionable language for marketing and brand teams

  • Excitement about the shift from “10 blue links” to generative search, and motivation to be at the frontier of that change

  • Confident verbal and written communication skills in English for high-quality client calls, workshops, and written recommendations

Bonus points

  • Experience building frameworks: SEO playbooks, content strategies, or measurement models for clients

  • Initial experience with AI search

  • Background working with enterprise and other high-touch clients

  • Experience in a high-growth, venture-backed SaaS or marketing tech environment

  • Confident verbal and written communication skills in German for high-quality client calls, workshops, and written recommendations

 

What we offer

  • Exciting and challenging work with real impact and ownership at one of Europe’s fastest-growing Series A startups

  • Regular team events and offsites

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity: everyone at Peec owns a piece of the upside

  • Paid Meal and Uber rides home when working late

  • One of the most beautiful office spaces and work environments in Berlin

At Limehome, data is one of our biggest competitive advantages. As a Data Scientist, you'll turn complex business challenges into scalable statistical and machine learning solutions that help us make smarter decisions across pricing, operations, product, and beyond.

Deine Aufgaben

Wir bauen die Software, mit der Mieterstromprojekte laufen: Zählerdaten rein, Abrechnung raus, und alles dazwischen. Das Core Team verantwortet das Betreiberportal, das Produkt, auf dem der laufende Betrieb unserer Kunden steht. Es ist unser fachlich tiefstes Team, und es wächst.

Das Betreiberportal ist kein generisches SaaS. Es bildet die Energiewirtschaft ab: Messstellenbetrieb, Marktkommunikation, Netzentgelte, Umlagen, Abrechnung nach Regeln, die der Gesetzgeber schreibt und regelmäßig ändert. Wer hier priorisiert, muss verstehen, was eine Anforderung für den Betreiber wirtschaftlich bedeutet und was passiert, wenn sie falsch umgesetzt wird.

Dafür suchen wir eine Person, die das Team führt und das Geschäft dahinter versteht. Nicht als Durchreiche für Tickets und nicht als Architekt, der alles selbst entscheidet, sondern als jemand, der Business-Anforderungen in technische Entscheidungen übersetzt und dafür sorgt, dass gute Entwickler gute Arbeit machen können: klare Ziele, wenig Reibung, ehrliches Feedback, verlässliche Lieferung.

Der Weg dahin ist bewusst gewählt: Du startest für rund sechs Monate als Entwickler im Core Team. Du baust Features, machst Reviews und lernst Codebasis, Fachlichkeit und Menschen von innen kennen. Danach übernimmst du die Führung des Teams. Wer ein Team führen will, das er nie von innen gesehen hat, führt es an dem vorbei, was zählt.

Technisch: Python mit Django und Django Ninja im Backend, React mit TypeScript im Frontend, PostgreSQL mit TimescaleDB, deployt auf Kubernetes per GitOps mit ArgoCD. KI-Coding-Assistenten sind fester Teil des Workflows. In den ersten Monaten schreibst du diesen Code selbst. Danach musst du ihn weiter lesen können und verstehen, worüber dein Team diskutiert.

In den ersten sechs Monaten

  • Du arbeitest als Entwickler im Core Team: Features end-to-end, Reviews, Deployments, Support-Fälle. Ohne Sonderrolle

  • Du lernst die Fachlichkeit von Messkonzept bis Abrechnung und die Geschichte der Codebasis, inklusive der Stellen, an denen sie weh tut

  • Du baust Vertrauen zu den Menschen im Team auf, weil du mit ihnen arbeitest und nicht über ihnen

Danach

  • Du führst das Core Team: Einstellung, Onboarding, 1:1s, Entwicklung, Feedback. Die Menschen im Team sind deine erste Verantwortung

  • Du verantwortest die Lieferung: Zusammen mit Product priorisierst du nach wirtschaftlichem Wert und regulatorischem Druck, planst realistisch und sorgst dafür, dass Zugesagtes fertig wird

  • Du bringst Fachverständnis in die Produktentscheidungen ein: Du erkennst, wann eine Anforderung aus dem Markt kommt, wann aus einem einzelnen Kunden, und wann aus einem Missverständnis

  • Du hältst die technische Qualität hoch, ohne selbst der Flaschenhals zu sein: Du moderierst Architekturentscheidungen, forderst Tests und Reviews ein und schaffst Raum für Refactoring

  • Du bist die Schnittstelle zu Product, Support und den anderen Engineering-Teams, und du löst Konflikte, bevor sie im Sprint landen

  • Du machst Probleme sichtbar: Wenn etwas nicht klappt, sagst du es früh und mit Vorschlag statt spät und mit Ausrede

  • Du gestaltest Prozesse so, dass sie dem Team dienen, und schaffst die ab, die es nicht tun


Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung in der Führung eines Entwicklungsteams, als Engineering Manager, Team Lead oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit Personalverantwortung

  • Du willst wieder oder weiter Code schreiben, bevor du führst, und siehst das als Vorteil, nicht als Umweg

  • Erfahrung in der Energiewirtschaft, idealerweise in Messstellenbetrieb, Abrechnung, Marktkommunikation oder Mieterstrom. Du kennst Begriffe wie Messkonzept, MaLo oder OBIS nicht nur aus Wikipedia

  • Business-Verständnis: Du denkst vom Geschäftsmodell des Betreibers her, nicht vom Feature. Du kannst erklären, welche Anforderung Umsatz sichert, welche Risiko reduziert und welche nur schön ist

  • Du gibst direktes Feedback und hältst es aus, direktes Feedback zu bekommen

  • Building Better NPD Processes: You document decisions and learnings, create clear handovers and help make product development more structured and predictable as ahead grows.


YOUR PROFILE

  • You bring 5+ years of experience in food product development, R&D, or NPD, with a track record from brief through formulation, sensory validation, scale-up, and launch. Hands-on experience in gummies, candy, chocolate, confectionery, or a related sweet-goods category is mandatory.

WHAT MAKES YOUR PROFILE COMPLETE

  • Experience launching 10+ food products, ideally across multiple markets.

Design end-to-end automation solutions

Own the technical solution throughout the sales cycle

Connect systems, software and operations

Collaborate from concept to implementation

  • Support integrators with technical guidance and best practices for selling and implementing Exotec solutions. 
  • Contribute to project handover, deployment and ongoing solution maintenance after the sale.  

Help us continuously improve

  • Contribute beyond your individual projects by helping strengthen solution-engineering practices and standards. 
  • Manage multiple opportunities and projects simultaneously in a fast-moving, collaborative environment.

  • Strong knowledge of end-to-end warehouse processes, material flows and warehouse systems. 
  • Experience designing technical solutions based on complex customer requirements, including layouts and performance considerations. 
  • Experience with WMS, WCS, WES or comparable logistics software, with the ability to understand and define interfaces between different systems.

Cuculus is looking for a hands-on senior engineer to design, build, implement and manage secure, scalable and cost-effective cloud and infrastructure environments for customer projects across cloud, on-premises and hybrid platforms.


What is the role about?

Own customer environment delivery from approved architecture through cloud provisioning, Infrastructure as Code, OpenShift/Kubernetes implementation, migration, production readiness, optimization and handover. This is not a routine Production Support role; the engineer will assist with critical customer issues requiring specialist expertise.


Your Role at a Glance

Cloud infrastructure and services

  • Design, deploy and manage cloud infrastructure and services across AWS, Azure or equivalent platforms, including on-premises and hybrid integrations.
  • Configure networking, identity and access management, compute, storage, databases, load balancers, DNS, firewalls and customer connectivity.
  • Translate approved architecture into development, UAT, staging, production, High Availability and Disaster Recovery environments.
Infrastructure as Code, platforms and CI/CD
  • Implement version-controlled Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and develop secure, reusable modules for repeatable customer environment builds.
  • Deploy, configure and manage OpenShift and Kubernetes platforms, including networking, ingress, storage, certificates, RBAC, secrets and workload resources.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and cloud automation using approved tools such as Ansible, Helm, GitOps, Python and Bash/Shell.
Security, resilience, monitoring and cost
  • Apply cloud security, compliance and governance requirements across IAM/RBAC, encryption, secrets, network controls, operating systems and platform configuration.
  • Implement backup, High Availability and Disaster Recovery practices and validate recovery against defined RTO and RPO requirements where applicable.
  • Monitor performance, availability, security and cost; optimize scalability, resilience, capacity and cloud spending without compromising service requirements.
Migrations, delivery and technical escalation
  • Assess and support infrastructure and workload migrations, including dependencies, cutover planning, rollback, validation and post-migration stabilization.
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, cloud-platform, CI/CD and deployment issues during implementation, testing, go-live and major technical escalations.
  • Complete production-readiness checks, acceptance evidence, knowledge transfer and formal handover; routine operational ownership remains with Production Support.
Standards, collaboration and responsible AI adoption
  • Develop cloud and infrastructure standards, architecture records, reusable modules, implementation guides, operational runbooks and support documentation.
  • Collaborate with developers, security teams, architects, DBAs, network specialists, project teams and customers to deliver complete working environments.

Must-haves (to thrive in this role)

Experience & education

Cloud, platforms & infrastructure

  • Strong knowledge of networking, IAM, compute, storage, databases, load balancing, DNS, firewalls, private connectivity and TLS.

Automation

  • Strong hands-on Terraform experience, including reusable modules, state management, version control and controlled infrastructure changes.
  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines and automation using Ansible, Python, Bash/Shell or equivalent tools.

Operations & collaboration

  • Experience with cloud monitoring, security, compliance, backup, HA/DR, scalability and cost optimization.
  • Strong troubleshooting, customer-facing communication, documentation and cross-team collaboration skills, with responsible adoption of approved AI tools.

Location & language

description:
What you can expect from us

Eraneos supports AI initiatives from strategy all the way through to production. In most AI projects, there's a gap between the strategy and what actually ends up running in production and creating real value. That's exactly the gap we close. 

For us, the work doesn't stop at the concept stage, and it doesn't start only once the spec is finished: an initiative stays in one pair of hands from the first idea to the running system. We work in a results-driven way rather than following the classic consulting model. Our clients are primarily DAX and Fortune Global 500 companies. 

You help decide what gets built, not just how. We always work with the latest models and tools to succeed with the client. There's no prescribed stack — instead, we pick the right tool for each task. You design technical solutions from the first idea through to production deployment, working closely with decision-makers on both the client and management side. 

What to expect:

  • You own the architecture and technical implementation of the AI solution end to end — from strategy through to production
  • You build agentic systems, RAG pipelines, and LLM integrations in real enterprise environments
  • Agentic coding tools are your everyday toolkit: you use them to develop solutions, speed up reviews, and build deployment pipelines
  • You're involved from the very first idea, not just once the spec is finished — growing deeper into the strategic and business side along the way
  • You stay accountable until the end: you don't hand things off, you see the solution through until it's running and delivering impact
  • You represent your technical decisions directly at executive level and lead these conversations yourself, without going through an intermediary layer


Who you are

  • You stand behind the whole outcome, not just one part of it. You stick with it until the solution is running in production and delivering impact, and you share in the responsibility for that — a founder and product mindset rather than simply executing tasks
  • You build hands-on, at the highest level — and you think beyond the code. From an engineering perspective, that means you've already taken LLM-based systems into production and understand the business rationale behind them, not just the architecture
  • You're convincing at executive level. You've already owned and defended technical decisions directly in front of top management. You bring this with you — we won't be developing you into it
  • Proven experience bringing LLM-based systems into production — ideally as a Forward-Deployed or Founding Engineer
  • Excellent, production-grade Python skills (e.g. FastAPI, containers, Git, CI/CD) and a deep understanding of agentic architectures, retrieval methods, and function calling
  • You use agentic coding tools as a core part of your toolkit, not as a gimmick — including building deployment pipelines
  • An appetite for picking up where classic engineering roles leave off, and for growing deeper into the strategic side
  • Ideally, experience in one of our core industries — Financial Services, Transportation & Logistics, Energy & Utilities, Life Sciences, Healthcare, Public Sector, Automotive, or Defence. More important than the specific industry is that you quickly get up to speed in a new, often regulated environment
  • German (at least C1) and business-fluent English
  • Willingness to work regularly on-site at client locations
  • A completed degree in computer science, mathematics, physics, data science, business informatics, or a comparable field (Bachelor's or higher)


Who we are

  • Shape the future with AI by working on diverse and impactful projects at the intersection of strategy, technology, and business.
  • Work flexibly in a way that suits your life – with hybrid working models, flexible working hours, and the option to work from home.
  • Enjoy an open, collaborative culture with flat hierarchies, an international team, and colleagues who are always willing to share their knowledge and support one another.
  • A Great Place to Grow: Benefit from tailored learning opportunities, individualized career paths, and dedicated support for your professional and personal development.
  • Be part of a strong international network of more than 1,300 colleagues and enjoy regular cross-office and international company events.
  • Maintain a healthy work-life balance with flexible working models and, where appropriate, the opportunity to take a sabbatical.
  • Take advantage of our Company Bike program and a subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership to support your health and wellbeing.
  • Work from modern, centrally located offices in Hamburg, Munich, and Düsseldorf, as well as flexible hub locations across Germany's major cities.
  • Enjoy complimentary drinks, fresh fruit, snacks, premium coffee – and, if you like, an after-work beer with your colleagues.
  • Thrive in an environment built on trust, ownership, and continuous growth, where your ideas are valued regardless of your role or level of seniority

Founding Data Scientist

 

We're looking for a Founding Data Scientist to work directly with leadership on zero-to-one measurement and growth problems. This is not a role for maintaining existing systems — it's for someone who can take an ambiguous, high-stakes question and build the data infrastructure to answer it reliably, then own what comes next.

We value people who combine measurement rigour with builder instincts: someone equally comfortable designing a causal experiment and shipping the pipeline that operationalises its output.

 

What You'll Do

  • Own incrementality testing across marketing, product, and rewards — proving its value from hypothesis to business impact.

  • Build the data pipelines and measurement stack behind it, tying experiments to real shifts in user behaviour, monetisation, and multi-touch attribution.

  • Drive experimentation strategy across growth and product: design, run, and interpret tests with a sharp focus on causal validity — not just p-values.

  • Own data products end-to-end: scoping, architecture, implementation, rollout.

  • Partner with C-level, engineering, and business stakeholders to turn measurement into live operational decisions.

  • Set the frameworks and practices the team can scale on.

 

What You Need

  • Deep expertise applying causal inference and experimental design in practice, in real business contexts.

  • Hands-on experience building and operationalising attribution models in a real business context — not just running models, but making them useful.

  • Proven zero-to-one experience: ambiguous problem, built the infrastructure, shipped something production-ready.

  • Proficiency in Python and SQL; GCP preferred; comfortable with modern data stack tools (dbt).

  • Familiarity with AI and LLM tooling is a plus — whether that's integrating language models into data workflows, using AI-assisted analysis to move faster, or exploring how generative and predictive AI can sharpen measurement and personalisation at scale. We're an AI-native team and expect this role to grow alongside those capabilities.

 

You Are

  • A builder with a strong ownership mindset — you don't wait for a spec.

  • Rigorous but pragmatic: the stats matter, but the business question matters more.

  • Someone who, if they have to debug something twice, automates it.

  • A clear communicator — you can translate model outputs into decisions that non-technical stakeholders can act on.

 

Why Almedia?

  • Own Our Growth: Competitive package with meaningful equity.

  • High Impact: Work on company-defining projects, not tickets in a queue.

  • Scale With Almedia: Join a profitable, high-growth startup early.

  • Great Environment: Central Berlin office, transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more.

 

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

Investigating 770 Million User Interactions Across a 100TB Data Lake

When a platform serves 770 million users, every optimization from reward mechanics to SDK integrations needs to be grounded in data. The Rewarded Analytics team builds the internal dashboards, alerting systems, and data pipelines that monitor the user funnel, traffic engagement, and reward consistency.

SQL and Python power deep-dive investigations and automated 100 terabyte-sized data analyses queried through Trino. Using Tableau as the main visualization tool, stakeholders have access to real-time insights on the product performance. Airflow orchestrates the pipelines that keep everything up to date. This team provides the data that turns questions into answers: every A/B experiment the product team runs, every anomaly a publisher flags, and every new SDK integration. These answers guide all the business decisions.


Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

  • Data analyst with a strong technical foundation. You have 5+ years as a Data Analyst and work fluently in both SQL and Python, writing complex queries, big data optimizations, and analysis pipelines to support product and growth initiatives.

  • Master of experimentation and A/B testing. You have deep experience designing experiments, calculating sample sizes, managing variance reduction techniques, and analyzing A/B/n tests to ensure statistically sound business decisions.

  • Statistically grounded. You can reason confidently about core statistical concepts—hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, p-values, power analysis, and Bayesian vs. Frequentist approaches—and apply them to real-world product decisions.

  • Not a stranger to anomaly detection. You have experience working with anomaly detection algorithms and approaches like distribution analysis and cross-population comparison to monitor test guardrail metrics and identify unexpected shifts in experiment data.

  • You own the systems, not just your slice. You understand the end-to-end telemetry and feature flagging systems that power experimentation. You can speak to data flows, event tracking pipelines, architecture tradeoffs, and why things were built the way they were.

  • Automation-minded across the stack. You think beyond one-off test analyses and build automated experiment reporting dashboards, reusable analytical frameworks, and data visibility solutions. Experience with dbt, Airflow, or experiment platforms (e.g., Optimizely, GrowthBook) is a strong plus.

  • Collaborative and business-aware. You work closely with product managers, engineers, and growth leads to translate complex statistical results into clear, actionable recommendations that drive executive decision-making.

 

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.

What’s in It for You?

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

  • Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.

  • Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.

  • Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.

  • Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other.

  • Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.

We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

ProcessOS is a new kind of Camunda product: business processes described in natural language, generated as executable BPMN workflows, and improved autonomously from production data. We’re hiring the first cohort of Forward Deployed Engineers to bring it into production at enterprise customers. You’ll own the deployment journey from first process file to a working, improving system, and hand off a functioning capability to the customer’s team. The code you write and the patterns you discover feed directly back into how ProcessOS is built. This is a rare opportunity to shape a product, a function, and a field practice from day one.


You’ll work end‑to‑end across Java services and React interfaces, collaborating closely with a talented global team to measure, improve, and scale performance and fault tolerance in real-world distributed systems.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  •  Deploy and prove. Own the journey from first process file to production workflow. At 90 days: at least one workflow running, the improvement loop active, and measurable fitness gains the customer can see. At 12 months: 3–5 customers with viable deployments.

  • Drive organizational adoption. Work across technical and business stakeholders to build understanding and trust, turning early deployments into lasting customer capability.

  • Work at depth technically. Configure and run Camunda clusters locally and in cloud environments. Debug integration failures. Build custom agents where platform defaults don’t fit. Write connector logic that gets legacy enterprise systems talking to ProcessOS.

  • Build the playbook. There is no deployment template yet. Document what good looks like as you discover it, and make the next implementation faster.

  • Feed the product. Custom agents you write get contributed back. Integration patterns get codified. Production bugs you find, you often fix. Your field work is a direct input to ProcessOS.

  • Hand off deliberately. Leave customers with a team that can operate independently, is trained on the platform, and acts on improvement results without you.

What You Will Bring to the Role

Must Haves:

  • Enterprise production experience: you’ve shipped something inside a large organization and stayed to see it operate. You know why governance and resilience matter at scale.

  • Technical depth: You can debug an integration failure, write a custom agent against a legacy API, stand up a Camunda cluster from scratch, and explain generated BPMN to both engineers and business leads.

  • Stakeholder communication: you work effectively across engineering, architecture, and business leadership and adapt how you communicate without losing precision.

  • Practical AI experience: you’ve used AI to solve real problems in production – not just experimented. You understand context management, prompt engineering, agent testing, and integration tradeoffs.

  • Comfort with ambiguity: you make sound judgment calls without a playbook and document what you learn.

  • Occasional travel may be required

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience in a customer-facing engineering or professional services role.

  • Familiarity with regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or insurance

  • Production experience with agentic systems or AI-integrated workflows.

  • Contributions to a shared platform or open source project that others built on.

What you'll own

  1. Develop and improve analytical, machine-learning, and simulation models to address business problems in the real-estate and energy domain.
  2. Build and improve data extraction pipelines for structured and unstructured sources, evaluating extraction accuracy and reliability

  5. Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to translate business needs into data-driven solutions.

  1. You take ownership of well-defined analytical and modeling problems and independently deliver robust solutions.

Your Mission

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you own the systems behind our platform: the GraphQL API, the relational data model, the background processing that turns customer documents and spreadsheets into structured data, and the permission model that lets a single owner and a bank with hundreds of portfolios use the same product. Most of your work runs from schema design all the way to the resolver.
You partner with product, design and other engineers to make sure we build what matters - not just what you have been told to do. You take real responsibility for production: when something is slow, you find out why, whether the answer is a bad query, application code or the infrastructure underneath.
You also help us make AI reliable in production. Document extraction, long-running analysis jobs and agentic features are core to where the product is going, and we need people who make these workflows testable and dependable rather than impressive in a demo.
Our company size of ~40 people ensures that the best idea wins and political discussions are kept aside. And every line of code helps to improve the carbon footprint of real estate properties.

Tech stack: TypeScript (NestJS backend, React frontend), Hasura/GraphQL, PostgreSQL (multiple databases incl. PostGIS), queue-based job processing, AWS (ECS / Elastic Beanstalk, S3, SES, Textract), IaC, Claude but all agents welcome


What you'll own

  • Build features across our Hasura GraphQL API, NestJS and Postgres. From schema design to resolver.
  • Model complex real estate and ESG domains in relational schemas. We run several Postgres databases side by side (one of them geospatial), and schema decisions here have consequences but also positive impact.
  • Own background processing: Excel imports, document extraction, long-running analysis jobs, 3D and image processing. Queues, retries, jobs that spawn other jobs - and figuring out what to do when step 3 of 7 fails at 2am.
  • Develop our permission model. Customers range from a single owner to enterprises with organization/portfolio/building-level access.
  • Integrate LLMs into backend workflows - especially document and data extraction - and make them reliable, verifyable and testable.
  • Debug production. Navigate Grafana dashboards and traces to find out why something is slow or failing, whether in the app, the CI/build pipeline or the infrastructure.
  • Spot overgrown or overly complex parts of the codebase and simplify them without being asked. Paying down complexity is part of the job.


What success looks like

  • You have shipped features end-to-end across schema, API and background processing that our customers actively use.
  • Our async processing (imports, extraction, analysis jobs) is measurably more robust: fewer silent failures, clear retry and recovery paths, and observability that tells us what broke and why.
  • You have taken ownership of at least one core area e.g. the permission model, the job orchestration layer or the LLM extraction pipeline and are the person the team goes to for it.
  • You have raised the bar on testing and developer experience in the backend, and other engineers ship faster because of you.
  • You are a trusted sparring partner for product and the team when we decide what to build and how.


What it takes

  • You're strong with Postgres. Schema design comes naturally, you can read a query plan, and you know when the ORM is lying to you. Geospatial experience is a bonus, not a requirement.

  • You've built real queue-based processing. You designed workers, dealt with retries and partial failures, orchestrated multi-step workflows.

  • You'd rather have one integration test that hits a real database schema than ten unit tests mocking everything. You write the test that catches the broken migration.
  • You treat production as a debuggable system. You can navigate dashboards and traces to figure out why something is slow, and you don't treat infrastructure as someone else's problem.
  • You communicate clearly - with engineers, product and, when needed, directly with customers.
  • You speak German at C1 level or better and English fluently. Our customers are German banks and asset managers, and you will talk to them.
Bonus:

  • AWS (S3, SES, ECS, RDS, …) and IaC.

  • LLMs in production, especially document or data extraction and making it reliable for actual user workflows.

  • Data pipeline work: staged, reproducible processing, dataset versioning.

  • Mentoring or leading engineers, or wanting to grow into it.

  • Debugging tooling and build issues, not just application code. Our toolchain moves fast and is occasionally non-standard.

  • Team: Office-first in Munich's Werksviertel, 4 days/week.

About FION

European industry is losing competitiveness because electricity here is more expensive and more volatile than in the US or China. The reason: renewables fluctuate strongly, factories consume constantly.

We close that gap. FION plans and installs the right battery system for an industrial site and runs it with AI in real time against tariffs and markets. The software that dimensions, controls and monitors those systems is our own, and it runs end to end: ML and optimization in the cloud, data streaming and control, and the edge device at the customer site. The result for the customer: significantly lower energy costs and measurable CO2 savings. We earn trust by delivering systems and operating them transparently.

We already work with more than 20 factories across industries such as plastics, automotive and food processing, and we are backed by early-stage investors.

We're looking for an engineer with deep experience in time-series forecasting and mathematical optimization to join us as an early hire. You'll work on the forecasting and optimization core of our platform: the models that forecast industrial electricity consumption and PV generation, and the optimization that decides how each battery operates and trades against tariffs and markets within physical and grid constraints. This is a startup role: you should be comfortable switching between strategic thinking and hands-on work.

You'll work directly with the CTO, one of the co-founders.

Tasks

Forecasting models Develop and improve time-series forecasting models for industrial electricity consumption, PV generation, and other energy-relevant signals, and extend them with probabilistic outputs. Evaluate forecast quality on noisy, incomplete, and non-stationary industrial data, including its actual operational and economic impact.

Battery dispatch optimization Develop and improve the optimization models that schedule battery dispatch across peak shaving, self-consumption, spot market trading and flexibility marketing, while adhering to physical and grid constraints. Design how forecasts, uncertainty measures, physical constraints, and system states are used in downstream optimization workflows.

Validation, simulation and monitoring Build and improve simulation, replay, benchmarking, and validation workflows to test model behavior before and alongside deployment in live systems. Build and use tools and processes to monitor and assess the quality of operational forecasting and optimization models.

Production integration Design, write, test, and deploy production-grade code for mission-critical forecasting and optimization products. Improve robustness through plausibility checks, fallback behavior, re-forecasting, and handling of low-confidence or missing data. Collaborate closely with software engineers to integrate models into our core platform and edge devices.

Requirements

You bring:

- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience

- Strong applied experience in time-series and probabilistic forecasting: forecast calibration, uncertainty evaluation, backtesting, and model validation

- Strong understanding of mathematical optimization, especially LP/MILP, and the ability to model real-world systems through objectives, constraints, and operational rules

- Strong Python skills with the scientific and machine learning tool stack (pandas, NumPy, SciPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch)

- Experience developing, releasing, and tracking the performance of forecasting or optimization models in a commercial software setting

- An ownership mindset - you want to shape the platform, not just implement tickets

Even better if you have:

- Energy domain knowledge - you understand power, energy, phases, and how the grid works

- Understanding of European electricity markets, flexibility services, and grid operation

- BESS-specific experience: familiarity with BESS architectures, components, and operation, and direct experience with energy management algorithms for battery systems

- Experience with open-source and commercial MILP solvers (e.g. Pyomo, OR-Tools)

- Experience with optimization techniques such as stochastic or robust optimization

- Experience building forecasting and machine learning products in the cloud (e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure)

- Experience using Large Language Models to accelerate software development and reliably add new capabilities to real products

- German language skills (our customers and partners are German)

Benefits

Ownership, not tickets This isn't a role where the models are decided and you fill in the blanks. The forecasting and dispatch optimization stack is greenfield - nothing exists yet, and you'll design and build it from the ground up. At larger energy companies, this scope is split across multiple teams. Here, you own it all.

Real impact, fast Your code runs physical batteries that save real factories real money. You'll see results on a Grafana dashboard the same week you deploy.

Founding trajectory As FION grows, you grow with it - from hands-on builder to platform lead to head of forecasting and optimization. What takes 5 years at a large company, you'll have from day one.

Compensation

- VSOP (virtual shares)

- you participate in the company's success

- Berlin hybrid (remote from within Germany possible for the right person)

Send us:

- Your CV or LinkedIn profile

- A few sentences on why this role interests you

- Optionally: a link to a project, repo, or writeup that shows how you think about technical problems

We review every application personally and get back to you within a week. No automated screening, no ATS black hole - you're writing to a person, not a system.

description:
What we are building

ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others.


Why This Role Matters

You build and run the platform the whole product sits on: the event streams, the backend services and the cloud infrastructure everything else is built on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to make sure that traffic lands reliably, moves through the system in a shape other teams can build on, and keeps doing so as the number of sites grows.
You join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters.

What you will work on

  • Event streaming. Kafka is the spine of the system. You own topic and schema design, partitioning, retention and delivery semantics  and the everyday reality behind them: consumers falling behind, replays, backfills, late and duplicated readings.
  • Backend services in TypeScript. The ingestion services, integrations and APIs around that stream. Every site is a little different, so a good part of the job is turning that variety into one consistent interface the product squads can rely on.
  • Cloud infrastructure on GCP. Compute, networking, IAM, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability. The goal is a paved road: other engineers ship and debug their own services without going through you.
  • Technical direction. You are senior enough to set it. Where we invest in the platform, what we standardise, what we deliberately leave rough for now  and bringing the rest of the team along with it.


What Sets You Up for Success

Must have:

The Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled and innovative Mobile QA Engineer to lead end-to-end quality assurance, test automation, and release stability for our ScholarshipOwl Flutter mobile appand its integration with our GraphQL API. You’ll play a pivotal role in ensuring rapid, regression-free delivery across iOS, Android, and Shorebird OTA updates for millions of students.

In this role, you will champion the "new generation" of quality engineering. Beyond traditional test automation, you will leverage modern AI coding assistants (such as Cursor, Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini) as your primary force multiplier to achieve maximum test coverage at unmatched speed. What You’ll Do

  • API & Schema Verification: Proficiency in testing GraphQL APIs (Bruno, Postman, Playwright, or HTTP clients), including schema validation, headers, and JWT auth flows.

About the role

Gauss Fusion is aiming to build the first commercial scale fusion power plant based on the stellarator concept and is seeking an experienced mechanical engineer to lead on development of the robotic maintenance approach.
The fusion environment within the reactor is very aggressive, and in-vessel components such as the breeder blanket and divertor will need to be replaced on a regular basis as the materials become damaged by the radiation. Due to the environment inside the device, and in order to maintain a high overall availability, the maintenance must be done robotically using automated systems to extract and replace the components and bring the removed ones to a hot cell for separation, waste treatment, and recycling.
Gauss Fusion is looking for an innovative mechanical design engineer with experience in robotics to lead the work defining and developing the maintenance approach for the Gauss stellarator power plant and its key stellarator systems. While the magnetic configuration will be designed to maximise access to the reactor, the complex geometry poses a challenge to fixations and kinematics, and inventive approaches to the problem are required.


Main responsibilities

Manage the Gauss Fusion maintenance approach to meet the requirements of a commercial scale fusion power plant design:

  • Develop workable approaches to achieving high power plant availability, taking account of engineering and physics requirements across the reactor.
  • Integrate these remote maintenance requirements into plant layout specifications.
  • Define approaches to minimising hot cell inventory through efficient handling of removed components.
  • Lead development of the breeder blanket and divertor segmentation and fixations resulting from these approaches.
  • Lead development of remote maintenance testing and demonstration systems for the reactor.


Qualification and educational requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related field, master’s or Ph.D. preferred.
  • Technical experience: 
    • Minimum of 6 years of experience in mechanical engineering, preferably in large-scale engineering projects.
    • Experience in designing complex mechanical systems, preferably in the energy or nuclear industry.
    • Familiarity with CAD software and engineering analysis tools.


Competences and preferred skills

  • Experience developing remote maintenance systems operating in hazardous environments
  • Strong background in mechatronics, motion control and mechanical integration. 
  • Experience with digital mock-up will be an asset
  • Familiarity with maintenance, inspection and intervention systems 
  • Familiarity with system engineering processes, requirements management and verification activities. Strong understanding of mechanical design principles and engineering mechanics.
  • Proficiency in structural analysis, finite element analysis (FEA), and kinematic analysis.
  • Ability to manage multidisciplinary teams and coordinate with other engineering disciplines.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Du denkst Systeme vom Datenmodell bis zur Oberfläche, konzipierst gern technische Lösungen und übernimmst Verantwortung dafür, dass sie am Ende auch so umgesetzt werden? Dann bist du als Senior Fullstack-Entwickler (m/w/d) / Senior Webentwickler PHP/Laravel (m/w/d) beim Händlerbund genau richtig!

Bei uns entwickelst du an einer Plattform, die rechtliche Prozesse digital abbildet und automatisiert. Von der Erstellung rechtlicher Inhalte über Vertrags- und Prüfprozesse bis hin zu Datenschutz- und Sicherheitsfragen. Dazu gehören Schnittstellen und Plugins, über die unsere Inhalte in die Shopsysteme unserer Mitglieder gelangen, sowie Integrationen mit Partnersystemen. Ziel ist es, komplexe rechtliche Anforderungen in verlässliche, verständliche und effiziente digitale Workflows zu überführen.

In dieser Rolle übernimmst du die technische Leitung von Projekten, die wir in kleinen Projektteams umsetzen: Du konzipierst Lösungen, verantwortest die Umsetzung, leitest andere Entwickler im Projekt an und hältst alle Beteiligten über den Stand auf dem Laufenden. Kleinere Projekte setzt du eigenständig komplett um, bei größeren arbeitest du im Team mit Laravel und Livewire im Stack.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Technische Konzeption: Analyse von Anforderungen, Entwurf der Lösungsarchitektur, Festlegung von Datenmodellen und Schnittstellen sowie Einschätzung von Aufwänden für Features und Projekte.

  • Ownership für die Umsetzung: Verantwortung dafür, dass ein Projekt von der Konzeption bis zum Go-live ankommt. Aufgaben schneiden und priorisieren, Fortschritt im Blick behalten, technische Entscheidungen treffen und Blocker aus dem Weg räumen.

  • Anleitung & Wissenstransfer: Fachliche Führung weiterer Entwickler im Projekt durch klare technische Vorgaben, Pairing und Code Reviews im Backend wie im Frontend. Wissen über Architektur und Entscheidungen landet im Team und in der Dokumentation, nicht nur bei dir.

  • Reporting: Regelmäßige, verständliche Berichte zu Stand, Risiken und nächsten Schritten an Team Lead, Product Owner und Stakeholder.

  • Fullstack-Entwicklung: Umsetzung mit Laravel, Livewire, Alpine.js, Flux UI und Tailwind CSS. Kleinere Projekte eigenständig von Anfang bis Ende, größere im Projektteam.

  • Partneranbindungen & Integrationen: Lösungsevaluierung, Umsetzung und Dokumentation von Schnittstellen zu Partner- und Drittsystemen.

  • Architektur & Technologie-Evaluation: Mitgestaltung von Architektur, Entwicklungsstandards und Tooling; Evaluation neuer Technologien, Frameworks und KI-Einsatzmöglichkeiten im Hinblick auf ihren konkreten Nutzen für Produkt und Team.


Dein Profil

Technisch

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit PHP & Laravel: Entwicklung von Webanwendungen über den gesamten Stack, im Frontend idealerweise mit Livewire, Alpine.js, Flux UI und Tailwind CSS.

  • Konzeption & technische Leitung: Erfahrung darin, technische Konzepte zu erarbeiten und deren Umsetzung zu verantworten, allein oder als technische Leitung eines Projektteams.

  • Code Reviews über den gesamten Stack: Praxis im Review von Backend- und Frontend-Code und die Fähigkeit, Feedback so zu geben, dass andere daran wachsen.

  • Testerfahrung: Sicherer Umgang mit PHPUnit oder Pest und Erfahrung mit Teststrategien in größeren Codebasen. Tests sind für dich Teil der Umsetzung, nicht Nacharbeit.

  • Datenbanken & APIs: Sicherer Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken, Datenmodellierung und API-Design.

  • Agile Teamarbeit: Erfahrung in agilen Teams, idealerweise mit Scrum, inklusive enger Zusammenarbeit und kontinuierlichem Austausch.


Nice to Have, aber kein Muss

  • DevOps-Erfahrung: Cloud-Systeme, PaaS-Plattformen, Container, CI/CD oder Linux-Serveradministration (z.B. DigitalOcean und Laravel Cloud)

  • Erfahrung mit Shopsystemen und der Entwicklung von Plugins oder Apps dafür (z.B. Shopify oder JTL)

  • Gespür für UX und Erfahrung in der Gestaltung benutzerfreundlicher Oberflächen

  • Erfahrung mit Event-basierten Architekturen, Queues oder asynchronen Verarbeitungsprozessen

  • Erfahrung mit der Integration von LLM-APIs in Produktfeatures (Prompting, Evaluierung, Guardrails)


Persönlich

  • Ownership: Du fühlst dich für das Ergebnis eines Projekts verantwortlich. Von der ersten Skizze bis zum Go-live und darüber hinaus und nicht nur für deine eigenen Tickets.

  • Systemisches Denken: Du siehst die Auswirkungen von Änderungen über Komponenten- und Teamgrenzen hinweg.

  • Pragmatismus: Du findest die Balance zwischen sauberer Lösung und pragmatischem Fortschritt.

  • Wissenstransfer: Du hast Freude daran, Wissen weiterzugeben und andere im Team besser zu machen, bspw. in Reviews, Pairings und Dokumentation.

  • KI als Werkzeug: Du nutzt KI-Tools im Entwicklungsalltag selbstverständlich und beurteilst nüchtern, wo sie im Produkt echten Nutzen bringen und wo nicht.


Warum wir?

Code. Chill. Repeat.

  • 4 Tage Code – 3 Tage du selbst: Bei uns ist die 4-Tage-Woche Standard. Kein Gimmick, sondern Realität. Du arbeitest remote oder im Leipziger Büro – so, wie du am besten performst. Flexzeiten, kein Micromanagement, volle Eigenverantwortung. Und ja: unbefristet von Anfang an.

  • Professionalität: echte Qualität statt Show-off. Wir leben agile Entwicklung mit klaren Iterationen und direktem Feedback. Du arbeitest mit modernen, professionellen Tools, mit klaren Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten – du weißt genau, was dein Job ist und hast die Freiheit, ihn so zu machen, wie es richtig ist. Sauberer Code, smarte Entscheidungen und ein Team, das zusammenarbeitet. Professionalität heißt hier: Du kannst dich auf das konzentrieren, was du am besten kannst – entwickeln.

  • Snacks, Swag & Softdrinks: Obst, Müsli, Kaffee, Wasser – alles for free. Kein Dresscode. Komm, wie du bist. Hauptsache du fühlst dich wohl.

Dein Weg zu uns
