description:
Network Operations Engineer

1. About the role

Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure into a single layer and give ISPs, hyperscalers, and AI companies a clean path to deliver connectivity into every home and business across Kenya and the continent. Behind that marketplace is a real network: a BGP edge peering with Tier 1 transit, hyperscalers, and local exchanges, an MPLS backbone, aggregation and access gear, and the systems that watch all of it.

For the partners who run on us, the network is the product, and the NOC is where they feel it. A clean shift is a partner who never knew anything happened. That is the bar.

We are early and the team is small, so we cannot afford a pair of hands that only knows how to escalate. We need a capable network engineer who can stand a shift, resolve real faults without waking anyone, and then keep building the network while East Africa sleeps: propagation and peering checks, health passes across the estate, config changes through to merge, tickets off the board, automation that takes the next repetitive job off everyone's plate. The watching is the floor of this role, not the ceiling.

The NOC you would be joining is not a legacy one. We are building it as an AI assisted operations environment from the ground up. The forwarding plane runs on open source routing and forwarding software, every device configuration lives in Git, and an LLM layer sits on top of the live network state. When something moves, that layer reads the telemetry, correlates it against the topology and the config history, and puts a probable cause and a candidate fix in front of the engineer on shift. The point is not to replace your judgment. It is to collapse the time between an alert firing and you knowing where to look, so mean time to repair is measured in minutes.

You sit inside that system. You use it, you push back on it when it is wrong, and what you catch that it misses is part of how it gets smarter. As we build automation out across the NOC, you are not just a consumer of the tooling. You help write it.

2. What you'll do

Watch, and know what you're looking at. Sit on our monitoring stack (Zabbix and Grafana dashboards, flow telemetry, alerting) and actually read it. Learn what normal looks like so abnormal jumps out at you: a BGP session that dropped, a link that went down, latency climbing on a path, a capacity threshold breached, a partner suddenly pushing or pulling nothing.

Troubleshoot and resolve. This is where you earn your seat. Confirm the alert is real, gather the facts, and localise the fault: one peer or many, us or upstream, a real outage or a monitoring blip. The assistive layer surfaces a likely diagnosis and a suggested fix, the config history is right there in Git, and the runbooks are live. Your job is to read all of it critically, decide what is actually true, and close out what you can on your own. Every ticket you resolve yourself is one our senior people did not get pulled out of deep work, or out of bed, to deal with.

Keep the network healthy, not just alive. A quiet shift is not an idle one. Run the proactive passes: check that routes are propagating the way they should, that RPKI and filter chains are doing their job, that peering and transit sessions are clean across the edge, that no PoP is drifting toward a capacity wall. Catch the slow degradations that never trip an alert. The day team should inherit a network in a known good state.

Build and automate. The repetitive parts of this job should not stay repetitive. Write the scripts that turn a manual check into a scheduled one. Push our config automation forward (Jinja driven generation, NAPALM or NETCONF/gNMI against the devices) so changes ship from data, not from memory. When the assistive layer keeps missing the same thing, that is a candidate for automation, and you are well placed to build it during the hours nobody else is online.

Move the work forward. You are part of the network team, working the same board they do. Pick up tickets from the Linear queue, take config changes through review to merge, and keep our source of truth (Nautobot) accurate as the estate changes. Real work lands while East Africa is offline, so the team wakes up further ahead than they went to bed.

Report exactly what is happening. For everything you cannot or should not fix alone, the handoff has to be clean: what is wrong, where, since when, what is affected, whether it is getting worse, and what you have already tried. No guessing dressed up as fact. No "the internet is down." A clear, written incident note a senior engineer can act on the moment they open it, and a tidy handover to the East Africa team at the end of your shift.

Escalate well. Know the ladder cold: what you are cleared to touch, what you must not touch alone, and who to bring in for what. Escalating early on a genuine outage is good judgment. Sitting silently on a problem because you were unsure is the one thing that gets people out of bed angry. Handle what you can, raise the rest fast and clearly, and do not turn either dial too far.

3. Who we're looking for

A network engineer who can stand on their own through a shift, and who treats the quiet hours as time to build rather than time to wait. You will not be the most senior engineer on this team, and you do not need to be. The people you escalate to are CCIE level. What we need from you is independence and range: work a problem properly, resolve a fair share of it yourself, and use what is left of the shift to actually move the network forward. Pair that with clear reporting, sound judgment about when to bring in help, and the instinct to question a machine's suggestion rather than follow it blindly, and you are who we are looking for.

Must-have

  • Strong networking competence, held in your hands rather than on paper. CCNA and well beyond it. You understand TCP/IP, routing and switching, IP addressing and subnetting, DNS, DHCP, NAT, and how they behave when they go wrong.

  • Real troubleshooting instinct. Given a degraded link or a dropped session, you know where to look and what to rule out. You can read BGP session state, follow a path with ping and traceroute, and tell a local fault from an upstream one without waiting to be told.

  • Working BGP knowledge. Reading communities and route policy, spotting a flap or a leaky origin, understanding how transit, peering, and RPKI behave at the edge.

  • Comfortable on the gear and the CLI. Linux, network device CLIs, and dashboards are familiar ground. We run MikroTik (RouterOS) across the network and so do many partners, so RouterOS experience is a real plus.

  • Comfortable working with config in Git. Configuration lives in repos, not on devices. Reading a diff, understanding why a config changed, and proposing one yourself should not be foreign to you.

  • Some scripting, and the appetite to do more. Bash or Python, enough to automate the repetitive parts away and to grow into our config and automation pipelines. We are not hiring a button pusher.

  • Clear written English. You can describe a technical situation accurately and briefly so someone picking it up cold understands it instantly.

  • Calm under pressure and dependable. When the graphs go red you get more precise, not more panicked. You show up for every shift, alert and on time.

  • Located in New Zealand or a nearby time zone where covering our deep overnight maps onto your normal working day.

Nice-to-have

  • CCNP, or MikroTik MTCNA / MTCRE.

  • Prior NOC, ISP, or carrier operations experience.

  • Hands on with MPLS (L3VPN, EVPN) and the multi-tenant isolation a shared backbone needs.

  • Exposure to open source and white box routing or forwarding stacks (SONiC, IP Infusion OcNOS, FRR, or similar).

  • Network source of truth and automation tooling (Nautobot, NAPALM, Jinja config generation, NETCONF or gNMI).

  • Familiarity with a monitoring stack such as Zabbix, Grafana, Loki, or Prometheus, and with flow telemetry.

  • Working familiarity with FreeRADIUS, CoA and Disconnect flows, and how session control and accounting hook into the network.

  • Exposure to applying ML or AI in network operations: anomaly detection, predictive failure analysis, automated triage or remediation.

  • IPv6 and dual stack exposure, and internet exchange operations (looking glass and route server behaviour, IRR and RPKI hygiene).

4. What we offer

  • A seat inside a serious, very senior network team, with people who have deep service provider backgrounds and will sharpen you fast. You will see how a real carrier network behaves under live conditions.

  • A front row seat to how a network actually gets run in 2026. Open source forwarding, config as code, and an LLM layer doing real operational work. Not a slide about the future of network operations, but the environment you would work in every shift, and help build.

  • Real engineering, not just monitoring. The role is built so the quiet hours go into automation, propagation and health work, and tickets off the board. The path into deeper network engineering and automation work is the plan, not a vague someday.

  • Competitive salary and private health and wellness benefits, fully remote, in a mission driven, investor backed company building the backbone of Africa's next generation internet.

description:
About us

At CYCLE, we're redefining urban mobility for the people who keep cities moving: couriers, riders, and delivery pros. Our e-bike subscription service combines durable vehicles, fast repairs, and real support, everything riders need to stay on the road.
From Berlin to London, Vienna to Amsterdam, we operate in 200+ cities across Europe, providing thousands of riders with bikes built for work, not for show.
Our mission is simple: make last-mile delivery more reliable, affordable, and sustainable, one ride at a time. With every bike we deploy, we're helping build the backbone of smarter, greener cities.
Ride with us into the future - sustainable, efficient, and full speed ahead!


Your Mission

As Head of Supply Chain, you own every part of how physical goods reach our fleet and our riders, from the purchase order to the shelf to the courier's bike. You report to our Director of Operations and work directly with Hardware, Finance, Software and our country teams. In particular you will:

  • Own supply chain end to end: Purchasing, warehousing, stock keeping and outbound logistics across our European network, as one function with one owner. You ultimately ensure we have the right number of bikes, batteries and parts at the right time, the right place and the best price.
  • Oversee our assembly & refurbishment activities: Manage our assembly and refurbishment partners, own the bills of material for everything we build from purchased components as well as internal refurbishment within our locations.
  • Own the systems, not just the process: Take full responsibility for our ERP and warehouse management setup for all supply chain topics, from data model and master data through to daily execution – you will be the business owner to our software team and guide implementation.
  • Professionalize the structure: Design and implement the processes, controls and physical setup our growing operation needs, and then get your hands dirty making them real and ensuring your organization internalizes them.
  • Own the numbers behind the goods: You will guide the rest of the company on such topics as transfer prices, landed cost allocation and other supply-chain related financials, ensuring each business line's P&L is accurately reflecting parts consumption and asset usage – together with our Finance team.
  • Drive the agenda across teams: Set priorities, align Hardware, Finance and Tech behind them, and hold the line when it matters. 
  • Partner with the larger organization and understand your impact on them: All you do, you do with the end goal in mind to become the best friend of our Local and Country Operations and Sales teams, who all depend on your fulfillment excellence to grow and maintain their businesses.
  • Lead and grow your team: Build a supply chain organization that scales with us across markets.


Your skills and qualifications

We are looking for someone who has built structure inside a well-run company and is ready to build it again from scratch, with their sleeves rolled up. Ideally you bring:

  • 10+ years of relevant professional experience, of which at least 5 in a managerial supply chain or operations role.
  • Experience leading a team of at least 3 direct reports in a supply chain or operations-heavy function.
  • Structure from an established company: You have worked inside proper processes and systems and know what good looks like.
  • 0 to 1 experience: You have also built something from nothing in a smaller or fast-moving company or demonstrated you can excel in such a setting, and you are comfortable being scrappy when that is what the situation needs.
  • Commercial and financial fluency: Working capital optimization, inter-company transactions or product costing,  are all familiar territory for you.
  • Cross-functional communication: You can carry a topic across teams and drive it to a decision.
  • Ownership and a firm, professional attitude: You take the whole problem, not your part of it.
  • English at C1 level or above

Nice to have:
  • Hands-on experience with Odoo or a comparable ERP, ideally including experience in shaping or designing a system for supply chain topics rather than execution alone.
  • Background in bike, scooter, mobility or another hardware-heavy industry where physical goods move between internal as well as external locations.
  • German or Dutch


What you can expect from us


  • Exciting industry: You will work in the dynamic world of mobility, which is a constantly evolving sector.
  • Real impact: Your work improves the lives of many bike couriers.
  • Take on immediate responsibility: Start making a difference right away and implement your own ideas. Boredom? Not a chance!
  • Shape the future: As part of our growing start-up, you will help to shape tomorrow's mobility.
  • International team & Strong network: Work alongside motivated colleagues from all over the world. Teamwork is very important to us.
  • Fair conditions: We offer a stable employment with attractive salary, €50 HRmony voucher, a company e-bike, modern equipment and 28 days' holiday a year.


Diversity

At CYCLE, we believe diversity makes us stronger. No matter who you are, where you're from, or what makes you unique, you're welcome here.

Das erwartet dich

Wir bauen mit unserem Green-Field-Ansatz eine neue Cloud in unseren deutschen Rechenzentren auf — vollständig selbst gehostet, cloud-native und ohne Abhängigkeit von amerikanischen Hyperscalern. Jeder unserer Kunden erhält ein dediziertes Kubernetes-Cluster auf Basis des SUSE-Stacks (Harvester, RKE2), ausgerollt und verwaltet über Fleet, mit eigenem Tenant-Management.

Du bist nicht Betreiber eines fremden Systems, sondern gestaltest die Plattform, auf der unsere Software als SaaS läuft — mit echter Verantwortung und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum.

Digitale Souveränität ist bei uns kein Versprechen, sondern Betriebsrealität. Auf dieser Plattform laufen die geschäftskritischen Anwendungen von Versicherern und Auftraggebern der öffentlichen Hand. Die Anforderungen an Verfügbarkeit, Informationssicherheit und Nachweisbarkeit sind auf allerhöchsten Level. Hierfür sind unsere Managed Services nach BSI C5 testiert.

Das erwartet dich

Plattform entwickeln und gestalten

  • Konzeption, Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung der selbst gehosteten Cloud-Plattform (Multi-Cluster, ohne Hyperscaler-Abhängigkeit, volle Kontrolle)
  • Architektur und Design hochverfügbarer Kubernetes-Cluster im SUSE-Stack, inklusive Networking, Storage, Load Balancing und Authentifizierung
  • Design und Weiterentwicklung des Tenant-Konzepts: isolierte Kundenumgebungen, Verantwortung für Architektur und Lifecycle
  • Abstimmung mit der Entwicklung zu performance- und verfügbarkeitsrelevanten Anforderungen an das Cluster- und Tenant-Konzept
  • Weiterentwicklung des Hochverfügbarkeitskonzepts: Ein verteilter In-Memory Ansatz über mehrere Knoten (Schwarmtechnik), der die Echtzeitfähigkeit der Anwendungen im Normalbetrieb sicherstellt
Automatisieren und standardisieren
  • GitOps-Workflows über ArgoCD und Fleet — von der Erstauslieferung bis zum Day-2-Betrieb vollständig automatisiert
  • Infrastructure as Code mit Ansible, Terraform oder vergleichbaren Tools; Policy as Code für Sicherheit und Governance
  • CI/CD-Integration und Standardisierung der Deployment-Prozesse
Brücke zu den Entwicklungsteams und Kunden
  • Platform Engineering für interne Teams: Aufbau von Self-Service-Fähigkeiten, Definition von Standards, Begleitung des Onboardings
  • Aktive Unterstützung der Entwicklungsteams bei der Migration ihrer Workloads in die Cloud-Plattform
  • Verarbeitung von Erkenntnissen aus dem laufenden Betrieb (Monitoring-Daten, Incidents) zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung von Stabilität, Sicherheit und Performance


Das bringst du mit

Must-have

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Cloud- oder Platform-Engineering, in Container-Technologien oder Infrastrukturautomatisierung
  • Fundierte Kubernetes Kenntnisse, idealerweise aus dem Betrieb produktiver Multi-Cluster-Umgebungen
  • Erfahrung mit GitOps-Workflows (idealerweise ArgoCD oder Fleet) und Infrastructure as Code (z. B. Ansible, Terraform)
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1) sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Reisebereitschaft für Kundentermine und Termine an unseren weiteren Standorten
Nice-to-have
  • Erfahrung mit SUSE Stack oder vergleichbaren Kubernetes-Management-Plattformen
  • Kenntnisse in DevSecOps, Policy as Code oder Hochverfügbarkeitskonzepten
  • Erfahrung mit Monitoring-Stacks (z. B. Prometheus, Grafana)
Persönlich
  • Systemisches Denken statt Ticket-Fokus, mit Blick fürs Gesamtbild
  • Sicheres Auftreten und Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe mit Entwicklungsteams wie mit Kunden
  • Strukturierte, eigenständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Erfahrung darin, Themen über Team- und Kundengrenzen hinweg zu steuern


Was wir dir bieten

  • Übernimm Verantwortung und nutze deinen Gestaltungsspielraum, um eigene Ideen zu verwirklichen.
  • Arbeite dort, wo Wirkung entsteht: im Office oder direkt beim Kunden. Homeoffice ist die Ausnahme – dafür bieten wir dir flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein Office, in dem man gerne arbeitet und den Tag gemeinsam verbringt.
  • Profitiere von internen und externen Schulungen, die dich fachlich und persönlich weiterbringen.
  • Genieße Benefits wie BusinessBike, EGYM Wellpass, Corporate Benefits und einen Zuschuss für den ÖPNV.
  • Neben einem VWL-Zuschuss bieten wir dir eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge und eine Kita-Förderung.
  • Ob Surfen, Wandern, Mountainbiken oder Golfen – bei unseren vielseitigen Mitarbeiter-Events ist für jeden etwas dabei!

description:
Warum LPE Immobilien?

  • Die Hausverwaltung ist der unterschätzteste Beruf Deutschlands: Kein anderer entscheidet so unmittelbar darüber, wie Menschen wohnen. Trotzdem gilt der Hausverwalter bis heute als Buchhalter mit Schlüsselbund. Wir wollen das ändern, und Software ist dafür einer unserer zentralen Hebel.
  • Mit lpeOS bauen wir die Systeme, mit denen wir selbst jeden Tag arbeiten: das Kundenportal für unsere Eigentümer, KI-Agenten, die eigenständig Aufgaben übernehmen, und das Verwaltercockpit als Arbeitsumgebung unserer Verwalter. Wir digitalisieren unsere eigenen Prozesse, um die Arbeit unserer Verwalter jeden Tag ein Stück besser zu machen, mit dem Anspruch, die Branche zu revolutionieren.
  • Kaum eine Branche wurde von moderner Software so lange übersehen. Der Abstand zwischen dem, was ist, und dem, was möglich ist, ist riesig, und wir bauen ihn Stück für Stück zu. Du wärst eine der ersten Personen im Produktteam.


Was dich bei uns erwartet – Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst Fullstack in TypeScript, vom Kundenportal über das Verwaltercockpit bis zu den Services und der Infrastruktur dahinter, auf der grünen Wiese und ohne Altlasten. Features verantwortest du end-to-end: von der Idee über die Gestaltung bis zum Release, bei Bedarf auch ohne Designer an deiner Seite.
  • Du baust KI-Agenten als Produktfunktionalität für unsere Verwalter und Kunden. Zugleich entwickeln wir unsere eigene Entwicklungsumgebung permanent weiter: ein modernes Setup rund um Cursor und Claude Code, inklusive Agent-Graph-Loops und Harness.
  • Dabei arbeitest du nah an den Nutzern: Deine Kolleginnen, Kollegen und Kunden sind direkt erreichbar, Feedback bekommst du auf kurzem und direktem Weg. Wir sammeln Probleme, bewerten sie und bauen die wichtigsten in festen Cycles.
  • Unser Stack: TypeScript durchgehend, mit React und Next.js im Frontend und Node im Backend, als Monorepo auf Google Cloud (Infrastructure as Code), dazu Postgres und event-getriebene Prozesse. Du musst nicht alles davon kennen, den Rest lernst du bei uns.


Was du mitbringen solltest

  • 2 bis 4 Jahre Erfahrung in der Webentwicklung.
  • Sichere Praxis in TypeScript oder JavaScript, idealerweise mit React oder Next.js.
  • Ein aktuelles Projekt, das du zeigen kannst: Produktionscode, Side Project oder Open Source.
  • Du arbeitest gern quer über den ganzen Stack und magst Frontend und Backend ähnlich gern.
  • Du verantwortest Features end-to-end und kannst bei Bedarf auch ohne Designer ein gutes Interface gestalten.
  • KI-Tooling ist Teil deines Arbeitsalltags, und du prüfst die Ergebnisse genauso kritisch, wie du sie nutzt.
  • Grundverständnis von Datenbanken (SQL) und API-Design.
  • Du willst verstehen, warum etwas gebaut wird, bevor du es baust.
  • Deutschkenntnisse mindestens auf B2-Niveau.
Du erfüllst nicht alle Punkte? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Talent und Lernkurve zählen bei uns mehr als Jahreszahlen im Lebenslauf.


Was wir dir bieten

  • Eine seltene Ausgangslage. Wir bauen Software für ein Geschäftsmodell, das bereits funktioniert, und wissen, dass sie gebraucht wird. Du erlebst aus nächster Nähe, wie sich eine ganze Branche neu erfindet, und gestaltest das aktiv mit.
  • Echter Impact. Alles, was du baust, kommt bei unseren Verwaltern, Eigentümern und Kunden direkt zum Einsatz.
  • Eine Branche von innen kennenlernen. Die Immobilienwirtschaft ist einer der größten Märkte Deutschlands und steht erst am Anfang ihrer Digitalisierung. Du lernst sie dort kennen, wo die Entscheidungen fallen.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Produktverantwortlichen. Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen und jemand, der sich Zeit für deine Fragen nimmt.
  • Mentoring und Weiterentwicklung. Wohin du dich entwickeln willst, besprechen wir offen und regelmäßig. Mentoring ist bei uns in alle Richtungen möglich, fachlich wie persönlich.
  • Ehrliches Feedback. Sofort und in beide Richtungen.
  • Die richtigen Werkzeuge. Premium-Hardware, cloudbasierte Tools, aktuelles KI-Tooling, papierlos. Wenn dir etwas fehlt, um besser zu arbeiten, bekommst du es.
  • Perspektive. Diese Stelle ist so gebaut, dass sie mit dir und mit lpeOS wächst.

Deine Aufgaben:

Mission
Bei yoursquares baust du die Systeme, mit denen wir jeden Tag arbeiten.

Als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen den Problemen unserer Bauträger-Partner und unserem Tech-Stack entwickelst du Lösungen, die sofort im Alltag ankommen – und das ohne monatelange Abstimmung. Mal ist das ein sauber gebautes Tool mit eigenem Backend, mal eine Automatisierung, die in zwei Tagen steht. Du entscheidest, was die Aufgabe wirklich braucht. Wir sind vollständig bootstrapped auf über 700 % Wachstum pro Jahr gekommen. Wenn du Lust hast, unsere Produkte auf das nächste Level zu heben und dabei viel Eigenverantwortung zu übernehmen, dann ist das genau das Richtige für dich.

Dein Verantwortungsbereich

  • Du entwickelst eigenständig Software für konkrete Probleme unserer Bauträger-Kunden: Tools, Services und Integrationen – von der ersten Idee über den Prototyp bis zum produktiven Rollout. Frontend und Backend mit JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js und Python, angebunden an Datenbanken wie Supabase
  • Du konzipierst und baust APIs und System-Schnittstellen, über die unsere Tools, unser CRM und die Systeme unserer Kunden zusammenspielen
  • Du analysierst manuelle, wiederkehrende Prozesse im Unternehmen und automatisierst sie mit Make.com, n8n oder Zapier – eigenständig, statt auf einen expliziten Auftrag zu warten. Prozessgestaltung ist bei uns Teil der Rolle, nicht Zusatzaufgabe

  • Du übernimmst technische Ownership für das, was du baust: Monitoring, Troubleshooting, Testing und eine strukturierte technische Dokumentation gehören für dich dazu
  • Du triffst technische Entscheidungen eigenverantwortlich und etablierst Standards dafür, wie wir Software, Automatisierung und AI bei yoursquares einsetzen – mit direktem Einfluss darauf, wie das ganze Team zukünftig arbeitet


Das bringst du idealerweise mit:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Weiterbildung im Bereich AI, Informatik oder Tech — oder vergleichbare praktische Erfahrung

description:
Deine Aufgaben:

Mission
Content für unsere Kunden entsteht bei yoursquares nicht mehr Stück für Stück, sondern über ein System, das du aufbaust. Sobald ein Creative bei einem Kunden zieht, lässt du daraus AI-gestützt binnen kurzer Zeit ein ganzes Set an Varianten entstehen – andere Hooks, neue Formate, kürzere und längere Schnitte – und bringst sie parallel in den jeweiligen Account. Jede Version bleibt klar auf die Marke des Kunden zugeschnitten, und was weiterläuft, entscheiden die Zahlen, nicht das Bauchgefühl.

Produktentwicklung & Workflows

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Produkt-Team unseren AI-Creative-Stack weiter und gestaltest Systeme, mit denen wir deutlich mehr hochwertige Werbemittel in kürzerer Zeit produzieren können.

  • Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen Content, AI, Performance Marketing und Produkt und übersetzt operative Anforderungen in skalierbare Prozesse und Produktideen

  • Du musst dabei nicht jeden technischen Prozess selbst programmieren oder bauen. Entscheidend ist, dass du verstehst, was mit AI, Automatisierungen und modernen Tools möglich ist, wo technische Grenzen liegen und wie ein sinnvoller Workflow aussehen sollte

  • Wenn du Workflows, Automatisierungen oder Prototypen selbst bauen kannst: umso besser. Bei komplexeren Lösungen arbeitest du eng mit unserem Produkt- und Tech-Team zusammen und bringst die fachlichen Anforderungen ein

Automatisierte Content-Produktion

  • Du arbeitest täglich mit Tools wie Claude Code & Design, Make, Higgsfield. HeyGen, Midjourney, Runway, Nano Banana, und weiteren AI-Tools und verbindest sie sinnvoll miteinander

  • Du entwickelst Systeme, die aus Projektinformationen automatisiert unterschiedliche Paid-Social-Content, Videos, Landingpages und Creative-Varianten generieren können

  • Du automatisierst die Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Landingpages und sorgst dafür, dass aus wenigen Inputs möglichst schnell hochwertige, conversionstarke Seiten entstehen

  • Du entwickelst und automatisierst AI-Video-Workflows – von der ersten Idee über unterschiedliche Hooks und Szenen bis hin zu Varianten, Formaten und Cutdowns

Creative-Produktion & Performance

  • Du entwickelst High-Performing Creatives für Paid Ads selbst – Static Ads, Video, Motion, Landingpages und neue Formate

  • Du liest unsere Performance-Dashboards selbst, erkennst Muster und übersetzt die Daten direkt in neue Creative-Hypothesen und Iterationen

  • Du analysierst unter anderem Hook Rate, CTR, Conversion Rate, CPL, CPA und ROAS und nutzt diese Erkenntnisse, um unsere Creative-Produktion kontinuierlich besser zu machen

Tooling, UX & Marktbeobachtung

  • Du gestaltest auch die UX/UI unserer internen AI-Tools und Workflows mit. Dein Anspruch: Komplexe Technologie muss so einfach werden, dass jede Person im Team sie intuitiv nutzen kann

  • Du beobachtest den AI-Markt kontinuierlich und erkennst früh, welche neuen Modelle, Tools und Workflows einen echten Vorteil bringen

  • Du testest neue Technologien schnell und pragmatisch. Wenn ein neues Tool unseren bestehenden Prozess deutlich verbessert, integrierst du es – statt an bestehenden Lösungen festzuhalten


Das bringst du idealerweise mit:

  • Du bringst mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Content, Creative, AI, Automation oder einem vergleichbaren digitalen Umfeld mit.

  • Du bist AI-Native. Claude, Prompting, Make und generative AI gehören für dich zum täglichen Werkzeugkasten und sind keine Buzzwords.

  • Tools wie Nano Banana, Runway, Midjourney oder vergleichbare Lösungen hast du dir idealerweise selbst beigebracht – und du beschäftigst dich bereits mit den Tools, die sie morgen ersetzen könnten.

  • Du verstehst nicht nur einzelne AI-Tools, sondern kannst erkennen, wie unterschiedliche Tools zu einem sinnvollen Workflow zusammenspielen.

  • Du hast Spaß daran, Prozesse zu automatisieren und stellst dir regelmäßig die Frage: Warum machen wir das eigentlich noch manuell?

  • Du kannst Creatives nicht nur automatisieren, sondern hast selbst ein gutes Verständnis für Design, Content, Paid Social und Conversion.

  • Du verstehst, was einen guten Hook, eine starke Ad und eine funktionierende Landingpage ausmacht.

  • Du kannst Performance-Daten lesen und daraus konkrete Entscheidungen ableiten. Für dich gehören Creative und Performance zusammen.

  • Geschwindigkeit ist für dich kein Widerspruch zu Qualität. Die Vorstellung, sehr große Mengen an Creative-Varianten zu produzieren und zu testen, motiviert dich eher, als dass sie dich abschreckt.

  • Gleichzeitig hast du einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch: AI-Output darf nicht billig oder beliebig nach AI aussehen.

  • Du arbeitest eigenständig, pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert und hast Lust darauf, Dinge aufzubauen, für die es noch keine fertige Anleitung gibt.

  • Du fühlst dich in einem schnellen Start-up-Umfeld wohl, übernimmst Verantwortung und möchtest Strukturen nicht nur nutzen, sondern aktiv mitgestalten.

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

  • Erfahrung mit Make, APIs, Webhooks oder No-/Low-Code-Automatisierungen

  • Grundverständnis für LLMs, APIs und AI Agents

description:
Your mission

As our Quality Assurance Engineer (Software), you will help ensure the quality, reliability and usability of ProGlove’s connected solutions across embedded and IoT devices, mobile applications, front-end experiences and back-end services.

You will take ownership of quality assurance within the team, combining thoughtful manual testing with effective automation. By challenging assumptions, investigating complex system behavior and continuously improving how we test, you will help us deliver dependable products to our customers.

In this role, you will:

  • Take ownership of QA processes within the team and champion quality throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Analyze end-to-end system architectures, user flows and integrations to identify risks and gaps in test coverage.
  • Create clear and concise test plans based on product and technical requirements and document them in TestRail.
  • Plan and execute functional, regression, API, integration and cross-platform testing.
  • Contribute to our automation frameworks by designing and implementing new automated tests and maintaining existing test suites.
  • Perform hands-on manual and exploratory testing where it adds value.
  • Configure and maintain dedicated test environments and test data and support performance and load testing when required.
  • Share findings transparently, raise risks early and collaborate with engineers and other stakeholders to resolve issues.
  • Continuously improve our testing approaches, tools and ways of working.


Your profile

At ProGlove, technical expertise matter, but how you work is just as important. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, stays curious, collaborates openly and applies pragmatic judgment.

  • You bring 4+ years of relevant quality assurance experience, including at least 2 years of hands-on test automation experience.
  • You have experience building or contributing to automation frameworks and maintaining automated test suites.
  • You understand and can apply the full Software Testing Life Cycle, including functional, regression, API, integration and cross-platform testing.
  • You can analyze end-to-end architectures, user flows and integrations, identify quality risks and translate them into appropriate test coverage.
  • You have hands-on experience with automation tools  and frameworks such as Pytest, Cypress, Selenium, Appium or REST Assured.
  • You are comfortable configuring and maintaining test environments and test data.
  • You have experience executing performance or load tests.
  • You take end-to-end ownership, communicate clearly and raise risks early.
  • You enjoy investigating complex issues, challenging assumptions and balancing thoroughness with pragmatism.
  • You collaborate openly with engineers and other stakeholders.
  • You are fluent in English and comfortable working in an international environment.

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be valuable, but is not required:

  • Python or JavaScript and Git
  • UNIX or Linux environments
  • Agile product development environments
  • Test documentation tools, especially TestRail
  • AWS or other cloud platforms
  • Testing embedded systems, IoT devices, mobile applications or connected hardware ecosystems


Why us?

  • Diversity and inclusion: Diversity is core to us and one of the reasons for our success.
  • Career development: We support active and individual career planning and progression at your own pace.
  • Cutting-edge technology: Choose the devices that work best for you from our range of supported IT products.
  • Location-specific benefits: Benefit from offerings tailored to your location, such as gym membership, pension funding and mobility support.
  • ProHealth: Our global health program supports the physical and mental well-being of all team members.
  • Employee referral rewards: Earn €2,000 before tax by referring someone who joins our team.
  • Office events: In addition to our summer and winter parties, smaller office events are part of everyday life at ProGlove.


What success looks like

  • Quality risks are identified early, communicated clearly and addressed before they affect customers.
  • Critical user flows and integrations have reliable, risk-based test coverage across the relevant platforms and system components.
  • Automated test coverage grows in a maintainable way and supports faster, more confident releases.
  • Test plans, results and quality documentation are clear, current and useful to the relevant stakeholders.
  • QA is an active part of product development, with shared ownership of quality across the team.
  • Testing processes, environments and tools become more effective and scalable over time.


Meet your team

You will join our Quality Assurance team and work closely with software, embedded and mobile engineers, as well as other relevant stakeholders across Product and Engineering.

The team values hands-on collaboration, clear communication and shared ownership of product quality. You will contribute your perspective early in the development process, help the team understand quality risks and work together with colleagues to turn requirements and user flows into practical, maintainable test coverage.

New Challenge

About Us 
Project Q GmbH ("Q") is a Germany-based DefenseTech company with offices in Berlin and Munich. We network market-available sensors, effectors, or situational awareness systems into a tactical IoT backbone that reliably provides armed forces and security agencies with cross-domain information superiority — automated, scalable, and cost-efficient.

Our solutions integrate seamlessly into existing defense and maritime infrastructures, delivering fast data fusion and AI-enhanced analytics for robust situational awareness in dynamic environments. We build platform-agnostic systems that enable real interoperability across domains.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll directly impact the technical direction of our orchestration products – Hydris – the coordination engine for sensors and mission systems, and the interoperability API that underpins it. 

You'll work at the layer where heterogeneous real-world systems like radars, AIS receivers, LoRa mesh radios, satellite feeds, and C2 platforms become a single coherent picture. The problems lie in distributed systems, protocols, and data modeling areas. They play out in environments that are bandwidth-constrained, intermittently connected, and operationally unforgiving. 

The role is deeply hands-on, but it expects you to shape what we build and how we build it, not just deliver what's specified.

What you'll do
Core engine development

  • Design and build the systems that power Hydris.
  • Go is your primary language. You should be comfortable reading Rust and TypeScript across the codebase, even if you're not writing in them day-to-day.
  • Own the architecture of a system that must run reliably on edge hardware, in disconnected mesh networks, and at scale — often all of that simultaneously.
Protocol and integration architecture
  • Evolve the schema that defines how every sensor, asset, and mission system talks to Hydris.
  • Make API design decisions that hold up across our client libraries without creating a maintenance burden.
  • Continue refining the integration framework that lets Hydris connect to new sensor types, data sources, and command systems.
  • Set the patterns for how built-in integrations (ADS-B, AIS, ASTERIX, Meshtastic, SpaceTrack, TAK, federation) are structured, tested, and maintained.
  • Make it straightforward for external developers and system vendors to build their own plugins/integrations to Hydris.
Distributed systems
  • Architect the peer-to-peer mesh and federation layer that keeps Hydris operational in disconnected, denied, intermittent, and limited-bandwidth environments.
  • Solve the hard coordination problems: conflict resolution across federated nodes, eventual consistency of entity state, and track correlation across unreliable links.
  • Ensure the system degrades gracefully rather than failing completely when connectivity is lost or constrained.
Technical leadership
  • Set technical standards for the codebase: how we test distributed behavior, how we handle protocol versioning, how we think about backward compatibility in an API-first product.
  • Review code with a focus on long-term maintainability and operational correctness, not just feature completion.
  • Make build-versus-integrate decisions and help the team clearly understand the trade-offs.

You should apply if you
  • Have built and shipped distributed systems that run in production, ideally in environments where reliability matters more than convenience.
  • Are comfortable working across the stack, from Protobuf schema design and systems-level Go, to the TypeScript that puts a map in front of a user.
  • Have well-formed views about API design and protocol evolution, informed by experience maintaining APIs that other people depend on.
  • Can operate effectively with a high degree of autonomy but are adept at collaboration with colleagues toward high-quality technical decisions, at scale.
  • Are interested in contributing to European military, maritime, and critical infrastructure defence systems.
  • Write clearly and communicate architectural decisions in a way that survives beyond the conversation where they were made. 
  • Working language is English. German is not required.
You'd be a great fit with
  • Experience with geospatial systems, sensor fusion, or track management.
  • Familiarity with defense or ISR data standards like CoT/TAK, ASTERIX, SAPIENT, MIL-STD-2525.
  • Background in networking, mesh architectures, or systems designed for contested or degraded communication environments.
  • Experience working on developer-facing open-source infrastructure where adoption depends on the quality of the API and documentation.

We Offer
  • Remote work anywhere in Germany, or hybrid/on-site in Berlin or Munich if you're already based there and prefer an office.
  • High degree of autonomy and ownership, a flat structure, and real input into technical direction.
  • Annual €1500 Learning & development budget (available after probation).
  • Bike Leasing and Urban Sports Club membership.
  • 30 days of paid time off.
Note: We're unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role – candidates must already be eligible to work in Germany.

Since our inception in 2012, we've harnessed cutting-edge technology to transform the way physicians acquire and apply scientific knowledge. Each AMBOSSian is passionate about being the champion of clinicians today - this motivates and unites us each day towards success. And what does success look like? When a clinician or med student tells us, “AMBOSS makes practicing medicine easier and enjoyable. I love what I do, and a big part is because of AMBOSS.”

We are AMBOSS, and we’re looking for a Backend Engineer in the Shop team. Engineers at AMBOSS are at the forefront of shaping user experience for doctors and students, helping them make critical decisions, ultimately impacting the healthcare of billions of people worldwide. We are looking for someone with a passion for technology who wants to keep growing their engineering craft while helping the team raise its bar. We work AI-first: agentic tools like Claude Code are part of our daily engineering workflow, and we are looking for someone excited to help shape how software gets built in this new era. Join our agile team on a mission to build and run the gateway that lets medical students and clinicians around the world access the AMBOSS platform

If you’d like to learn more about our unique culture, check out this video.

You will:

You bring:

description:
HEY THERE

At Yazio, we help millions of users every day on their journey to healthy nutrition and greater well-being. We're hiring a Backend Engineering Manager to lead our Backend Team, a small, senior team behind Yazio's API and all of the AI features in the app. This role is for an engineering manager who has led a team before and enjoys helping experienced engineers take full ownership of their work, including the conversations with Product.

 

Let's shape the future of nutrition together and make Yazio the most successful nutrition app worldwide!

 

This role is 100% remote and open to candidates based in Germany, Spain, Portugal or the UK.

YOUR MISSION

Our Backend Team works with the product squads across Yazio, including Monetization, Growth, Tracking Experience, Mobile Platform and Web, as well as Internal Tools and our CRM team. As its manager, you'll give the engineers the context and support they need to own their initiatives end to end, from planning through to conversations with each squad.

 

In your first year, you'll:

  • Take ownership of the team's rituals in your first couple of months (stand-ups, refinements, sprint planning, retros and a bi-weekly written sync) and keep improving how the team works

  • Build close working relationships with squad leads and product managers, so backend work is part of each squad's plans from the start of the quarter

  • Own the team's part of our OKR process: build the quarterly roadmap with the engineers and keep progress visible to the teams that depend on it

  • Grow the team through regular 1:1s, development goals and timely feedback, and step in early when accountability slips

  • Hire for the team as it grows, together with our Talent Acquisition team

  • Keep an eye on production: when an issue or outage comes up, make sure it gets to the right person and is resolved

YOUR PROFILE

You'll thrive here if:

  • You've led an engineering team with direct reports, and you've helped that team take on new responsibilities or change the way it works

  • Before moving into management, you spent several years as a senior backend engineer, so you're comfortable discussing system design, infrastructure and technical trade-offs with a very experienced team

  • You get results through your team: you coach engineers to make decisions and handle stakeholder conversations themselves, and you give them the room to do it

  • You're a clear, friendly communicator who stays calm under pressure, including during an outage

  • You build strong relationships with other leads and stakeholders, and you hold your ground when someone has a strong opinion while staying open to the best solution

  • You have a strong product mindset and connect the team's work to what users and the business need

  • You notice when a topic has gone quiet and follow up before it stalls

Bonus points for:

  • Leading a team that supports several product squads at the same time

  • Working on high-traffic consumer products

  • Setting up, or working in, a model where backend engineers are embedded in product squads

  • Steering the business with KPIs and running A/B tests to improve them

 

OUR CORE TECH STACK

  • Backend: PHP (REST APIs) and Go (async processing and high-concurrency features)

  • Ways of working: Jira and Notion, with a Scrum-like process

  • AI features: daily tips, meal summaries and food search by voice, text and image

  • AI in development: agentic coding as part of the team's everyday workflow

  • Scale: up to one million API requests per minute

WHY US?

  • An exciting product with millions of users in over 150 countries, driven by our mission to transform the world through healthy eating

  • A remote-first setup: work 100% from home, join a co-working space, or work abroad for several weeks per year

  • 30 vacation days to relax and recharge, plus 5 child sick days if your little one needs you

  • A focus-driven culture that values efficiency over long hours - no overtime expectations, and if it happens, you get that time back!

  • A high-impact environment where your work drives real change - short decision-making processes and no micromanagement

  • A team culture where ambition and balance go hand in hand, supported by strong connections - from our fully covered company retreat to team meetups and virtual coffee breaks

  • Tools and support to do your best work: MacBook, monitor, and €1,000 annual learning budget, plus regular feedback and career development

  • A truly international team with English as our company language and a shared commitment to growth and well-being - supported by Sunday Supplements and Nilo Health

DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

At Yazio, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone, regardless of gender identity, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, or ability, feels valued and empowered. We celebrate different perspectives and actively encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

READY TO JOIN US?

Excited to take Yazio to the next level and help people worldwide lead healthier lives? We’d love to hear from you! Please send us:

  • Your CV in English

  • Any additional materials that showcase your work (e.g., LinkedIn profile, portfolio)

description:
Intro

As our Health Claims lead, you'll own claims decisions on Feather's health MGA books from day one: coverage, declines, settlement amounts, all within policy terms. You'll manage our insurance carrier relationships, decide how we work with service providers, and build the playbook, automations and systems that let the function scale as we grow MGA health claims fast across expat and international health.

At Feather, we're building insurance that actually matters to our customers. It rests on three principles: a fully digital experience, modern and flexible plans, and reliable human support. And because we build it all for expats living abroad, we're a genuinely different kind of insurer.


Why work at Feather?

  • We're small, lean, and we love what we do. The usual buzzwords here, except we actually mean them. Staying small helps us focus on what matters, and we want to keep it that way.
  • You'll work on a product that is loved by customers. Our excellent Trustpilot and Google reviews speak for themselves.
  • There's plenty of space to grow. We trust you to take ownership and make real decisions from day one, and you'll have all the support you need to succeed.
  • You'll have the freedom to build something from scratch. You're not inheriting a finished system. You're building the decision logic, reporting, and playbook that let health claims scale.
  • Flexible remote work policy. We offer a remote-first work environment, hiring across Europe via an Employer of Record. We host company retreats, team dinners, and meetups to spend in-person time together.


What you bring to the table

  • You have hands-on experience handling health claims across borders or internationally.
  • You are familiar with medical coding and provider billing.
  • You have an instinct for automation and AI tooling, and you use it daily.
  • You take tough decisions daily, including saying no to customers, and you still enjoy the work.
  • You are pragmatic in an unfinished system: you improve it while running it.
  • You are a fluent English speaker.
Nice to have:
  • German, Spanish, or French language skills.
  • Experience with moratorium underwriting.
  • A medical background.
  • Experience in an MGA or delegated authority setup.
  • Experience managing third-party administrators (TPAs).


You'll be responsible for

  • You will make claims decisions
    • You will interpret coverage, decide declines, settlement amounts, and goodwill within policy terms, with real authority, not recommend-and-wait.
    • You will handle expat and international health claims: cross-border invoices across languages and billing conventions, currency and tax, and coordination with statutory and private cover in the country of residence.
  • You will manage our carrier relationships
    • You will own claims reporting and bordereaux, contentious cases, and coverage disputes with our insurance partners.
    • You will keep audit-ready records throughout, so nothing surprises the carrier.
  • You will decide how we work with service providers
    • You will decide where using third-party administrators (TPAs) makes sense, and manage instructions, quality, turnaround, and commercial performance where we use them.
  • You will build the operating model
    • You will close gaps with product and engineering across intake, documents, decision support, payout, and automation.
    • You will run audits and fraud checks, working toward semi-automated monitoring with the data team.
  • You will build capability
    • You will write the playbook so health claims stops depending on one person.
    • You will train whoever joins the team next.


What will the interview process look like?

  1. CV screening
  2. Initial phone call with our People team. We'll have a chat and get to know each other (30m)
  3. Hiring manager call. We'll cover the role, skills needed, and answer your questions (1 hour)
  4. Case study. We'll give you a case study to work on, which will give you an idea of the type of projects you'd take on at Feather (3-4h)
  5. Case study discussion. We'll go through your reasoning and approach together (90min)
  6. Call with our Head of Ops. We'll talk through our async, remote-first way of working and how our team operates day to day (45min)
  7. Final interview. You'll be speaking to one member of our leadership team (45min)


Does this sound like a good fit for you? Apply now!

At Feather, we actively foster inclusive representation within our teams and embrace a diverse mix of talent. We encourage applicants from all educational paths to apply: we believe that what you’ve built, worked on, and achieved is far more important than on-paper qualifications.

description:
Studio Apelbaum, founded by artist and engineer Jonathan Apelbaum, brings painting, technology, sound and people into the same space. Our work begins with stories of intimacy, memory and identity and grows through a team of makers, engineers, musicians, performers and writers. We are building a new 150 m² studio at Osloer Straße 16–17 in the historic Umspannwerk Christiania, with a workshop and our own exhibition space.

Our cognitive paintings are oil paintings whose images shift with light, movement and sound through custom LED systems and software. Building these paintings and building the new studio are equally important parts of the internship. Both ask us to work with our hands, solve problems together and learn across disciplines.

Our team crosses disciplines: Jonathan Apelbaum (painting and artistic direction), Thore Bartholomäus (co-owner and main engineer), James Calvert (mechanics and mechatronics), Fabian Wetekamp (software), Titouan Duflo (engineering, performance and AV), Clément Royon (music and soundscape) and malice. (a French collective from Clermont-Ferrand), Lucie Froehlich (fabrication and animation), Aysu Naz Atalay (writing), Valeria Loseva (building), and Alexandra Psijas (design). We also work with choreographer Matilde Flor Usinger and musician Forgotten Sounds to shape how an exhibition moves into the night.

Our own series of ambitious, invitation-only exhibitions and events is central to the new studio. We design and build adaptable furniture in steel and oak so the same room can hold work, an exhibition or a dinner. We make the artworks, shape the space, invite our guests and welcome them ourselves. With Clément Royon's music, an exhibition can slowly change its rhythm; with Forgotten Sounds, it can move into a party. This way of working grows from Jonathan's experience in queer and club culture. Beyond the studio, we create large installations with TRACEY (formerly Lunchbox Candy), Playground Festival and other art festivals.

How the internship works

We welcome engineers, programmers, makers, artists, writers and communicators. The internship has three connected parts:

1. We begin together with two equally important jobs: building the studio and building the cognitive paintings. Everyone joins the hands-on work, whatever their background. This includes renovating and making furniture as well as assembling, wiring and testing the paintings.

2. You take on one main studio project shaped around your skills, with guidance from the team. This can become the direction of a longer collaboration.

3. In May, we come together for a major exhibition. We will transform an entire building and take care of the experience from installation and invitations to welcoming guests.

Tasks

  • Build, assemble and test cognitive paintings and their LED systems
  • Build the studio with us, including custom steel and oak furniture and its adaptable exhibition and dining space
  • Contribute to research, prototypes, software, spatial design or storytelling according to your skills
  • Organise materials, tools, storage, artwork transport and installation in the studio and at external sites
  • Manage shipping lists, cost estimates, and customs documentation
  • Write or create invitations, exhibition texts, documentation and communication materials where relevant to your project
  • Assist in managing multiple ongoing projects
  • Occasionally travel as a courier for exhibition

Requirements

  • A practice or strong interest in engineering, programming, making, visual art, writing, communication or related fields
  • Ability to work independently and take initiative
  • Interest in contemporary art, installation, or performance
  • Curiosity about working across art, technology, production, storytelling and communication; you do not need to arrive with all these skills
  • Reliability, flexibility and care for both artworks and people

Benefits

You will learn within a diverse team that works like a chosen family, surrounded by a larger community. You will gain practical experience in electronics, steel and oak, and help shape our studio, intimate events and major May exhibition. Your own studio project gives you room to grow with us.

  • Duration: 6 months
  • Format: Part-time
  • Compensation: Unpaid

You must have paid work outside the studio—whether a job, freelance work or service work—to support yourself during this unpaid internship. An independent artistic project alongside is welcome, but optional. Within Studio Apelbaum, you will lead one main project agreed with and supported by the team.

The studio is a place to teach, learn and grow together. We are looking for people who want to stay with us. The internship is a first step, and the main project you take on here can become the direction of your future work in the studio.

Please send:

  • A motivation letter explaining your interest in the studio and the direction you would like to develop here (most important). If you have an independent artistic project, you can tell us about it too.
  • Your CV and/or portfolio (if available)

description:
About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

The Role

Due to rapid growth, we are seeking a Technical Program Manager with an AI/ML background to join our team in Berlin. You will be a key driver of technical cohesion, bridging the gap between our research and the physical implementation of next-generation materials.

Your Impact

In this role you will be building and executing the program management framework that accelerates AI/ML frontier research and platform capability development, which is critical for translating scientific objectives into real-world, scalable materials breakthroughs.

As a member of our growing team of TPMs, you will work closely with our technical teams on internal initiatives and also manage high-stakes customer projects. Your main focus initially will be coordinating complex technical campaigns in frontier AI/ML research focused on developing novel materials, and over time you will likely get involved in establishing more sophisticated, scalable processes for model development lifecycles.



What You Will Do

Program Leadership & Research Integration

  • Lead internal technical programs across AI/ML model development, frontier research, data workflows, and machine learning infrastructure, acting as the connective tissue between AI researchers and materials scientists.

  • Translate scientific and business objectives into executable plans, aligning commercial, research and engineering teams.

  • Close the loop between experimental results and the AI research cycle, translating lab findings back into the model development process to continuously improve accuracy and accelerate discovery.

  • Own planning and delivery of projects; calculating compute, managing resources & dependencies, mapping out timelines, and managing risks to ensure successful outcomes.

Partner & Customer Collaboration

  • Lead technical programs with industry partners and research institutions, serving as a primary program contact for our external partners during the execution and delivery of projects.

  • Facilitate technical discussions between internal teams and external stakeholders.

  • Drive project scoping and proposal writing in collaboration with the Partnerships and technical teams.

  • Manage joint development initiatives and coordinate customer pilot programs from conception through to deployment.

Process & Operations

  • Work closely with the rest of the global TPM team to refine scalable processes.

  • Implement metrics for tracking technical milestones and program outcomes.

  • Coordinate compliance and regulatory considerations across programs.

  • Support intellectual property (IP) and scientific publication processes.

  • Foster interdisciplinary team culture and own change management to successfully scale the organisation.

  • Use data to drive continuous improvements to internal and customer-facing processes.


Must Have Skills and Qualifications:

  • You possess a strong background in AI/ML and/or a related Natural Science field.

  • Proven experience as a Technical Program Manager specifically within the AI/ML domain, including a deep understanding of model architecture, cloud computing best practices and the software development lifecycle.

  • Strong leadership and facilitation capabilities for managing cross-functional teams.

  • The ability to navigate high levels of ambiguity and maintain cohesion across multi-disciplinary teams (AI, Chemistry, and Engineering).

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence both highly technical researchers and non-technical partners at varying levels of seniority.

  • Strategic thinking and problem-solving skills with comfort navigating ambiguity and changing priorities.



Bonus Points (But Not Critical):

  • Experience with molecular simulation software, quantum chemistry packages, or cheminformatics tools.

  • Practical experience or an academic background in Materials Science, Experimental Chemistry, or Physics.

  • Hands-on experience with high-performance computing (HPC) infrastructure or scientific data management.



Additional Considerations

This role will be based in our Berlin office, with the expectation of being in the office three days per week. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to other locations (particularly London or Amsterdam) for collaboration and project work.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

  • Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

  • Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

  • ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

  • Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth

  • Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

  • True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other


Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.


CuspAI is an equal opportunities employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

We actively encourage applications from all backgrounds and value the unique perspectives and contributions that diversity brings to our team.

Please let us know if you require any specific adjustments during or after the interview process. We will do everything we can within reason to accommodate.

Who You’ll Work For: 

 

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. 

We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Data Scientists who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. Ifyou're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.  

 

The role:  

Develop and Deploy Production-Grade AI Systems 

  • Build, deploy, and maintain scalable APIs that serve AI/ML models in production environments 

  • Own end-to-end delivery of AI solutions, from prototyping to fully productionized systems 

Design Advanced AI Architectures 

  • Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems using vector databases 

  • Build and orchestrate AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar 

  • Evaluate and select appropriate large language models (LLMs) and foundation models based on specific use cases 

Optimize Performance and Scalability 

  • Continuously optimize model inference for latency, cost efficiency, and throughput at scale 

  • Identify bottlenecks and implement improvements to ensure high-performing systems 

Ensure Reliability and Observability 

  • Implement robust monitoring, logging, and alerting for deployed models and services 

  • Ensure system reliability, uptime, and performance through best practices in production ML systems 

Establish Engineering Best Practices 

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for seamless testing, deployment, and iteration of AI systems 

  • Contribute to evolving engineering standards as the company transitions from rapid experimentation to more structured, scalable operations 

Collaborate Cross-Functionally 

  • Work closely with product and engineering teams to integrate AI capabilities into core products 

  • Translate business problems into technical solutions and clearly communicate trade-offs 

Drive Structure in a Fast-Paced Environment 

  • Help bring stability and structure to AI development processes during a high-growth, scale-up phase 

  • Balance speed of execution with the need for maintainable, well-documented, and scalable systems 

  • Take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive them through to practical, production-ready outcomes 


Core Experience 

  • 5+ years of experience in Python, with ~10 years of overall software engineering or data experience (candidates transitioning from backend engineering are welcome) 

  • Proven experience building and deploying production-grade APIs (preferably with FastAPI; REST/GraphQL experience is a plus) 

  • Hands-on experience working with large language models (LLMs) and LLMOps, including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation (e.g., GPT, Claude) 

  • Strong experience fine-tuning open-source models (e.g., Hugging Face ecosystem) 

  • Practical experience designing and working with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, pgvector) 

  • Experience building AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or similar 

  • Solid understanding of model deployment and serving (e.g., vLLM, TGI, or managed endpoints) 

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices (Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions) 

  • Strong experience working with and processing large-scale text datasets 

Preferred Experience 

  • Experience with MLOps platforms such as MLflow or Weights & Biases 

  • Familiarity with cloud AI ecosystems (e.g., AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI) 

  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects 

  • Experience in the sustainability or climate/product domain 

  • Background in B2B SaaS environments 

  • Prior experience in a startup or scale-up environment (approximately 100–300 employees) 

  • Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU. 

Key Attributes 

  • Builder mindset: Comfortable owning systems end-to-end, from experimentation through to production 

  • Bias for action: Operates effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment with shifting priorities 

  • Systems thinker: Designs solutions with scalability, reliability, and maintainability in mind 

  • Pragmatic decision-making: Balances technical excellence with speed and business impact 

  • Ownership & accountability: Takes responsibility for outcomes, not just outputs 

  • Clear communicator: Able to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders 

 

What We Offer: 

 

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). 

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. 

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. 

 

 

The Experience: 

 

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. 

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect. 

  • Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life. 

  • Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters. 

  • Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact.

Unsere Leidenschaft sind technologische Lösungen, die schon heute wirken und einen bleibenden Mehrwert stiften. Je komplexer, desto besser. Strategisch durchdacht, nutzerzentriert, barrierefrei. Mit einer guten Portion Liebe für Testing, Dokumentation, Prozesse und saubere Strukturen innerhalb schwergewichtiger Projekte.

Keine Schokoriegel, sondern digitale Erlebnisse. Keine Turnschuhe, sondern Fitness für die graue Zellen. Weil: komplexe Themen – anspruchsvolle Kund:innen.

Und noch ein Hinweis: Wir nehmen Informationssicherheit ernst – und freuen uns, wenn du diesen Anspruch mit uns teilst.


Deine Ansprechpartnerin.

Nicole Lilie

Du entwickelst daraus ein klares System – mit starken Angles und Hooks, strukturiertem Testing und einem Prozess, der erfolgreiche Creatives konsequent weiterentwickelt.

Dafür bekommst du echte Ownership, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und die Chance, unsere Creative Strategy maßgeblich zu prägen.

Bereit, aus starken Ideen ein skalierbares Creative-System zu machen?


Wofür du Verantwortung übernimmst

Du bist die Übersetzung zwischen Performance-Daten und kreativer Umsetzung, nicht die Person, die selbst designt oder schneidet, sondern die, die genau weiß, warum ein Hook funktioniert oder nicht, und daraus die nächste Iteration ableitet. 

  • Du entwickelst Angles, Hooks und Kampagnenkonzepte: Für Meta, TikTok und Google übersetzt du Zielgruppen-Insights in Creatives, die konvertieren. 
  • Du verantwortest unsere Creative Strategy: Du schaffst klare Prozesse, Briefing-Standards und ein Testing-System für skalierbare Performance Creatives.
  • Du identifizierst neue Creative-Potenziale: Wettbewerber, Trends, Kundenfeedback und Social Listening nutzt du für neue Botschaften und Ideen.
  • Du erstellst klare Creative Briefings: Vom Hook bis zum CTA gibst du unserem Visual-Team, Creator und externen Partnern eine klare Richtung.
  • Du etablierst strukturiertes Testing: Gemeinsam mit Performance Marketing testest du Hypothesen, wertest Ergebnisse aus und leitest nächste Iterationen ab.
  • Du skalierst erfolgreiche Creatives: Anhand relevanter KPIs erkennst du erfolgreiche Konzepte, entwickelst sie weiter und wirkst Creative Fatigue entgegen.
  • Du sicherst unsere Markenkonsistenz: Auch bei schnellem Testing bleiben Tonalität und Positionierung von kleines kraftwerk klar erkennbar.
  • Du nutzt AI als Beschleuniger: AI-Tools helfen dir, Research und Variantenentwicklung schneller und effizienter zu machen.


Womit du punkten kannst

Du kennst Performance Creatives aus der Praxis: Du bringst ca. 3+ Jahre Erfahrung als Creative Strategist:in, im Performance Creative oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit, idealerweise im D2C-, Agentur- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld.

  • Du weißt, was konvertiert: Du hast bereits Creative-Konzepte entwickelt, die nicht nur gut aussahen, sondern nachweislich funktioniert und skaliert haben.
  • Du verstehst die relevanten Plattformen: Meta, Google und TikTok Ads sowie die Struktur von Kampagnen und Creative-Tests sind dir vertraut. Hands-on-Erfahrung mit den Tools ist ein Plus.
  • Du denkst kreativ und datengetrieben: KPIs wie Hook Rate, Hold Rate, CTR und CPA kannst du sicher einordnen und in konkrete Ideen und nächste Iterationen übersetzen.
  • Du kannst andere kreativ anleiten: Du schreibst klare Briefings und arbeitest sicher mit internen Visual-Teams, externen Creator und Kooperationspartnern zusammen.
  • Du willst gestalten statt verwalten: Du arbeitest strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich und hast Lust, bestehende Ansätze zu einem funktionierenden Creative-System weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Du bist offen für neue Tools: AI nutzt du bereits für Creative Research und Produktion  oder hast Lust, dich intensiv damit auseinanderzusetzen.
  • Du kommunizierst souverän: Gute Englischkenntnisse für internationale Ad-Benchmarks sind ein Plus.

Bewirb dich nicht, wenn …

  • Du lieber nach Bauchgefühl arbeitest: Daten und KPIs gehören für dich genauso zu guten Creatives wie starke Ideen.
  • Du klare Prozesse brauchst, um loszulegen: Bei uns gibt es noch nicht für alles ein Handbuch. Genau das soll dich reizen.
  • Du operative Arbeit grundsätzlich ablehnst: Dein Fokus liegt auf Strategie, aber du bist dir auch nicht zu schade, bei Bedarf selbst im Ads Manager mit anzupacken.


Worauf du dich freuen kannst

Creative Strategy aufbauen statt nur umsetzen: Du bekommst volle Gestaltungsfreiheit beim Aufbau unserer Creative-Strategy-Funktion und kannst Prozesse, Testing-Strukturen und Standards von Grund auf mitgestalten.

  • Eine Ausgangslage mit echtem Potenzial: Dich erwarten eine wachsende, aktive Zielgruppe und ein Marketing-Budget mit echtem Hebel, die ideale Basis, um Creatives systematisch zu testen, Learnings schnell umzusetzen und sichtbare Ergebnisse zu erzielen.
  • Gemeinsam möchten wir wachsen: Wir setzen auf ein starkes WIR-Gefühl, eine freundschaftliche Teamkultur, flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege.
  • Raum für deine Ideen: Deine Ideen werden gehört und gebraucht – du kannst dich einbringen, Verantwortung übernehmen und wirklich mitgestalten.
  • Work-Life-Balance ist uns wichtig: Du hast flexible Arbeitszeiten, 2 Tage Home-Office pro Woche, 28 Tage Urlaub sowie 5 Tage Workation im Jahr. Außerdem hast du an deinem Geburtstag frei!
  • Deine Gesundheit und Zukunft liegen uns am Herzen: Du erhältst Zuschüsse zu Wellpass und betrieblicher Altersvorsorge sowie exklusive Rabatte auf unsere Produkte.
  • Ein Arbeitsplatz zum Wohlfühlen: Dich erwarten moderne, lichtdurchflutete Büros und eine phänomenale Dachterrasse, die zum Durchatmen und Austauschen einlädt.


Du willst Teil der Energiewende werden?

Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der erneuerbaren Energien.  Join uns und werde Teil des Teams!

Wir sind ein ambitioniertes Start-up im Bereich erneuerbare Energien mit einer klaren Mission: erneuerbare Energie von morgen für alle zugänglich machen. Dafür suchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, eigene Ideen einbringen und Lust haben, gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen: in einer dynamischen Umgebung, in der du viel Gestaltungsspielraum hast, Strukturen mit aufbauen kannst, eigene Entscheidungen triffst und direkten Einfluss auf den Erfolg des Unternehmens nimmst. 

Dabei ist uns egal, woher du kommst, an was du glaubst, wen du liebst, womit du dich identifizierst, wie alt du bist, ob du neurodivers bist oder eine Behinderung hast – die Welt ist bunt und wir können es kaum erwarten, von dir zu lesen! Alle Geschlechter sind Willkommen!
