description:
About us

UVC Partners is one of Europe’s leading early-stage venture capital firms. With our fourth fund generation of €250 million, we invest in disruptive B2B startups at the seed and Series A stage across Europe. Our focus areas include enterprise software, mobility, and industrial technologies.
Headquartered in Munich and closely integrated with UnternehmerTUM, Europe’s largest entrepreneurship center, we are proud partners to some of Europe’s most ambitious founders – including Flixbus, Isar Aerospace, finn.auto, Proxima Fusion, and Aleph Alpha.

At UVC Partners, we’re driven by a deep passion for entrepreneurship and its power to positively shape society. Environmental and social responsibility are core to our DNA. We hold ourselves to the highest standards in everything we do. As a firm, we continuously reinvent ourselves to stay ahead and best serve our portfolio and investors. We believe in ownership over hierarchy and foster a culture built on collaboration, curiosity, and personal engagement. And while we’re serious about our mission, we also genuinely enjoy working together and building lasting relationships along the way.


Your mission

You will join a specialized team working at the intersection of applied research and venture capital, side by side with investors, AI researchers, and engineers building the backbone of our investment intelligence. This is a hands-on role with real stakes. You will be treated as a full member of the team, expected to take a research question from literature to a working prototype and to present your results to the people who make the investment decisions.


Your profile

  • You are enrolled in a Master’s program in Computer Science, Data Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a similar program at a top university.
  • You bring depth, or the ambition to build it, in at least one relevant toolkit, whether that is graph ML and graph databases (e.g. PyTorch Geometric), LLM tooling, tool use and evaluation, or probabilistic modeling (e.g. PyMC, NumPyro).
  • You write clean, modular Python and have firm machine learning and statistics fundamentals.
  • You are fluent with AI-assisted coding tools and you have judgment about them. You know what they do well, where they quietly fail, and you review everything they produce. You do not ship AI slop.
  • You work independently. You have run a project where you set the direction yourself, and you can point to it.
  • You are fluent in English, including technical language. It is what you will work, write, and present in. German is helpful but not required.

How we work
We are an AI-powered development team. Everyone here codes with AI assistance, and we treat that as a craft. You need to know which parts of a problem to hand over, where these tools fail quietly, and how to review output you did not write.
Agency matters a lot in our team. You get mentorship, context, and access to everyone. You do not get someone assigning you tasks every morning. Take a rough problem statement, come back with an approach, show drafts while they can still change, and flag what is not working. What you bring should outweigh what it costs us to support you.

Potential Research Directions
These are directions we could explore, with scope defined together at the start based on your background and where the work leads.
1. With Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) we would work on a graph-structured database, where people and companies are nodes and the relationships between them are part of the data, and ask what that structure can tell us that a table cannot.
2. With Program-aided Language Models (PAL) we would have the model write a small program for every number it pulls from decks and financial statements, so figures are accurately computed, because that is what makes it safe to point a language model at financial data.
3. And with Bayesian Updating we would keep our recorded understanding of a company moving as new evidence arrives, since the investment process is iterative and a view written down two years ago should not still be the view today. Your thesis could focus on one of these, though as a full-time member of the team you will work across several.

Academic Supervision: The Lead of the Data & AI Team is a PhD candidate at TUM's School of Computation, Information and Technology (CIT) and can supervise CIT masters students directly, so there is no separate supervisor search. However, you are free to choose your own supervisor and candidates from other universities bring their own.


What we offer

  • Network: A desk at the Munich Urban Colab, our main office, with the option of a second one in Garching, plus access to the UnternehmerTUM ecosystem of startups, experts, and investors.
  • Team & Culture: Monthly team lunches, our regular Stammtisch, free sports classes, Makerspace access for your personal projects, and regular team events.
  • Compensation: An attractive salary for the full six months of your master thesis or internship.
  • Ownership: Research that is yours end to end and feeds real fund decisions.
  • Equipment: A MacBook or a Windows laptop, whichever you work best on.
  • AI Tooling: Full access to the AI development stack we use daily, and a team that will teach you to use it properly.
  • Real Data: Proprietary venture data that researchers rarely get access to, with the pipelines to use it productively.

Interested?
Please send a one-page CV, a current transcript, and a link to your GitHub or portfolio. Tell us which of these directions interests you most and why. We look forward to hearing from you!


Diversity is important to us

Diversity enriches our team. We explicitly encourage all qualified individuals to apply, regardless of gender, social and ethnic background, sexual orientation, religion, age, or disability.


Contact

Unternehmertum Venture Capital Partners GmbH , c/o Munich Urban Colab, Freddie- Mercury-Straße 5, 80797 Munich, Germany

www.uvcpartners.com

UVC Partners is an equal opportunity employer.

UVC Partners is an independent venture capital fund. For efficiency, we use certain shared services from UnternehmerTUM. This is why parts of the application process may appear UTUM-branded, and your application will be processed by UVC Partners and UnternehmerTUM.

About us

AI Triangle is a joint initiative of TUM Venture Labs, the ETH AI Center, IPAI and Campus Founders, backed by TU Munich and ETH Zürich. Further AI entrepreneurship centers and universities will join. Our mission: to build a leading AI cluster spanning Baden-Württemberg, Bavaria, and Switzerland - one that turns the region's research excellence into globally relevant companies. Our philosophy in three words: Research. Build. Scale.

The Opportunity
We are hiring an Expert AI Infrastructure & Frontier Models to drive the Build phase. Your job: create the formats and support structures that let founders and hubs turn academic breakthroughs into frontier AI solutions and the next generation of AI companies - across key hubs and their partner institutions.
Concretely, you build the formats that:

  • Lower the barriers to infrastructure, inference, data, and evaluation, and
  • Spark innovation around frontier models and platforms.
The Challenge
This is a deliberate hybrid role, and we want to be honest about that up front. It joins two profiles that rarely coexist in a single person:
  • The deep technical judgment on large-scale AI infrastructure to build and run frontier AI models (pre- and post-training, inference, data engineering, evaluation,...)
  • The instinct to strategically build solutions with ecosystem partners that help researchers and founders to overcome the hurdles
You will move between two worlds: deep technical conversations with ML-infrastructure experts from CSCS/ALPS, Jülich, AWS, Google, and NVIDIA, and high-impact discussions with top innovators and early founders emerging from ecosystems like TUM, ETH, and IPAI. If that combination energizes you, read on.


Your mission

  • Drive hub collaboration: align technical leads across the hubs and lead flagship projects that catalyze real, cross-border cooperation.

  • Shape frontier model development: Define approaches to frontier model development with partners and founders that address the current challenges.

  • Build the open innovation layer: create sandboxes, APIs and formats so the next wave of builders starts faster.

  • Enable future founders and startups: design the education and support formats that help teams scale models, data and compute into products.

  • Map and improve the landscape: continuously analyze the compute, data, model architectures, training approaches and evaluation resources across the Triangle and close the gaps.

  • Coordinate compute access: secure fair, workable access across STACKIT, ALPS, KI Service-Centers, and cloud providers for founders and startups.

  • Steer data and evaluation: manage shared training-data access, develop sector-specific benchmarks, and scale evaluation know-how across the network.


Your profile

  • Technical depth: you are a senior expert in ML training and infrastructure – from data to pre- and post-trainiang, inference, MLOps, and cloud.

  • Credibility and network: you have the standing to build trust with leading universities, entrepreneurship centers, and high-growth startups, and to be taken seriously as a peer.

  • Strategic clarity: you turn complex infrastructure challenges into strategies that work across an entire ecosystem.

  • Bridge-building: you connect deep-tech research with applied technology, build trusted relationships with founders and partners, and spar with them on hard decisions - with empathy and clarity.

  • Languages: fluent German and English, written and spoken.


What we offer

  • Direct work with world-class researchers, leading universities,
    and the next generation of deep-tech startups

  • Hands-on involvement with frontier compute, such as ALPS and STACKIT,
    to power next-generation models

  • Real room for ownership, creativity, and strategic influence

  • An experienced, open-minded team with flat hierarchies

  • Flexible working hours and remote-work options

  • A generous budget for internal and external training, Wellpass & monthly mobility budget


Diversity is important to us

Diversity makes our team stronger. We warmly encourage all qualified people to apply, regardless of gender, social or ethnic background, sexual orientation, religion, age, or disability.

description:
About

Linro is a cloud security company building a real-time, agentic cloud-security platform. Teams ship with AI. AI ships with Linro.

Cloud infrastructure changes constantly, and increasingly it's AI agents making those changes, not people. Most security tools only catch problems after the fact. Linro works differently. We enforce what's allowed at every stage, from commit to production. We stop bad changes before they ship, and fix problems in real time once they're live.

We have each been on the receiving end of this problem: running cloud security at scale, building the platforms underneath it, and shipping in regulated systems where a wrong change isn't an option. Founded in Berlin in 2026 and built fully remote across Europe, Linro has a platform that's real and working, with plenty still to shape.

The role

You would be one of our first engineers, building alongside the founding team. At the heart of the product is a stream-first policy engine that evaluates compliance as SQL across past, present and future infrastructure state. It has to be fast, correct and impossible to route around. You'd own large parts of it outright.

What you will do

  • Design and build core backend services in Go that evaluate policy against cloud infrastructure changes in real time.

  • Take a core area of the platform and own it end to end, from first design through running it in production.

  • Build the simulation and enforcement path that blocks or auto-remediates non-compliant changes before they reach production.

  • Stay close to customers, see how your work lands in the real world, and fold what you learn back into the product.

What we are looking for

  • Strong backend engineering experience in a compiled, statically typed language. We build in Go, so you are either already a Go engineer or someone who will get into it quickly.

  • You know SQL well and think naturally in relational and columnar data models. It’s central to how our engine works.

  • A product mindset. You care about the user and the problem, not only the ticket, and you have opinions about what to build, not just how.

  • A problem-to-solution instinct. You can take an ambiguous problem, find the simple core, and ship something that solves it.

  • End-to-end ownership. You own a problem from design through production and operation, and you see the hard parts through.

  • Hands-on experience operating and running at least one major cloud (AWS, GCP or Azure). Not just deploying to it, actually running it: access management, networking or the failure modes.

  • Hands-on with Terraform or Pulumi, and an understanding of how infrastructure-as-code actually behaves in practice.

  • You build with AI coding tools as a normal part of your workflow and have a point of view on where they help and where they don't. We build guardrails for these tools, so we want engineers with deep, hands-on experience in agentic development.

Nice to have

  • Background in cloud or cyber security, CSPM, CNAPP, or compliance (e.g. SOC 2, PCI, ISO 27001, GDPR).

  • Experience building policy or rule engines.

  • Experience with high-availability, scaling, and eventually-consistent, event-driven system design.

  • Production experience running Kubernetes clusters.

  • Early-stage startup experience, or having been a founding engineer before.

How we work

We are remote across Europe and hire anywhere within roughly two hours of Central European Time (CEST). We get the whole team together in person somewhere in Europe once a quarter for a few days. We work async by default, write things down, and protect people's focus time.

What we offer

  • Real ownership. As an early engineer you design, ship, run and own a genuine surface area of the product, with direct contact with users and a say in how we build.

  • Meaningful equity. You are an early employee, and your stake reflects it.

  • Competitive salary, benchmarked to the market.

  • A quarterly European offsite, and a team that takes both the mission and each other’s time seriously.

The honest version

This is early. Priorities will shift, and some of what you build early will change as we learn. There is no playbook waiting for you. If you want a highly structured environment with a mature codebase and a clear roadmap for the next two years, this is not it. If you want to shape a product and a category from close to the start, and you like the idea of building the thing that keeps AI agents from breaking production, we should talk.

Compensation: €90K – €115K • Offers Equity • Multiple Ranges

  • Senior (T5) • €107K – €115K • Offers Equity

  • Fundierte Kubernetes Kenntnisse, idealerweise aus dem Betrieb produktiver Multi-Cluster-Umgebungen
  • Erfahrung mit GitOps-Workflows (idealerweise ArgoCD oder Fleet) und Infrastructure as Code (z. B. Ansible, Terraform)
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1) sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Reisebereitschaft für Kundentermine und Termine an unseren weiteren Standorten

  • Erfahrung mit SUSE Stack oder vergleichbaren Kubernetes-Management-Plattformen
  • Kenntnisse in DevSecOps, Policy as Code oder Hochverfügbarkeitskonzepten

  • Systemisches Denken statt Ticket-Fokus, mit Blick fürs Gesamtbild

description:
Warum LPE Immobilien?

  • Die Hausverwaltung ist der unterschätzteste Beruf Deutschlands: Kein anderer entscheidet so unmittelbar darüber, wie Menschen wohnen. Trotzdem gilt der Hausverwalter bis heute als Buchhalter mit Schlüsselbund. Wir wollen das ändern, und Software ist dafür einer unserer zentralen Hebel.
  • Mit lpeOS bauen wir die Systeme, mit denen wir selbst jeden Tag arbeiten: das Kundenportal für unsere Eigentümer, KI-Agenten, die eigenständig Aufgaben übernehmen, und das Verwaltercockpit als Arbeitsumgebung unserer Verwalter. Wir digitalisieren unsere eigenen Prozesse, um die Arbeit unserer Verwalter jeden Tag ein Stück besser zu machen, mit dem Anspruch, die Branche zu revolutionieren.
  • Kaum eine Branche wurde von moderner Software so lange übersehen. Der Abstand zwischen dem, was ist, und dem, was möglich ist, ist riesig, und wir bauen ihn Stück für Stück zu. Du wärst eine der ersten Personen im Produktteam.


Was dich bei uns erwartet – Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst Fullstack in TypeScript, vom Kundenportal über das Verwaltercockpit bis zu den Services und der Infrastruktur dahinter, auf der grünen Wiese und ohne Altlasten. Features verantwortest du end-to-end: von der Idee über die Gestaltung bis zum Release, bei Bedarf auch ohne Designer an deiner Seite.
  • Du baust KI-Agenten als Produktfunktionalität für unsere Verwalter und Kunden. Zugleich entwickeln wir unsere eigene Entwicklungsumgebung permanent weiter: ein modernes Setup rund um Cursor und Claude Code, inklusive Agent-Graph-Loops und Harness.
  • Dabei arbeitest du nah an den Nutzern: Deine Kolleginnen, Kollegen und Kunden sind direkt erreichbar, Feedback bekommst du auf kurzem und direktem Weg. Wir sammeln Probleme, bewerten sie und bauen die wichtigsten in festen Cycles.
  • Unser Stack: TypeScript durchgehend, mit React und Next.js im Frontend und Node im Backend, als Monorepo auf Google Cloud (Infrastructure as Code), dazu Postgres und event-getriebene Prozesse. Du musst nicht alles davon kennen, den Rest lernst du bei uns.


Was du mitbringen solltest

  • 2 bis 4 Jahre Erfahrung in der Webentwicklung.
  • Sichere Praxis in TypeScript oder JavaScript, idealerweise mit React oder Next.js.
  • Ein aktuelles Projekt, das du zeigen kannst: Produktionscode, Side Project oder Open Source.
  • Du arbeitest gern quer über den ganzen Stack und magst Frontend und Backend ähnlich gern.
  • Du verantwortest Features end-to-end und kannst bei Bedarf auch ohne Designer ein gutes Interface gestalten.
  • KI-Tooling ist Teil deines Arbeitsalltags, und du prüfst die Ergebnisse genauso kritisch, wie du sie nutzt.
  • Grundverständnis von Datenbanken (SQL) und API-Design.
  • Du willst verstehen, warum etwas gebaut wird, bevor du es baust.
  • Deutschkenntnisse mindestens auf B2-Niveau.
Du erfüllst nicht alle Punkte? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Talent und Lernkurve zählen bei uns mehr als Jahreszahlen im Lebenslauf.


Was wir dir bieten

  • Eine seltene Ausgangslage. Wir bauen Software für ein Geschäftsmodell, das bereits funktioniert, und wissen, dass sie gebraucht wird. Du erlebst aus nächster Nähe, wie sich eine ganze Branche neu erfindet, und gestaltest das aktiv mit.
  • Echter Impact. Alles, was du baust, kommt bei unseren Verwaltern, Eigentümern und Kunden direkt zum Einsatz.
  • Eine Branche von innen kennenlernen. Die Immobilienwirtschaft ist einer der größten Märkte Deutschlands und steht erst am Anfang ihrer Digitalisierung. Du lernst sie dort kennen, wo die Entscheidungen fallen.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Produktverantwortlichen. Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen und jemand, der sich Zeit für deine Fragen nimmt.
  • Mentoring und Weiterentwicklung. Wohin du dich entwickeln willst, besprechen wir offen und regelmäßig. Mentoring ist bei uns in alle Richtungen möglich, fachlich wie persönlich.
  • Ehrliches Feedback. Sofort und in beide Richtungen.
  • Die richtigen Werkzeuge. Premium-Hardware, cloudbasierte Tools, aktuelles KI-Tooling, papierlos. Wenn dir etwas fehlt, um besser zu arbeiten, bekommst du es.
  • Perspektive. Diese Stelle ist so gebaut, dass sie mit dir und mit lpeOS wächst.

Your mission

As our Senior Product Manager, you will play a key role in driving ProGlove's software and solution offering.  
You will operate as the “CEO” of the software and service business inside the company, with accountability for strategy, P&L, growth, customer outcomes, and long-term value creation. The mission is not to manage an existing business. The mission is to build one. Success will have a measurable impact on the company’s growth profile, competitive positioning and profitability. The role reports directly to the CPO and will be part of the product management team. 


Your profile

Who you are: 

  • Commercially obsessed and outcome-driven
  • You think in terms of value, outcomes, and usage-not features
  • You are comfortable working in dynamic and evolving environments
  • You can navigate both technical and commercial discussions
  • You are curious, pragmatic, and impact-driven
  • You have strong business acumen 
  • You are motivated by building something that changes how a company operates
  • Able to balance short-term performance with long-term value creation
 
 
Core accountabilities 
  • Monitor and drivetheP&L for theproduct line
  • ARR growth
  • Attach rate
  • Net Revenue Retention
  • Customer adoption and value realization
  • Pricing and monetization strategy
  • Strategic partnerships
 
Required qualifications 
  • 5to8+ years of experience in product management, preferably in software, cloud, SaaS, or IoT environments
  • Proven experience delivering cloud-based or SaaS products
  • Strong understanding of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP)

Nice to have

Why us?

At ProGlove, we're building technology that empowers frontline workers to work smarter, faster, and safer. As a Senior Product Manager, you'll be a key pillar in defining the future products and solutions and making them commercially successful. 
What you can expect: 

  • A highly autonomous role with ownership of strategic, cross-functional initiatives.
  • The opportunity to influenceProGlove'sbusiness models.
  • Hybrid working model with regular collaboration with our Munich headquarters.

Strategy & Vision

Our team is focused on bringing new innovations that are appreciated by our customers and to continuously strengthen ProGloves portfolio. We work collaboratively across the entire company and value chain. Together we are not about growing products only; it is about changing how the company grows.

description:
Your mission

As our Product Manager – Android Integration & Ecosystem, you will define the product what and why for how ProGlove devices connect, integrate and create value within the enterprise Android ecosystem.

ProGlove is evolving from a wearable scanner company into a Worker Companion company, bringing together ergonomic wearable hardware, software, connectivity, workflow guidance, data and intelligence. With the MAI Wearable Companion, we are entering a broader ecosystem of enterprise applications, technologies, standards, partners and customer infrastructure.

Your mission will be to make our products easy to adopt, integrate and deploy at scale – without turning every customer opportunity into a bespoke engineering project. You will identify recurring customer needs, translate them into scalable capabilities and propositions, and decide where ProGlove should own, enable or partner. In doing so, you will help turn integration from a technical necessity into a source of differentiation, customer value and commercial opportunity.

You will work closely with the Product Manager responsible for the Wearable Companion device. While they own the device proposition, you will own how the device connects to and creates value in the wider ecosystem. Together, you will shape a coherent end-to-end proposition for customers, developers, integrators and partners.

Your day-to-day 
  • Define and evolve the product strategy and priorities for ProGlove’s enterprise Android integration and ecosystem capabilities, aligned with customer needs and business goals.
  • Work directly with customers, Sales and Solution Architecture to identify recurring problems, distinguish individual requests from broader market needs and turn the right opportunities into scalable solutions.
  • Translate recurring integration needs into repeatable product capabilities such as APIs, SDKs, tools, interfaces, documentation, integration patterns and deployment solutions.
  • Shape the product experience around device setup, provisioning, application distribution, device management and other capabilities required to deploy and operate connected device fleets at scale.
  • Make clear, pragmatic decisions about where ProGlove should own, enable or partner, balancing customer value, strategic control, speed, scalability and technical complexity.
  • Identify the platforms, applications, standards and ecosystem players that matter to our customers, and shape the integrations, certifications and technology partnerships that strengthen our proposition.
  • Explore where integration capabilities, software, services and ecosystem propositions can create differentiated value and support commercial or recurring-revenue opportunities.
  • Partner closely with Engineering and the Product Manager for the Wearable Companion to create alignment on customer problems, priorities, trade-offs and desired outcomes.
  • Enable Sales and other customer-facing teams to clearly explain our Android proposition, supported capabilities, integrations and common deployment patterns.
  • Maintain a forward-looking view of enterprise Android, AOSP, enterprise mobility, AI and adjacent technologies, and translate relevant developments into strategic options and product priorities.


Your profile

At ProGlove, technical expertise matters, but how you work is just as important. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, stays curious, collaborates openly and turns complexity into clear, pragmatic decisions.

  • You bring strong Product Management experience in B2B or enterprise technology and can define strategy, discover meaningful customer problems, prioritize opportunities and turn them into scalable products or propositions.
  • You are commercially minded and naturally connect product decisions with customer value, differentiation, business impact and opportunities to capture value.
  • You are comfortable working with enterprise software, platforms, connected devices, integrations or technology ecosystems, and understand the realities of complex customer IT environments.
  • You have enough technical depth to understand architecture, interfaces and trade-offs, contribute credibly to platform and integration discussions, and recognize when deeper engineering expertise is needed.
  • You think in systems and patterns: when faced with a customer requirement, you look beyond the immediate request to understand why it exists, how broadly it applies and what a simple, repeatable solution could look like.
  • You take end-to-end ownership, move topics forward without waiting for perfect instructions and remain effective when the product space or path ahead is not yet fully defined.
  • You collaborate generously and build trust across Product, Engineering, Sales, Solution Architecture, customers and external partners. You can create alignment and drive decisions without relying on formal authority.
  • You communicate clearly and transparently, raise risks early and can make complex technical and commercial topics understandable to different audiences.
  • You are curious about customers, the business and emerging technologies, and continuously test assumptions rather than pursuing technology for its own sake.
  • You use pragmatic judgment to balance speed, simplicity, quality and long-term value.
  • You are fluent in English and comfortable working in an international environment.

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be valuable, but is not required:

  • Enterprise Android, AOSP or adjacent Android ecosystems, including environments operating outside standard Google Mobile Services.
  • Enterprise mobility management, MDM/EMM, device provisioning, application deployment or connected fleet management.
  • Rugged or industrial devices, IoT or edge devices, connected hardware or other B2B technology ecosystems.
  • APIs, SDKs, developer or integrator experiences and enterprise integrations.
  • Platform or ecosystem strategy, technology partnerships, certification programs or developer and partner ecosystems.
  • Enterprise customers deploying technology at scale.
Direct Android Product Management experience is an advantage, but not essential if you bring strong Product Management expertise and relevant experience from an adjacent enterprise technology ecosystem.


Why us?

This is an opportunity to shape an important part of a category that is still being defined. 
Android gives ProGlove access to a much broader technology ecosystem, but the opportunity goes far beyond compatibility. You will help determine what role ProGlove should play in that ecosystem, which capabilities we should own, where we should partner, what customers and developers should be able to build around us, and where integration itself can become a source of differentiation and recurring business value. 
ProGlove already has the customer base, market credibility, technology and industrial expertise to build on. Our products are used in some of the world's most demanding operational environments. What we are now building is the next layer. 
Over time, success will mean more than making our own products easier to integrate. It will mean creating capabilities, interfaces and ecosystem relationships that customers, application providers and partners actively choose to build around - moving ProGlove from ecosystem participant toward ecosystem shaper. 
If you are excited by the idea of turning complex technology ecosystems into simple, valuable products - and helping shape how the next generation of frontline technology connects with the digital world - we would love to meet you. 
Join us in building the future of frontline work.


What success looks like

  • ProGlove has a clear, customer-backed strategy and prioritized roadmap for Android integration and ecosystem capabilities.
  • Recurring customer and integration needs are turned into scalable, repeatable solutions rather than one-off engineering projects.
  • Customers can adopt, integrate, deploy and manage ProGlove devices more easily within their existing enterprise environments.
  • Decisions about what ProGlove should own, enable or partner are made transparently and based on customer value, business impact and long-term scalability.
  • Product, Engineering, Sales and Solution Architecture are aligned on priorities, supported capabilities and key trade-offs.
  • Customer-facing teams can confidently communicate our Android proposition and common deployment patterns without relying on Product or Engineering in every opportunity.
  • Relevant integrations, partnerships and commercial opportunities are identified, validated and translated into tangible product or business outcomes.


Meet your team

You will join our Product team and report directly to the CPO. You will work especially closely with the Product Manager responsible for the Wearable Companion, as well as colleagues across Engineering, Sales, Solution Architecture and Product Marketing.

This is a highly cross-functional role. You will bring together customer needs, technical realities and commercial opportunities, while also building relationships with external technology partners, platform providers and integrators. The team values open collaboration, clear communication and shared ownership of outcomes.

About the team:

The Commercial Systems and Intelligence squad is a newly formed team within SumUp's Acquisition Mission under the Run & Grow tribe. We sit at the intersection of data, backend engineering, and sales operations, building the infrastructure that powers how SumUp attributes merchant acquisition, calculates commissions, and understands the full lifecycle of every merchant.

Today, these processes are largely manual. We're here to change that, automating what's opaque, and building systems that sales representatives, leadership, and analysts can actually trust. You'll join at the very beginning, helping to shape how the squad works, the architecture it builds on, and the standards it holds itself to.

 

What you'll do:

  • Aggregating data from across the SumUp ecosystem to determine which acquisition channel or sales agent drove a merchant to take a valuable action (e.g. signing up, adopting a product)
  • Establishing data models, API contracts, and rule definitions that automate existing manual commission workflows for field and tele-sales agents, partnerships and merchant referrals
  • Build the Lifecycle Event Log in close collaboration with the Merchant Intelligence squad. A centralized store of curated merchant lifecycle events (signups, product usage, verification, purchases) used across attribution, recommendations, customer support and sales
  • Build internal backoffices and APIs for sales representatives and leaders to monitor commission and modify commission plans, manage portfolios and resolve disputes
  • Define and document API contracts, schemas, and integration patterns that other engineering teams can adopt confidently
  • Establish best practices for testing, observability, and incident response within a newly formed squad
  • Use AI and agentic coding tools deliberately, to scaffold services, write tests, explore unfamiliar code, and draft documentation while maintaining full accountability for what gets shipped

 

You'll be great for this role if you:

  • Bring a strong backend engineering background in Go, or are a typed-language generalist ready to ramp up quickly
  • Have designed APIs and distributed systems with clear contracts, versioning, and integration patterns
  • Are fluent in relational and analytical databases (PostgreSQL, Snowflake) and comfortable making the right choice for the right use case
  • Have built Kafka-based, event-driven systems and understand event sourcing and CDC patterns
  • Have experience in auditable, high-trust systems where every decision must be traceable — fintech, payments, or similar domains
  • Have built services from scratch in greenfield, early-stage squads with limited prior context,  and are energized, not unsettled, by that challenge
  • Have experience with testing, observability, and incident response practices and treat them as first-class concerns, not afterthoughts
  • Are resourceful and adaptable, you take end-to-end ownership, do more with less, and adjust quickly as priorities shift
  • Can bridge technical and non-technical audiences, translating fuzzy problems into clear engineering work and explaining trade-offs to engineers and sales stakeholders alike
  • Are pragmatic, you know when good enough ships value and when something genuinely needs to be done properly
  • Have mentorship instincts, you raise the bar for the people around you, not just your own output

Cloud & Infrastructure Automation

description:
Build the Operating System of the Energy Transition

Most internships have you sitting in meetings, fixing small bugs, and watching others build.

This one doesn't.

At Reonic, you'll work on software used by thousands of renewable energy companies across Europe. You'll ship real features, solve real problems, and see your code in production within days.

We're building the AI-native operating system for renewable installers. And we're looking for ambitious builders who want to learn fast, take ownership, and make an impact from day one.

This is a full-time, on-site internship based in Berlin.


What makes this internship different

  • Your work directly impacts how renewable energy gets deployed

  • You'll ship production code used by real customers

  • You'll work closely with experienced engineers, product managers, and founders

  • You'll own projects instead of shadowing others

  • You'll see the full lifecycle: idea → implementation → customer feedback

  • No busy work. No "intern projects" disconnected from reality.

Just building, learning, and shipping.


What you'll build

  • Develop product features across our React, TypeScript, and Node.js stack

  • Turn complex business workflows into simple and intuitive user experiences

  • Work on AI-powered workflows that help installers sell and deliver renewable energy projects faster

  • Contribute to backend services, APIs, and internal tooling

  • Debug, improve, and optimize production systems

  • Collaborate closely with product and design to bring ideas to life

And if you're eager to go deeper:

  • Work with databases and PostgreSQL

  • Learn about system architecture and scalability

  • Explore AI integrations and automation workflows

  • Take ownership of larger features end-to-end

This is not a typical internship.

It's a playground for builders.


You'll thrive here if you...

  • Love building things and seeing them used by real people

  • Are curious and learn quickly

  • Prefer ownership over detailed instructions

  • Enjoy solving problems, not just writing code

  • Care about creating great user experiences

  • Want to work with ambitious people who move fast

  • Are studying Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field

Previous startup experience is a plus, but not required.

What matters most is your ability to learn, execute, and take ownership.


Why join now

  • Competitive internship compensation

  • High ownership from day one

  • Steep learning curve and rapid personal growth

  • Uber Eats and Uber rides on us when you finish late

  • Regular team events, great coffee, and a MacBook

  • A vibrant, collaborative office culture where great ideas happen face-to-face — we're a full in-person team (5 days/week) in a beautiful Berlin office near Hackescher Markt.

  • Join one of Germany's fastest-growing VC-backed startups

Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply! Imposter syndrome shouldn't hold you back - we value talent and passion above all.

 

About Reonic

At Reonic, we’re on a mission to simplify renewable technology with our AI operating system for renewable installers. Backed by top-tier investors and trusted by 3000+ business customers, we’re growing fast - and we need YOU to help us accommodate our new and existing customers.

Be a changemaker

Wir bei Knuddels haben das Ziel, soziale Netzwerke wieder wirklich sozial zu machen – weg vom Konsumieren von Content, hin zu echter menschlicher Nähe. Bei Knuddels soll jeder 3 wichtige Menschen für sein echtes Leben finden.

100.000 Mitglieder erzeugen bei uns täglich Millionen von Events. Deine Aufgabe: Diese Daten nicht nur analysieren, sondern die richtigen Schlüsse daraus ziehen – und dafür sorgen, dass datenbasierte Erkenntnisse im ganzen Unternehmen ankommen und zu konkreten Verbesserungen führen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Hands-on Datenanalyse & Data Science: Du analysierst unsere komplexen Daten und ziehst wertvolle Erkenntnisse mittels Data Mining, Clustering, Forecasting oder Recommendation Classification. Du stellst dabei die Korrektheit unserer Daten in den verschiedenen Systemen sicher.

  • Datengetriebene Entscheidungen ermöglichen: Du analysierst unsere Daten, bereitest die Ergebnisse verständlich auf und leitest daraus konkrete strategische Maßnahmen ab. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Produktmanagement, Community Management und Geschäftsführung zusammen – nicht im Elfenbeinturm, sondern als Sparringspartner auf Augenhöhe. Du verknüpfst quantitative Analysen mit dem qualitativen Feedback unserer Community, um fundierte Entscheidungen zu ermöglichen. und etablierst Best Practices wie Code Reviews und Dokumentation.

  • Hands-on Datenanalyse & Data Science: Du arbeitest operativ mit unseren komplexen Daten und ziehst wertvolle Erkenntnisse mittels Data Mining, Clustering, Forecasting oder Recommendation Classification. Du stellst die Korrektheit unserer Daten in den verschiedenen Systemen sicher und etablierst Best Practices wie Code Reviews und Dokumentation.

  • Teamführung & Datenkultur: Unser Data-Science-Bereich befindet sich im Wandel – und du gestaltest ihn mit. Du übernimmst die fachliche und perspektivisch disziplinarische Führung eines kleinen Teams, förderst die Entwicklung deiner Kolleg:innen und baust den Bereich strukturell weiter auf. Gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung definierst du die langfristige Daten-Strategie und etablierst eine echte Datenkultur im Unternehmen.


Was bieten wir dir?

  • Flexibilität, die sich Deinem Leben anpasst: Bis zu 100% Remote Work, Vertrauensarbeitszeit und die Option auf 10 unbezahlte "Flexi-Urlaubstage" zusätzlich zu 30 Tagen Urlaub.

  • Echter Zusammenhalt: Wir leben eine offene, respektvolle und kooperative Kultur, in der wir uns gegenseitig unterstützen.

  • Wachstum nach Deinen Vorstellungen: Nutze 10% Deiner Arbeitszeit für Weiterbildung und profitiere von unserem Coaching-Pool, Inhouse-Workshops und regelmäßigem Feedback.

  • Fokus auf unser eigenes Produkt (B2C): Du siehst unmittelbar, wie Dein Beitrag bei unserer Community ankommt und hilfst, Menschen näher zusammenzubringen.

  • Exzellente Ausstattung: Wir stellen Dir hervorragendes technisches Equipment. Wenn Du vollständig remote arbeitest, bezuschussen wir zusätzlich ein mobiles Klimagerät.

  • Büro in Top-Lage (Karlsruhe): Mit kostenlosem Frühstücksbuffet, täglich frisch gekochtem Mittagessen, voll klimatisiert und riesiger Dachterrasse.

  • Wir möchten deine Gesundheit unterstützen: Zuschuss zum Fitnessstudio/Sportverein.

  • alle Benefits findest auch nochmal unter jobs.knuddels.de

Was bieten wir nicht?

  • Staubige Konzernstrukturen

  • Arbeiten an Geschäftskundenprojekten (Wir sind ein B2C-Unternehmen)

  • Einen an den Haaren herbeigezogenen dritten Bullet Point, wenn uns nur zwei einfallen :)


  • Ausbildung: Du hast ein Studium der Informatik, Mathematik, Statistik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation erfolgreich abgeschlossen.

  • Business-Verständnis: Du kannst nicht nur Daten analysieren, sondern auch erklären und in praktischen Nutzen überführen. Du erkennst Muster, verstehst ihre geschäftlichen Implikationen und denkst in Lösungen für das Produkt – nicht nur in Algorithmen.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du vermittelst komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich an Nicht-Techniker und trittst souverän auf – auch wenn du bestehende Annahmen mit Daten in Frage stellen musst.

  • Führungspotenzial: Du hast Lust, Verantwortung zu übernehmen – ob als Mentor:in, in der Projektleitung oder durch fachliche Anleitung. Formale Führungserfahrung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Entscheidend ist, dass du ein Team motivieren und weiterentwickeln willst.

  • Analytische Stärke: Du hast eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe, arbeitest strukturiert und hast Freude an der Analyse großer Datenmengen – strukturiert wie unstrukturiert.

  • KI-Mindset: Du begreifst KI (z. B. LLMs, Copilots) als festen Bestandteil moderner Arbeit. Du nutzt entsprechende Tools routiniert und hast Ideen, wie wir KI auch für unsere Datenanalysen oder das Produkt gewinnbringend einsetzen können.

  • Tech-Stack: Starke Kenntnisse in SQL und Python (inkl. Frameworks wie pandas, sklearn). Erfahrung mit statistischen Analysen und Datenbanken sowie mit Excel/Google Sheets zur Aufbereitung und Visualisierung von Ergebnissen. Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in Machine Learning (Forecasting, Clustering, Kategorisierung) und Deep-Learning-Frameworks (z. B. PyTorch, TensorFlow) mit.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (mindestens C1) und Englischkenntnisse sind Voraussetzung.

  • Nice-to-have: Kenntnisse in Java und Mixpanel.

description:
About HOLY

  • HOLY is the soft drink revolution: With our product lines Energy®, Iced Tea®, Hydration®, Milkshake®, and our newest innovation, the HOLY Syrup Bottle® you get amazing taste across 50+ flavors while maintaining a good conscience—for your body & the environment.
  • Over 2M loyal customers: Started in a shared apartment by three best friends, we have scaled to Europe's fastest growing consumer brand—and our cult-like community, the HOLY Squad, loves it: 4.6 stars on reviews.io speak for themselves.
  • From D2C to Global Omnichannel: In less than four years, we've profitably scaled HOLY to more than €180M D2C revenue in DACH, FR, UK and PL. Now scaling our retail business, we're on an exciting transition to becoming a true omnichannel rocketship.
  • We are still just getting started: Backed by the world's best consumer investors, we aim to revolutionize the soft drink industry and build a generational love brand: tastier, healthier & more sustainable. Our team of 170+ people aims high (Coca-Cola, we're coming for you!).


About the Position

HOLY is growing fast: with new product launches, expanding retail partnerships, and an ever-increasing customer base driving demand across all channels.

To keep pace with this momentum, we are looking for a Logistics Manager with a clear focus on Retail and a strong connection to D2C Logistics. You will make sure that retail orders are prepared completely and delivered on time, while also supporting reliable D2C fulfillment, inventory flow, and customer experience.

This role is highly operational and hands-on. You are the kind of person who spots a problem, takes ownership, and fixes it before it becomes a bigger issue.

Retail Logistics Ownership

  • Take end-to-end responsibility for ensuring that retail orders are complete and ready for shipment on time.
  • Own Retail OTIF performance and proactively steer against deviations with fulfillment partners and retail customers.
  • Coordinate display assembly, capacity planning, timelines, and escalations.

D2C Logistics Support
  • Support reliable D2C order fulfillment, inventory flow, replenishment, and delivery performance.
  • Monitor open operational issues and coordinate quick resolutions with fulfillment partners, Supply Chain, Customer Service, and E-Commerce.
  • Support accurate system synchronization across warehouses and sales channels.

3PL Partnership & Operations Oversight
  • Act as an operational contact for our fulfillment partners across Retail and D2C topics.
  • Ensure SLA adherence and daily operational stability.
  • Escalate and resolve deviations in speed, accuracy, availability, or cost efficiency swiftly.

Performance Analysis & Reporting
  • Track retail and D2C logistics KPIs and turn them into actionable insights.
  • Use partner reports and internal dashboards to identify risks, recurring issues, and improvement opportunities.
  • Maintain clear SOPs, documentation, and performance reporting for internal visibility.
Cross-Functional Coordination
  • Act as the communication bridge between Logistics, Inside Sales, Retail, E-Commerce, Customer Service, Supply Chain, and external partners.
  • Keep stakeholders informed of critical operational updates, risks, and changes.
  • Lead root-cause investigations and coordinate quick resolutions to protect customer experience.
Process Improvement & Scalability
  • Improve recurring logistics workflows across Retail and D2C.
  • Identify efficiency and cost-reduction opportunities and track implementation progress.
  • Help build scalable logistics playbooks for HOLY's omnichannel growth.


About You

  • Retail-Ops-Ownership: You take full end-to-end responsibility for retail order readiness and OTIF performance, proactively steering against deviations before they become escalations.
  • 3PL & partner management: Proven experience managing fulfillment partners operationally - holding them to SLAs, resolving deviations in speed, accuracy or cost quickly and calmly.
  • Cross-functional coordination: Comfortable acting as the bridge between Logistics, Retail, E-Commerce, Customer Service and Supply Chain, keeping stakeholders aligned even when things move fast.
  • Analytical & KPI-driven: Skilled at turning partner reports and internal dashboards into actionable insights, spotting risks and recurring issues early.
  • Language proficiency: Fluency in English and German is a must.


Our Offering

In today's job market, A-players have many options to choose from. As part of our offer, we prioritise providing a productive working environment and opportunities for growth. In addition to competitive compensation, including company shares, you can expect:

  • A successful and growing company: Join a company that has been growing profitable and quickly for the last 36+ months and have just raised a series B, while many other e-commerce companies are struggling.
  • Huge impact: Enjoy huge impact to shape HOLY’s internationalisation in a top market.
  • Awesome team: Join an awesome team of colleagues who are ambitious, funny, down-to-earth, and authentic. Get to know us and see for yourself!
  • Top product: Marketing is important, but a good product is essential. Our differentiated soft drinks have won over customers. Check out our reviews.io reviews or contact us for free samples.
  • Startup culture: Join a startup culture that values flat hierarchies, fast pace, and personal development. With us, you can make a real impact.
  • Perfect setup: Enjoy a perfect setup that includes all the requirements of a modern employer, such as a central office in Berlin Prenzlauerberg, flexible working hours, and much more.
  • Competitive comp. + equity: Join us at a pivotal stage of hypergrowth. We offer a strong salary and meaningful equity—giving you the chance to share in our current success and benefit from the massive upside as we scale.
Find out more about HOLY and our team on our careers page.


The Process

As we are experiencing rapid growth and have ambitious plans, the optimal start date for the position is today. Nonetheless, we are prepared to patiently await the arrival of the ideal candidate, recognizing that quality ultimately yields the best results.

  1. Getting to know you: After reviewing your CV, Eric, our Talent Acquisition Manager, will have a 30-minute screening interview with you to discuss more about HOLY and the position and see if our expectations match.
  2. Hiring Manager Interview with Jan: Deep dive into your experience and approach with Jan, our Senior Logistics Manager.
  3. Case study: As soon as you have successfully completed the first 2 interviews, you will receive a case study.
  4. Advanced discussion: In this on-site meeting, the team will discuss your case study with you and answer questions in our office, the HOLY Temple. Here you will also meet Markus, our COO.
  5. Founder interview: As a strong cultural fit is important to us, you will have a final meeting with Fredi, one of our HOLY founders. This gives both you and us the opportunity for a final check.
  6. Job offer and decision: If everything goes well, you will receive an offer and we are ready to embark on this journey together with you!
Typically his process should take around 2 weeks.


Any questions or concerns?

description:
Role: Product Owner – Communication Channels & AI

Location: Manchester

Hours: Monday-Friday 8:45am-5:15pm

Package: £80k OTE 

As Product Owner - Technical Products, your role is to own and continuously improve PHMG's Technical product portfolio, ensuring Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE deliver measurable client value, operational quality and long-term commercial growth. 

You are accountable for translating client needs, technology capability, partner opportunities and commercial priorities into scalable products and service models that strengthen adoption, retention and PHMG's competitive position. 

Through H2 2026, you will lead the evolution of the technical product portfolio by bringing together product performance, platform capability, roadmap execution, client outcomes, commercial discipline, operational readiness and cross-functional alignment into one coherent product improvement agenda. 

Key Objectives 

Core Accountability 

  • Own the strategy, design and ongoing performance of Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE.
  • Set a clear, prioritised roadmap that balances client value, technical feasibility, commercial return, operational capacity and partner dependency.
  • Ensure Technical products are positioned, sold, onboarded, serviced and renewed in a way that delivers measurable value for clients.
  • Define the product standards, service models and client journeys that CS and Technical Production can execute consistently.
  • Bring clarity to build, buy and partner decisions so product direction is deliberate, commercially disciplined and scalable.

 

Technical Product Strategy & Roadmap 

  • Define the long-term direction for Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE, including the sequence of capability, integrations and service-model changes.
  • Prioritise AI Receptionist growth across both horizontal capability and the vertical use cases where PHMG has the strongest right to win.
  • Create a clear approach for CCE in the existing base, reducing under-utilisation and turning technical review, onboarding and value evidence into retention levers.
  • Partner with the Creative Product Owner so the full product set feels coherent to clients and to the teams selling and servicing it.

Client Experience, Adoption & Value Evidence 

  • Define the client experience for Technical products across onboarding, configuration, in-life usage, renewal and offboarding.
  • Clarify how clients access, configure and understand product value through the portal, including call flows, AI Receptionist behaviour, CCE setup and usage analytics.
  • Ensure CS has the standards, data and language needed to evidence value, drive adoption and manage client expectations confidently.
  • Identify where clients slow, stall or disengage, and build product or service-model interventions that protect retention.

Commercial Performance & Partner Discipline 

  • Own the commercial logic of the Technical portfolio, including pricing, CAC, cost-to-serve, gross margin, revenue performance and investment cases.
  • Operationalise the GoTo resell model with clear pricing, service, process and margin controls while protecting the partner relationship.
  • Use data to assess where Technical products create incremental value, where they cannibalise existing activity and where the model needs to change.
  • Make active trade-offs between speed, quality, margin, client experience and platform investment.

Operational Delivery & Launch Readiness 

  • Work with Technical Production and Tech to define standards, SLAs, runbooks and support models for each product and release.
  • Ensure new capabilities do not go live until operational readiness, client communications, CS briefings and support routes are clear.
  • Create tight governance for launch decisions, technical dependencies, client escalations, recurring provisioning issues and partner constraints.
  • Keep accountability clear between Product, Tech and Product Operations so issues are solved at the right level rather than absorbed by CS.

Insight, Reporting & Continuous Improvement 

  • Maintain a reliable view of product performance across adoption, usage, NPS, retention, revenue, margin, service issues and operational friction.
  • Build structured feedback loops with CS, Client Insights, Sales, Tech and Technical Production to identify product problems worth solving.
  • Turn recurring client or operational issues into permanent product, process, reporting or service-model improvements.
  • Use performance data to make early decisions before product issues become retention, margin or client-experience risks.

 

About PHMG:

Established in 1998, PHMG has grown from a Manchester-founded creative business into the world's leading audio branding agency. Today, we partner with almost 40,000 clients across more than 50 countries, including global brands such as Coca-Cola, Samsung, Adidas and Audi, alongside ambitious SMEs in virtually every sector. Innovation fuels everything we do. From day one, we set out to redefine audio branding by harmonising creativity, technology and measurable results. That mindset continues to shape our evolution as we expand beyond sound into a broader suite of client communication services. In 2025, PHMG entered a defining new chapter as an employee-owned business. Ownership now sits with the people who power our creativity, performance and growth. It strengthens our independence, sharpens our long-term focus and ensures success is shared. We are proud recipients of the King's Award for Enterprise, recognised for innovation, growth and performance excellence. Today, more than 800 colleagues across six global offices collaborate to deliver work that blends artistry with commercial impact. Joining PHMG means becoming part of a people-powered, future-focused company that values creativity, champions diversity and invests in professional growth. Sound good?

description:
Role: Head of Data Engineering

Location: Manchester based office – Hybrid working

Package: £98k OTE

 

PHMG is continuing to develop and mature its data capability, focusing on modernising our data platform and enhancing the way we work. This creates further opportunities to leverage data more effectively, allowing us to better serve our customers and colleagues. As part of this continued development, we are looking to strengthen our Data Engineering capability and maximise the value from the wealth of data held across the organisation. 

To support this vision, we are seeking a Head of Data Engineering. This pivotal role will lead an established Data Engineering team, supporting their development while strengthening engineering practices, technical standards and ways of working across the function. The successful candidate will foster a culture of technical excellence, collaboration and continuous improvement. 

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced data engineering leader to help develop our data engineering community of practice, define data standards across the organisation and be part of the team delivering and evolving PHMG's Data Strategy. 

The role: What you will do: 

  • Lead, manage and develop the Data Engineering team, building capability, resilience and strong ways of working.
  • Own PHMG's core data platform, architecture, data warehouse and associated pipelines, ensuring solutions are scalable, reliable, maintainable and cost-effective.
  • Own Data Engineering delivery, ensuring work is appropriately designed, prioritised and delivered to agreed standards.
  • Establish and embed strong engineering practices across source control, CI/CD, testing, code review, documentation, monitoring and error handling.
  • Work closely with the wider Data team to translate the Data Strategy and business priorities into an effective engineering roadmap and delivery plan.
  • Work closely with IT, Infrastructure and other engineering teams on architecture, integrations, migrations and platform decisions.
  • Identify and evaluate opportunities to improve the performance, reliability and efficiency of PHMG's data capability, including the use of emerging technologies.

This is an exciting role for an experienced data engineering leader who has: 

  • Demonstrable experience leading, developing and managing Data Engineering teams.
  • A strong track record of designing and delivering enterprise-scale data platforms, solutions and architectures.
  • A thorough understanding of modern ETL/ELT practices and experience designing scalable, reliable and maintainable data pipelines.
  • Advanced working knowledge of SQL and Python.
  • Experience working with modern cloud data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift or BigQuery. Experience within the Microsoft data ecosystem would be advantageous.
  • Strong understanding of modern engineering practices including source control, CI/CD, automated testing, code review, monitoring and observability.
  • Strong experience of data modelling for reporting and analytics, using tools and approaches such as dbt or equivalent.
  • Strong understanding of data quality, governance, security and data management best practices.
  • Experience managing engineering delivery using agile ways of working.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions, risks and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Nice to have experience: 

  • Experience integrating data with operational systems, including reverse ETL into platforms such as Salesforce.
  • Understanding of the Data Science / Machine Learning lifecycle and MLOps.
  • Experience using Infrastructure as Code approaches and tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.

Why PHMG Tech:  

The IT, Development and Data functions within PHMG continue to evolve how we use technology and data to deliver value to the business. We want to build an open, collaborative culture where people communicate honestly, support each other and take pride in delivering good work. 

About PHMG:

description:
Kleines Kraftwerk & Du

Wir sind Kleines Kraftwerk, ein junges Unternehmen mit großer Ambition. 


In nur drei Jahren sind wir stark gewachsen und noch lange nicht am Ziel. Bei uns erwarten dich Verantwortung, Tempo und echter Gestaltungsspielraum – verbunden mit der Erwartung, dass du ihn nutzt.  Mit unseren Produkten bringen wir die Energie von morgen direkt zu den Menschen nach Hause. Unsere Mission ist es, nachhaltige Energie einfach, zugänglich und alltagstauglich zu machen. 


Du hast Lust, dass aus Performance-Daten und kreativen Ideen Ads entstehen, die nicht nur auffallen, sondern konvertieren? 

Als unser:e neue:r

Creative Strategist:in 

entwickelst du unsere Creative Strategy zu einem echten Wachstumstreiber. Die Basis steht: laufende Kampagnen, jede Menge Daten, ein Visual-Team und erste Testing-Ansätze. Du entwickelst daraus ein klares System – mit starken Angles und Hooks, strukturiertem Testing und einem Prozess, der erfolgreiche Creatives konsequent weiterentwickelt.

Dafür bekommst du echte Ownership, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und die Chance, unsere Creative Strategy maßgeblich zu prägen.

Bereit, aus starken Ideen ein skalierbares Creative-System zu machen?


Wofür du Verantwortung übernimmst

Du bist die Übersetzung zwischen Performance-Daten und kreativer Umsetzung, nicht die Person, die selbst designt oder schneidet, sondern die, die genau weiß, warum ein Hook funktioniert oder nicht, und daraus die nächste Iteration ableitet. 

  • Du entwickelst Angles, Hooks und Kampagnenkonzepte: Für Meta, TikTok und Google übersetzt du Zielgruppen-Insights in Creatives, die konvertieren. 
  • Du verantwortest unsere Creative Strategy: Du schaffst klare Prozesse, Briefing-Standards und ein Testing-System für skalierbare Performance Creatives.
  • Du identifizierst neue Creative-Potenziale: Wettbewerber, Trends, Kundenfeedback und Social Listening nutzt du für neue Botschaften und Ideen.
  • Du erstellst klare Creative Briefings: Vom Hook bis zum CTA gibst du unserem Visual-Team, Creator und externen Partnern eine klare Richtung.
  • Du etablierst strukturiertes Testing: Gemeinsam mit Performance Marketing testest du Hypothesen, wertest Ergebnisse aus und leitest nächste Iterationen ab.
  • Du skalierst erfolgreiche Creatives: Anhand relevanter KPIs erkennst du erfolgreiche Konzepte, entwickelst sie weiter und wirkst Creative Fatigue entgegen.
  • Du sicherst unsere Markenkonsistenz: Auch bei schnellem Testing bleiben Tonalität und Positionierung von kleines kraftwerk klar erkennbar.
  • Du nutzt AI als Beschleuniger: AI-Tools helfen dir, Research und Variantenentwicklung schneller und effizienter zu machen.


Womit du punkten kannst

Du kennst Performance Creatives aus der Praxis: Du bringst ca. 3+ Jahre Erfahrung als Creative Strategist:in, im Performance Creative oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit, idealerweise im D2C-, Agentur- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld.

  • Du weißt, was konvertiert: Du hast bereits Creative-Konzepte entwickelt, die nicht nur gut aussahen, sondern nachweislich funktioniert und skaliert haben.
  • Du verstehst die relevanten Plattformen: Meta, Google und TikTok Ads sowie die Struktur von Kampagnen und Creative-Tests sind dir vertraut. Hands-on-Erfahrung mit den Tools ist ein Plus.
  • Du denkst kreativ und datengetrieben: KPIs wie Hook Rate, Hold Rate, CTR und CPA kannst du sicher einordnen und in konkrete Ideen und nächste Iterationen übersetzen.
  • Du kannst andere kreativ anleiten: Du schreibst klare Briefings und arbeitest sicher mit internen Visual-Teams, externen Creator und Kooperationspartnern zusammen.
  • Du willst gestalten statt verwalten: Du arbeitest strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich und hast Lust, bestehende Ansätze zu einem funktionierenden Creative-System weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Du bist offen für neue Tools: AI nutzt du bereits für Creative Research und Produktion  oder hast Lust, dich intensiv damit auseinanderzusetzen.
  • Du kommunizierst souverän: Gute Englischkenntnisse für internationale Ad-Benchmarks sind ein Plus.

Bewirb dich nicht, wenn …

  • Du lieber nach Bauchgefühl arbeitest: Daten und KPIs gehören für dich genauso zu guten Creatives wie starke Ideen.
  • Du klare Prozesse brauchst, um loszulegen: Bei uns gibt es noch nicht für alles ein Handbuch. Genau das soll dich reizen.
  • Du operative Arbeit grundsätzlich ablehnst: Dein Fokus liegt auf Strategie, aber du bist dir auch nicht zu schade, bei Bedarf selbst im Ads Manager mit anzupacken.

Your agents will work at each of these steps: reviewing requirements before they become commitments, checking and improving artifacts as the project moves, and catching risks while there's still time to act on them.   • Design human-in-the-loop workflows that learn: people review and correct agent output at defined checkpoints, and those corrections flow back into better prompts, evals, and components, so the agents keep improving.

  • Embed with our delivery teams to understand how their work actually flows, identify where agents create the most leverage, and define together what good looks like.

  • Drive adoption and help shape how RobCo uses AI internally: deliver agents through the tools teams already use every day, establish best practices, and build paved paths so teams can eventually create their own agents.

Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that adapts to your use case, improves over time, and requires zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

You’ll be reducing design risk, shortening development timelines, and unlocking system-level optimization that purely physics-based approaches can't achieve at the speed we need.

You will design, build, and deploy machine learning models that enhance, accelerate, and augment our multiphysics simulation environments across our high-energy laser systems, target injection and tracking system, target manufacturing system, and fusion chamber.   • Physics-informed ML: Develop physics-informed machine learning (PIML) and physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) that embed physical constraints (Maxwell's equations, thermodynamics, fluid dynamics) directly into model architectures

  • ML pipelines: Build and maintain ML pipelines for training, validation, uncertainty quantification (UQ), and continuous model refinement against experimental and simulation data

  • Active learning & Bayesian optimization: Implement active learning and Bayesian optimization workflows to intelligently guide design space exploration and reduce costly simulation runs

  • Digital Twin integration: Integrate trained ML models into the broader Digital Twin framework, interfacing with HPC simulation outputs (COMSOL, ANSYS, custom solvers) and real-time sensor data

  • Anomaly detection: Develop anomaly detection and predictive diagnostics models to monitor system health and identify off-nominal behavior in laser subsystems

  • Autonomous optimization: Apply reinforcement learning and Bayesian control approaches to support autonomous or semi-autonomous optimization of laser operating parameters

  • Cross-functional collaboration: Collaborate with Digital Twin architects, systems engineers, and optical simulation scientists to ensure ML models meet fidelity, latency, and uncertainty requirements

  • Engineering rigor: Establish best practices for model versioning, reproducibility, testing, and documentation in a fast-moving research environment

Who You Are

Must-Haves

  • Master's or PhD in Machine Learning, Computational Physics, Applied Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a closely related field

  • Proven experience building, training, and deploying ML models for complex physical systems; strong command of deep learning (PyTorch, TensorFlow/JAX), probabilistic models, and uncertainty quantification

  • Expert-level Python; proficiency in C++ or Fortran a plus; experience with HPC environments (batch schedulers, MPI/OpenMP parallelization)

  • Fluency working with PDE-based simulation outputs, time-series sensor data, and high-dimensional parameter spaces typical of multiphysics environments

  • Hands-on experience with Gaussian processes, neural network surrogates, reduced-order models, or equivalent metamodeling techniques

  • Experience building robust ML pipelines for scientific data — including preprocessing, feature engineering, model validation, and deployment

  • Ability to communicate model behavior, confidence intervals, and limitations clearly to physicists, engineers, and non-ML specialists

  • Strong cross-functional team skills; comfort working in an interdisciplinary environment spanning physics, engineering, and software

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) or neural operators (DeepONet, FNO) applied to physical systems

  • Background in laser physics, plasma physics, high-energy-density science, or related complex physics domains

  • Experience with digital twin platforms and live integration of ML models with simulation environments (e.g., NVIDIA Omniverse, Siemens Xcelerator, ANSYS Twin Builder)

  • Familiarity with multidisciplinary design optimization (MDO) workflows, including Design of Experiments (DoE), sensitivity analysis, and uncertainty propagation

  • Experience applying reinforcement learning to physical system control or optimization

  • Familiarity with Monte Carlo methods and statistical uncertainty quantification frameworks

  • Experience with MLOps tooling (MLflow, Weights & Biases, DVC) in a scientific computing context

  • Interest in fusion energy, advanced laser systems, or high-energy-density physics

What It Takes to Make an Impact Here…

  • Proven experience leading or managing software engineering teams.

  • Experience with modern software development practices, Java-based backend systems, cloud-native architectures, APIs, distributed systems, and CI/CD.
  • A strong understanding of software quality, automated testing, observability, security, and operational excellence.
  • Experience defining and using engineering effectiveness and delivery metrics, such as DORA metrics, flow metrics, quality and reliability indicators, to understand team health, identify bottlenecks, and drive continuous improvement—without using metrics as simplistic measures of individual performance.
  • Strong understanding of AI-assisted and agentic software development, with practical experience using modern AI coding tools and agents and the ability to help teams adopt them effectively across development, testing, code review, documentation, and other parts of the software delivery lifecycle.
  • Experience working closely with Product in an agile product-development environment.
  • Strong people-management skills, including coaching, feedback, performance management, and career development.
  • The ability to turn ambiguous business requirements into structured execution plans.
  • A data-informed approach to engineering performance without reducing productivity to simplistic metrics.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Professional fluency in English.

Our Engineering Culture…

  • Ownership over hand-offs Teams own outcomes, not just tasks.
  • Quality with speed We move quickly without treating engineering quality as optional.
  • Pragmatism over perfection We make deliberate trade-offs based on business and technical context.
  • Transparency Risks, mistakes, and disagreements should surface early. 
  • Continuous improvement Our architecture, processes, and ways of working should get better as we scale.
  • Collaboration Great products come from Engineering, Product, Design, Security, Data, and business teams working together.
